We are seeking a Remote Healthcare Verification Specialist to support our healthcare operations by coordinating patient appointments, providing patient and caregiver support, and assisting with insurance-related processes. The ideal candidate will have experience with insurance eligibility verification, billing, prior authorizations, and DME (Durable Medical Equipment), as well as a background in Urgent Care, a medical office, DME, or a similar healthcare environment. In this role, you will communicate with patients, caregivers, insurance providers, and healthcare teams through phone and
, coordinate appointments, verify insurance benefits and coverage, and assist with authorizations and DME-related processes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable managing multiple responsibilities while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer service. This position requires the ability to work independently, follow established processes, quickly learn new systems, and work U.S. Eastern Time (New York) business hours.



Key Responsibilities:



Handle customer inquiries and provide accurate information via inbound/outbound phone calls and
 communications.

Conduct outbound calls to patients and caregivers to schedule, confirm, and follow up on medical appointments.

Manage inbound calls related to appointment coordination and patient support.

Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate medical appointments based on patient and caregiver needs.

Answer questions regarding appointment details, availability, timing, and related information.

Provide updates regarding test result availability and expected turnaround times, when applicable.

Maintain accurate and detailed records of customer interactions, appointments, and communications.

Perform administrative and customer service support tasks as needed.

Deliver professional and high-quality customer service to ensure patient and caregiver satisfaction.

Verify insurance eligibility, billing, and prior authorizations.

Handle DME and DME insurance processes.

Support operations in Urgent Care, medical office, DME, or similar healthcare settings.

Review insurance benefits, coverage, deductibles, copays, and coinsurance.

Perform other duties related to the position as assigned.



Qualifications & Requirements:



Proficient level of English (written and spoken).

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with clients, vendors, and teammates.

Experience with insurance eligibility verification, insurance billing, and prior authorizations is highly preferred.

Familiarity with Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and DME insurance processes.

Experience working in Urgent Care, a medical office, DME, or a similar healthcare environment is preferred.

Strong understanding of insurance benefits, coverage, deductibles, copays, and coinsurance is preferred.

Familiarity with insurance portals, EMR/EHR systems, and billing or authorization platforms.

Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.

Excellent organization, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Resourceful, accountable, with a strong sense of ownership.

Out-of-the-box thinker, highly adaptable, reliable, self-motivated, and confident.

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage daily operations.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Familiar with standard business tools 
, spreadsheets, document management).

Ability to quickly learn new systems, software, and workflows.

Ability to follow established processes accurately with minimal supervision.

Ability to work U.S. EST (New York) business hours and adapt to business needs.

Interested in long-term career opportunities.

Able to undergo a background check.

Reliable Windows 10+ computer, two monitors, and high-speed internet.

Reliable backup power source (e.g., power bank, UPS, inverter, or generator) for uninterrupted work during outages.

Professional home workstation capable of supporting uninterrupted remote work.



Compensation & Benefits:



100% remote work.

Compensation in USD.

Full-time position with 40 hours weekly.

Please note that this is a long-term opportunity.

Great work environment with potential for growth.

title: Client Success & Lead Intake Specialist
description:
About the Company:

Our client is a well-established dumpster rental business in the U.S. that’s currently expanding its remote operations. The company is shifting from a personality-driven setup to a more process-oriented model, supported by new systems and technology. They are seeking a Customer Service & Sales Coordinator to strengthen client relationships, handle repeat orders, and ensure smooth daily operations.



Job Description:

The Customer Service & Sales Coordinator plays a key role in managing client relationships and coordinating day-to-day sales and service operations. This is a “farmer” role — focused on maintaining relationships, ensuring repeat business, and delivering excellent service — rather than cold calling or outbound sales.



Key Responsibilities



A. Lead Intake & Call Handling

- Answer all inbound calls promptly, accurately, and professionally.

- Gather caller information (name, address, service request, timelines).

- Log details into the system with complete accuracy.

- Forward qualified leads immediately to the salesperson.



B. Client Success & Customer Journey Support

- Serve as the main point of contact for clients after the sale is closed.

- Ensure promises made during sales are delivered as expected.

- Keep clients informed at important service touchpoints, including:

Rental start

Mid-rental updates

Before rental end

Pickup scheduling

- Communicate extension options, fees, overage situations, and billing reminders.

- Follow up on unpaid invoices professionally and consistently.



C. Upsell & Retention

- Identify opportunities for extensions, upgrades, or additional services.

- Recommend helpful solutions that add value to the customer.



D. Process Building & Company Growth

- Help build SOPs, workflows, and communication templates as the role develops.

- Suggest improvements based on customer feedback and recurring issues.

- Support the company in creating a stronger, more organized client success system.

- Bring initiative and ownership in shaping a new department.



E. Admin & Coordination

- Keep customer records updated, organized, and easy to follow.

- Coordinate with dispatch, billing, and sales as needed.

- Track all conversations and updates clearly in the system



Team Collaboration

- Work closely with the billing and operations teams to ensure all client records and orders are up-to-date.

- Communicate effectively with internal staff to relay customer needs and resolve issues quickly.

- Participate in weekly team check-ins and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.



Qualifications

- Minimum 2-3 years of experience in customer service, account coordination, or inside sales (preferably in a U.S. or English-speaking environment).

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Strong interpersonal skills — confident, warm, and approachable on the phone.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

- Proficiency with CRMs (HubSpot experience is an advantage).

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote setup.

- Background in logistics, construction, or service-based industries is a plus.



Why You’ll Love Working Here

- Opportunity to join a growing, forward-thinking company during an exciting expansion phase.

- Supportive leadership that values initiative and professional growth.

- Stable, long-term position with room to increase compensation based on performance.

- Work with a friendly, results-driven team that values relationships and accountability.

title: Executive Assistant & Business Growth Support
description:
A note before you apply: This role involves coordinating my keynotes, workshops, and retreats and speaking with clients, HR leaders, and executives, so clear, confident spoken English is a must.



I’m a licensed clinical psychologist, keynote speaker, and founder of a sleep and wellness education brand that serves corporate clients. I’m looking for a dependable, self-directed executive assistant who can keep my day-to-day running smoothly and help me grow my speaking business and lead pipeline.



This role is for someone who takes ownership. I want to hand off a task, trust it will be finished correctly, and not have to follow up. You’ll communicate with executives, HR leaders, and clients on my behalf, so polished writing and good judgment are essential.



What you’ll do



Business growth and lead generation (a major focus)



-Follow up with people I meet at conferences, events, and workshops, and move them through a simple pipeline (first touch, follow-up, proposal, booking)

-Do LinkedIn outreach and relationship-building with potential corporate clients and event planners

-Research and track speaking opportunities, conferences, associations, and corporate wellness buyers, and bring me a qualified list

-Keep a CRM or tracking sheet current so no lead falls through the cracks

-Help prepare proposals, one-sheets, and follow-up materials

-Set up and send newsletters or
 sequences that nurture new leads



Executive and administrative support



-Manage my calendar, scheduling, and travel (flights, hotels, ground transportation)

-Handle
 correspondence and client communication in a professional voice

-Prepare meeting agendas and notes, and keep documents organized and confidential

-Track expenses and help with invoicing and basic bookkeeping tasks

-Track contracts, agreements, proposals, and partnership deadlines, and flag what needs my attention before it becomes urgent



Workshops, events, and product fulfillment



-Support workshops from proposal through execution: logistics, materials, registration, surveys, and post-event follow-up

-Coordinate event-day logistics remotely, including materials, schedules, and registration (physical setup is handled on site by me or the venue)

-Track inventory and place orders for products sold at events (books, card decks, and similar items), coordinating with print-on-demand and shipping vendors



Marketing and content support



-Schedule and manage social media (LinkedIn, Instagram) using content I approve

-Research and create successful online ads

-Grow my online presence on LinkedIn and Instagram through consistent posting and engagement, and help launch and manage new channels, such as a YouTube channel or other social platforms

-Repurpose my talks, workshops, and videos into posts, clips,
 content, and graphics

-Create or polish presentations and graphics in Canva

-Make light edits and updates to my websites on GoDaddy and Wix (text, images, pages, forms). You don’t need to be a developer.



Membership or community support (if launched)



-Help set up, monitor, and support an online membership community



Special projects (as assigned)



-Special projects as assigned, including finalizing my children’s book, tracking and organizing legal contracts and agreements and their deadlines (administrative coordination, not legal advice or drafting), and other business projects I’ll define as we go



What I’m looking for



-Clear, confident spoken English so you can answer client questions, coordinate details for my keynotes, workshops, and retreats, and speak with HR leaders and executives, plus excellent written English and a professional, warm tone for corporate clients

-Availability during US Central Time hours when important or time-sensitive tasks come up. Most work can be done on your own schedule, but you must be reachable during these hours when something important needs to be handled.

-Proven ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and solve problems without constant direction

-Experience with outreach, lead follow-up, or sales support (a plus, not a dealbreaker)

-Comfort with Google Workspace, Canva, scheduling tools,
 marketing platforms, and social media

-Comfortable using AI tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) to work faster on drafting, research, summarizing, and organizing, while always reviewing the output for accuracy and tone before it goes out under my name

-Strong attention to detail and discretion



How to apply:

To be considered, please complete these two steps and send them together in one message within 48 hours of applying. It helps me get to know you, and hopefully we can schedule a live call afterward!



Introduce yourself on video (2 minutes or less). Record a short video or voice message and send me the link (Loom, Google Drive, or Vocaroo all work). I’d love to hear about you and your most recent admin or business support experience.



Choose ONE small sample:

Pick whichever fits your strengths best: 



Option A: Instagram post or carousel. Take a look at my 
 a free Canva account, create one simple post (a single image or a short carousel) that fits my style and message. Please send me a view-only link, plus a sentence on why you chose it. 

Option B: LinkedIn question. Take a look at my LinkedIn: 
/in/dr-kimberly-lemke. I’m a sleep expert and keynote speaker who speaks to HR leaders, wellness directors, and business owners. In a few lines, please tell me: (a) 5 types of people or roles you would connect with on LinkedIn to find speaking opportunities for me, and (b) a 2-sentence connection message you would send to one of them.



Please don’t worry about perfection. I’m simply looking to see your creativity, your sense of who my audience is, and how you communicate. I know this takes time out of your day, and I’m grateful for the effort.

title: USA Phone Closer
description:
We are looking for an experienced phone closer. This is a long-term position and you must be comfortable working in the US time zone.



What we do

We are an established and growing company. To keep growing, we onboard with new US payment processors, and for that we need US signers: US-based people who sign on as the signatory for our companies. That is the whole role for them. They sign on, they stay on file, and they get paid monthly for it. They do not run anything or handle anything.

We are not just some company. We have been doing this for a while, we keep expanding, and we continuously need new US signers.



What we need from you

We already have the leads. US-based people apply through our website and ads and land in our lead sheet. Nobody is calling them yet.

Your job is to call these leads, explain what a US signer is and what we offer, answer their questions, and close them so they agree to work with us. That is it. Once they say yes, our team takes it from there. You only close.

You make the changes in AutoCAD, accurately and quickly, following the drawing standard that's already there. It's steady, varied work updating existing drawings. Who this suits

We’re open to applicants from a range of backgrounds. This role may suit:



- Someone with drafting or technical experience who is returning to work after a break and wants a flexible way back into the workforce without stepping backwards.



- Someone with foundational AutoCAD skills and limited professional drafting experience who wants to develop their skills and build a career in drafting.



You don't need specific as built drawing experience. We'll teach you our drawing standards and CAD skills and give you insights into the construction industry. A team member will check your work and give you feedback in the early weeks. 



Hours, pay and set-up 



Hours: about 16 to 20 hours a week to start. Within those hours you choose when you work, as long as jobs go out on time. Jobs are small (usually 1 to 6 hours each) with about a two-day turnaround. 



Pay: 3 month probation period, a fixed PHP 13,000 a month for part-time hours, paid monthly. 



Full-time: we'll formally review your progress at 3 months. A successful candidate will transition to full time work (approx. 40 hours) for a fixed PHP 25,000 – 28,000 a month, within six months of starting. 



Pay progression: pay is reviewed annually and good work is rewarded. 



Start: by negotiation. 



Arrangement: direct hire only, no agencies please. 



Equipment: your own PC or laptop that runs AutoCAD, AutoCAD software, reliable internet and a power backup. 



About Design Assist Partners 



Design Assist Partners has been in business for over 21 years, working mainly for Australian construction clients. We're a small, close-knit team, and several of our people started part-time and have grown into senior roles. We update and revise existing Electrical, Hydraulic and Mechanical drawings, and put together supporting documents like Operation & Maintenance (O&M) manuals. 



What you'll be doing 



CAD drafting: making marked-up changes to existing drawings for clients in the construction industry. 



O&M manuals: assembling client information in Microsoft Word and a PDF editor. 



As you grow: helping with job quotes and RFIs, keeping a daily job list and monthly timesheet, tracking your hours against the quote and telling us early if a job is running over, building your own checklists so your work goes out error free, and later helping train newer team members. 



We have a structure in place that will give you opportunity to grow in many areas.

Foundation to Medium Level AutoCAD skills and a real wish to grow and learn.

Good written and verbal English, and comfortable with Word and Excel. 



Someone who manages their own time and speaks up early if something isn't working. 



Someone who wants to grow into more hours and more responsibility with us. 



Why this role 



There's no travel and no commute, and the hours are flexible. You get steady work with a long-established business and a real path to full time and more responsibility. We want people who join us to feel they're moving forward in a rewarding career.

Applications that skip a step won't be considered.

 directly,  put the words Paying Attention followed by your full name in the subject line.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

title: Remote E-Commerce VA — Research-Heavy Listing Reviewer & Pricer (Part-Time / Asynchronous) Location: 100% Remote / Onlin
description:
Remote E-Commerce VA — Research-Heavy Listing Reviewer & Pricer (Part-Time / Asynchronous)

Location: 100% Remote / Online (Any Time Zone — Company based in EST)



Schedule: Part-Time — No fixed shift hours or set schedules. Work whenever you want, entirely on your own time.



Structure: Weekly Quota Basis



Start Date: ASAP



Pay Rate: $0.20 per completed listing draft (Expect an average of $200/month)



Payout Schedule: Paid monthly via Wise



Weekly Hard Deadline: All assigned listing drafts for your weekly quota must be completed by Sunday, 7:00 PM EST.



About Distress Vintage LLC

At Distress Vintage LLC, we specialize in sourcing and selling unique vintage and rare pre-owned clothing across top online marketplaces. Because vintage clothing varies wildly in rarity, era, and value, this is a research-intensive role.



We are looking for an analytical, detail-oriented Listing Reviewer & Market Researcher who enjoys digging into product details, finding exact market comps, and ensuring every item is perfectly optimized and accurately priced before going live.



Key Responsibilities (Research & Quality Control Workflow)

Deep Pricing & Market Research: Utilize Google Lens, visual search tools, and historical eBay sold comps—along with our custom prompt system—to identify vintage tags, eras, and exact market value.





Title & SEO Optimization: Craft and refine search-optimized, keyword-rich titles in Nifty.AI based on your research findings (identifying brands, style names, eras, and key features).





Category & Feature Verification: Deep-dive into item details to verify and correct categories, sizes, colors, fabric contents, SKUs, and conditions across eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, and Depop.





Final Listing Approval: Cross-check photo ordering, pricing accuracy, condition notes, and item specifics to ensure each draft is 100% market-ready before saving.





Candidate Requirements

Minimum Requirements:

Strong Research Mindset: High curiosity, patience, and attention to detail when looking up obscure items, tags, and comps online.





Fluent English Skills: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (Required).





Reliable Internet: Stable connection with speeds of 50 Mbps+ (Required).





Basic Tech Comfort: Comfortable with general file management and web application navigation.





Video Interview: Willingness to join a short video call during the hiring process.





Preferred Qualifications:

Multi-Monitor Setup: Desktop workstation with 2 or more monitors (Highly recommended for side-by-side research and cross-listing efficiency).





SEO & Keyword Strategy: Solid grasp of how search algorithms and keywords work in e-commerce listing titles.





How to Apply

To demonstrate your attention to detail and love for clothing, please follow these instructions carefully
 



Subject Line: Send your message with the exact subject line:



I Want to Work for Distress Vintage — eBay Listing VA



Flex Your Fashion Passion: Share a few sentences showing off your genuine passion for fashion. Tell us about the specific aesthetics, eras, or styles you are currently interested in or have a deep knowledge of.



Screening Question: Answer this question directly in your message:



"What is the process to price an item?"



We look forward to meeting you during a quick video call!

title: Senior Payroll Officer – Australian Payroll
description:
Senior Payroll Officer – Australian Payroll



We are seeking an experienced Senior Payroll Officer based in the Philippines to join our Finance team and support the processing of Australian payroll.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced payroll professional who has a strong understanding of Australian payroll legislation, employment regulations and awards, particularly the Cleaning Services Award, and is looking to take on a senior payroll role within a supportive and professional team.

Reporting directly to the Payroll Manager, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of Australian payroll and ensuring payroll activities comply with relevant Australian legislation, awards and company policies.





The Organisation



Smart Cleaning Solutions (Aust) Pty Ltd (SCS Group) is an Australian and New Zealand commercial cleaning and integrated facility services provider supporting clients across a wide range of sectors. As a purpose-driven organisation, we combine industry knowledge, innovative technologies and a people-focused culture to deliver reliable, high-quality outcomes. This role is a rare opportunity to work remotely in Philippine, and further develop your payroll skillset with the support and guidance of an experienced Payroll Manager and team. 





The Responsibilities



Working within a supportive, positive and close-knit team, your responsibilities will include:

• Processing Australian payroll on a weekly basis, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time

• Processing new starters, employee changes, terminations and redundancies

• Interpreting and applying Australian employment legislation, payroll regulations and relevant Modern Awards

• Strong knowledge and application of the Cleaning Services Award and relevant pay rates, penalties, allowances, overtime and other entitlements

• Reviewing timesheets and payroll data to identify discrepancies and ensure accurate payroll processing

• Responding to and resolving payroll-related queries from employees and management

• Processing and reconciling superannuation, PAYG withholding and payroll tax

• Assisting with payroll reporting, reconciliations and compliance requirements

• Maintaining accurate payroll records and ensuring payroll information is treated confidentially

• Identifying and resolving payroll discrepancies in a timely manner

• Assisting with payroll audits and other compliance requirements

• Supporting continuous improvement of payroll processes and procedures

• Performing other payroll and finance-related tasks as required



The Ideal Candidate



The successful applicant will have at least 3–5 years of relevant payroll experience, with strong hands-on experience in Australian payroll.



You will ideally have:

• 3–5+ years' experience in payroll, preferably with significant Australian payroll experience

• Strong knowledge of Australian payroll legislation and employment regulations

• Practical experience interpreting and applying Australian Modern Awards

• Experience with the Cleaning Services Award (MA000022) is highly desirable

• Good understanding of Australian payroll requirements including PAYG, superannuation, payroll tax, leave entitlements, overtime, penalties and allowances

• Experience processing high-volume payroll and working with timesheets

• Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

• Strong organisational and time management skills

• Ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

• Ability to work to strict weekly payroll deadlines

• High level of integrity and confidentiality when handling sensitive payroll information

• A positive and proactive attitude, with a genuine passion for payroll



What We Offer:

• Great Place to Work® Certified for three consecutive years, recognising our commitment to our people and workplace culture.

• Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Lead Generation and Outbound Sales Specialist (Part-Time, AU SaaS Client)
description:
Imagine a sales role where you get to d
 how things are done.



An Australian SaaS founder is making his first-ever sales hire — and rather than handing you a script to follow, he wants to build the playbook with you, then trust you to run it. You'll work directly with him (no managers, no coordinators, no layers), get proper one-on-one time to learn the product in week one, and have real support while you find your feet. After that, the targeting, the cadence, the process — it's yours to shape.



If you've ever run someone else's outreach and thought "I'd do this differently," this is your chance to actually do it differently — with a founder who's genuinely asking for your ideas.



Why you'll enjoy this role

- Your ideas carry real weight. Targeting, outreach cadence, qualification criteria, CRM workflow — you help design all of it. He sets the goal; the how is yours.

- Even the tools are up for discussion. The CRM is currently Pipedrive, but if you think Go High Level (or something else) works better, he'll honestly consider switching. He's hiring you for your expertise, not just your output.

- You work directly with the founder. One relationship, clear communication, fast decisions.

- You're trusted, not tracked. Success means qualified meetings on his calendar — not hours logged, not screenshots, not activity reports.

- The product is easy to believe in. It's a digital signature and document management platform with a genuine edge: documents are verified on a blockchain ledger, giving absolute proof nothing was ever altered — at a lower price than DocuSign. Prospects actually want to hear about it.

- You won't be thrown in the deep end. Week one is structured onboarding: your own product login and real one-on-one time with the founder, so you can talk about the product with confidence before any outreach begins. And he reviews message content with you before it goes out — so you're never guessing alone.

- There's a clear path forward. If the first three months go well, the role converts to full-time with a bigger scope.



What you'll get from us

- PHP 21,250/month + PHP 750/month benefits

- 13th month pay

- 10 days paid annual leave

- 5 days paid sick leave

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator access — provided for you

- Family-friendly part-time hours: Monday to Thursday, 10:00 am – 3:00 pm AEST (Brisbane) — around 20 hours a week, with afternoons and every Friday free

- A genuine full-time pathway if the first three months go well



What your days will look like

- Finding the right people — identifying and qualifying SME decision-makers (C-suite, directors, owners) in fitness and wellness, cosmetic injectables, and lending/debt collection

- Running LinkedIn outreach — connection requests, sequences, and follow-up messaging

- Writing messages that get replies — drafting and refining based on what the response rates tell you, with the founder reviewing content before it goes out

- Keeping the pipeline tidy — maintaining the CRM: lead records, conversation status, next steps, and flagging leads that have gone cold

- Booking meetings — scheduling 15-minute discovery calls and 30-minute demos into the founder's calendar (he runs the calls; you fill the diary)

- Shaping the system together — in your first two to four weeks, you and the founder will agree what a qualified lead looks like, the outreach cadence, and the CRM workflow

- Quick daily updates — a short summary on Microsoft Teams so he always knows where things stand. No long reports, no micromanagement.



You'll feel right at home here if you…

- Have run real LinkedIn outreach campaigns before — you can comfortably chat about what you sent, what the response rates were, and what you tweaked along the way. (We genuinely love hearing about the experiments that didn't work — that's how we know you've really done this.)

- Enjoy building rather than following — a role with room to figure out what works sounds like fun, not stress

- Like running your own day — planning your time, tracking your progress, and raising things early rather than waiting to be asked

- Write clearly and well in English — your messages are the first impression prospects get, so polished writing matters here

- Keep a tidy CRM — your pipeline tells a story, not just stores data

- Enjoy a relaxed, no-pretence working relationship — the founder is friendly, casual, and direct. He says what he means, appreciates a good sense of humour, and cares about results over formality. If that sounds refreshing, you'll get along great.



Bonus points (nice, but truly not required)

- Go High Level experience

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience

- Background in fitness and wellness, cosmetic injectables, or lending and debt collection

- B2B SaaS outreach experience

- Experience positioning a product against a big-name competitor like DocuSign



Don't have the bonuses? Apply anyway. The essentials above are what matter — everything else can be learned.



One thing worth knowing

Because this is a brand-new function, there's no existing process to inherit — you'll be creating it, with the founder's close support in the early weeks. For the right person, that's the best part of the job: your fingerprints on everything, and the freedom to work the way you know works. If "here's the goal — show us what works" sounds like an adventure, we'd love to meet you.



Schedule

Monday to Thursday, 10:00 am – 3:00 pm AEST (Brisbane)

title: Moodle Technical Specialist
description:
Fully remote contractor opportunity for candidates based in the Philippines

Law Training Centre is looking for an experienced Moodle Technical Specialist based in the Philippines to help us use Moodle more intelligently and effectively across learning delivery, administration, assessment, reporting and learner support. This is a remote contractor role expected to require approximately three days per week initially.

About Law Training Centre

Law Training Centre is an established online legal education provider. We deliver regulated qualifications and professional legal training through Moodle, supported by specialist tutors and operational teams in the UK.

Moodle is central to how our learners access courses, complete assessments and progress through their qualifications. We want to make better use of its functionality to improve administration, the learner experience, progress tracking, reporting, automation and connections with other systems and learning platforms.

About the role

You will identify opportunities to improve how Moodle is configured and used, translate academic, operational and business requirements into practical Moodle solutions, and implement or coordinate improvements involving workflows, reporting, automation, plugins and integrations. You will also diagnose complex Moodle problems and determine when specialist hosting or development support is required.

A major initial priority will be to support the selection of a suitable Moodle hosting partner and manage the technical planning, testing and delivery of the platform migration. Following migration, you will provide continuing technical oversight, improvement and specialist troubleshooting.

What you will do

• Review how Moodle is currently configured and used and identify underused functionality and opportunities for improvement.

• Improve cohorts, groups, enrolments, roles, permissions, completion rules and learner progress tracking.

• Develop useful operational and management reporting, improve data visibility and automate repetitive Moodle processes where appropriate.

• Improve the technical configuration, workflows, controls and reporting for assessments and examinations, and provide technical escalation support where required.

• Diagnose complex Moodle problems and coordinate appropriate resolutions.

• Assess plugins, including appropriate AI-enabled plugins, integrations, APIs, web services and automation opportunities.

• Assess opportunities to integrate Moodle appropriately with other learning platforms and systems.

• Translate internal requirements into Moodle configurations or clear technical briefs, and test and approve technical changes.

• Support the selection of a suitable Moodle hosting partner and plan and coordinate the migration, testing, implementation and post-migration issues.

• Brief and manage hosting providers, developers and other technical suppliers, including assessing recommendations, costs and completed work.

• Maintain appropriate configuration and technical documentation and oversee testing and release processes.

• Understand and monitor backup, restoration, security and recovery arrangements at an oversight and supplier-management level.

What we are looking for

• At least three years of substantial hands-on Moodle administration and technical configuration experience.

• Direct experience of a significant Moodle migration, major upgrade or platform transition.

• Evidence of improving how an organisation uses Moodle.

• Strong working knowledge of cohorts, enrolments, roles, permissions, completion, assessments and reporting.

• Strong Moodle troubleshooting and technical problem diagnosis skills.

• Experience translating non-technical requirements into Moodle configurations or technical specifications.

• Experience working with Moodle hosting providers, developers or technical suppliers.

• Practical experience involving plugins, integrations, APIs, web services, reporting or automation.

• Clear written and spoken English and the ability to work independently with a UK-based team.

Useful additional experience

• Five or more years of substantial relevant Moodle experience.

• Experience supporting regulated education, professional qualifications or examination delivery.

• Hosting procurement, supplier comparison or migration planning.

• Knowledge of hosting environments, databases, scheduled tasks, backups, restoration, security and recovery at an oversight and supplier-management level.

• Staging environments, security reviews, release control and disaster recovery testing.

• Experience assessing AI-enabled Moodle functionality or integrations with other learning platforms.

Working arrangement

• Remote contractor engagement for a contractor based in the Philippines.

• Approximately three days per week initially.

• Monthly contractor fee of ₱35,000 to ₱50,000 for approximately three days per week (pro rata).

• Full-time equivalent of approximately ₱58,000 to ₱83,000 per month.

• The amount of work may expand or reduce depending on migration workload, platform development and continuing technical requirements.

• An initial 90-day self-employed contractor engagement, followed by review.

• At least six hours within the normal UK working day on each working day.

• Some flexibility outside these hours would be useful for planned technical changes, releases or migration activity.

• Availability for planned examination-day technical support would be useful but is not mandatory.

How to apply

Please complete the Philippine application form through the Law Training Centre recruitment webpage (see link below). You will need to upload your CV and answer six questions about your Moodle experience. You may also upload anonymised or redacted examples of your work. Do not share confidential information, personal data, learner records or material that you are not authorised to provide.

The form will ask for your availability, expected monthly contractor fee for approximately three days per week, the days or hours included in that fee, your additional day rate and your proposed full-time monthly contractor fee if the engagement expands. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a structured technical interview.

Selection approach

We will assess applicants on their Moodle administration and technical configuration, evidence of improving Moodle use, troubleshooting and technical judgement, workflows and reporting, migration and upgrade work, supplier management, and practical experience with plugins, integrations, APIs, web services and automation. We are also interested in experience of learner progress tracking, AI-enabled Moodle functionality and integration with other learning platforms. We will place more weight on specific examples than general claims. Shortlisted candidates should expect practical interview scenarios based on genuine, anonymised Moodle issues previously encountered by Law Training Centre. A short paid assessment may be used after interview only if further evidence is genuinely required.

title: Healthcare Operations and Revenue Cycle Virtual Assistant
description:
Position Overview

The Healthcare Operations and Revenue Cycle Virtual Assistant will support EVV reconciliation, billing and claim resolution, private-pay accounts receivable, payer enrollment and claims-platform administration, referral intake, eligibility and authorization tracking, documentation quality, scheduling, patient communication, recruitment, credentialing, management reporting, referral outreach, and general administration. This is an administrative position and does not include independent clinical judgment or licensed nursing practice.



Key Responsibilities

• EVV monitoring and reconciliation  Review Alora and Sandata exceptions, identify missing clock-ins or clock-outs, compare scheduled and verified hours, contact caregivers for supported corrections, and prepare daily exception reports.

• Billing, denial resolution, and accounts receivable  Reconcile authorized hours, EVV, service documentation, and claims; prepare claims and post remittances. Investigate denied, rejected, underpaid, and unpaid claims; identify errors involving patient or payer data, provider information, service codes, modifiers, units, dates, authorizations, EVV, documentation, timely filing, or submission format; and correct administrative errors or coordinate corrections with the responsible team member. Contact and follow up with the Ohio Department of Medicaid (ODM), Medicaid managed-care plans, commercial insurers, and other payers; record denial reasons, payer reference numbers, actions, and next follow-up dates; submit corrected claims or prepare reconsiderations and appeals under approved procedures; and verify acceptance, adjudication, and payment through resolution or escalation.

• Private-pay invoice follow-up  Reconcile invoices, statements, and payments; professionally contact private-pay clients or authorized responsible parties regarding delayed or unpaid invoices; resend statements; resolve routine administrative discrepancies; document communications and payment commitments; and escalate disputes, hardship requests, payment arrangements, refunds, write-offs, or high-value balances for approval.

• Payer enrollment and claims-platform administration  Maintain accurate enrollment, linkage, access, and organization records in ODM PNM, Medicaid managed-care and commercial payer portals, clearinghouses, EFT and ERA systems, and claims-submission and remittance platforms. Track applications, corrections, revalidations, renewals, rosters, service locations, NPI and taxonomy data, contacts, W-9 and legal-entity information, and required documents through completion. Verify that Peniel can submit claims, receive remittance information, and receive payment; promptly escalate access, enrollment, linkage, or payment-routing problems.

• Referral intake  Monitor CarePort,
, fax, and other approved referral portals. Collect demographics, insurance information, service needs, and required documents; request missing items; update referral status; and coordinate prompt routing for acceptance review.

• Eligibility and authorization tracking  Verify coverage through approved portals, record verification details, track authorization periods and units, maintain ISP and plan-of-care checklists, and alert management before expirations, shortages, or renewal deadlines.

• Documentation quality assurance  Check records for required fields, dates, signatures, service descriptions, start and stop times, units, and alignment with the ISP or plan of care. Request completion from caregivers and assemble organized audit packets.

• Scheduling administration  Confirm shifts, maintain caregiver availability, notify preapproved caregivers of openings, send reminders, document call-offs, and maintain records of coverage attempts and schedule changes.

• Patient and family communication  Complete introductory and routine status calls, send appointment reminders, conduct approved scripted satisfaction surveys, document nonclinical requests, and route concerns to the appropriate Peniel leader.

• Recruitment and HR administration  Post approved openings, screen candidates against objective criteria, schedule interviews, collect onboarding documents, and track training, background checks, credentials, and expiration dates.

• Credentialing administration  Maintain renewal calendars, compile credentialing applications, update rosters, collect supporting documents, and track submissions and follow-up items through completion.

• Quality and management reporting  Prepare dashboards covering census, referral conversion, uncovered shifts, service utilization, authorization balances, claim denials, payer and private-pay aging, payer-enrollment status, overtime, documentation status, and caregiver retention.

• Marketing and referral outreach  Maintain the referral-source CRM, identify hospitals, county boards, managed-care plans, veterans' organizations, and community partners, prepare non-PHI outreach, schedule meetings, track follow-up, and update approved social-media content.

• General administration  Support inbox management, meeting scheduling, SOP formatting, vendor follow-up, invoice tracking, action lists, and organized electronic records so owners and local leaders can focus on growth, patient care, and oversight.



Required Qualifications

• At least two years of recent experience supporting a U.S. healthcare, home care, home health, medical billing, revenue-cycle, or patient-access organization.

• Hands-on experience with U.S. healthcare billing, denial resolution, corrected-claim submission, payer follow-up, and accounts receivable, including professional follow-up on past-due private-pay invoices.

• Experience maintaining payer enrollments or provider records in Medicaid, managed-care, commercial insurance, clearinghouse, claims, remittance, EFT, or ERA platforms, plus at least two of these areas: EVV management, eligibility verification, prior authorization, referral intake, scheduling, credentialing, recruitment administration, or medical-record quality review.

• Working knowledge of HIPAA, protected health information, secure communication, and minimum-necessary access.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to maintain accurate trackers, aging reports, dashboards, calendars, and CRM records while reconciling information from multiple systems.

• Professional spoken and written English, excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, reliable follow-through, and willingness to escalate rather than guess.

• Ability to work the stated U.S. Eastern Time schedule consistently, including overnight hours in the Philippines.

title: UGC Video Editor | Hooks, B-Roll & Creative Variations
description:
UGC Video Editor | Hooks, B-Roll & Creative Variations



Hey! I’m Corey Brooks, a content creator looking for an editor specifically for UGC and Trybe videos.



I create content for clothing and lifestyle brands, and I need someone who understands how to turn product footage into engaging videos with strong hooks, clear messaging, and natural pacing.



A big part of this role is creating multiple versions from the same footage. You should understand how to change the hook, script, b-roll, and structure so each version feels intentional and gives us something different to test.



What you’ll work on:



- Editing short-form UGC and Trybe product videos.

- Creating multiple variations using different hooks, angles, benefits, and CTAs.

- Matching b-roll to the voiceover so viewers see what we’re talking about.

- Helping write and improve scripts with a hook, re-hook, problem/solution, product details, and CTA.

- Organizing footage so we can reuse strong clips across future edits.

- Adding clean captions, music, and sound design when they improve the video.



What you need to understand:



- How to grab attention in the first few seconds.

- The difference between a new creative angle and simply swapping the opening clip.

- How to show product details, fit, texture, and benefits through b-roll.

- How to keep a product video natural, relatable, and convincing.

- How to cut unnecessary pauses and repetition without making the delivery feel rushed.

- How to follow a brand brief and keep product claims accurate.

- How to use feedback and performance results to improve future variations.



For example, if I send footage of a hoodie, you should be able to create different versions focused on comfort, fit, styling, or everyday use, with relevant hooks and supporting footage for each.



My preferred style:



Clean, natural, and engaging. Some videos will need very little editing. Others will need more storytelling and b-roll. You should know what the video needs and make the product and message easy to understand.



I’m looking for someone who can contribute ideas, spot gaps in the footage, and tell me what additional shots or lines would make the videos stronger.



How to apply:



Use “LET ME COOK” as your application subject line.



Please include:



1. Three direct links to your best UGC or product video edits, ideally including clothing content. Explain what you personally worked on.

2. An example of multiple variations you created for the same product and what you changed between them.

3. Three different hook ideas for a comfortable everyday hoodie.

4. Your editing software, availability, expected rate, and typical turnaround time.

5. Whether you also have experience writing UGC scripts.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test edit, creating a few variations from the same footage.



I’m looking for an ongoing editor who takes pride in their work, communicates well, and can help me consistently create stronger product videos.

title: SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required
description:
We're Recruiting a SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required



Company: Allied Health Media

Job Type: Full-time

: 
 



About Allied Health Media



Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



About the Role



As our SEO Specialist, you'll own the organic search performance of a portfolio of client websites, most of them in healthcare. That means running full technical and on-page audits, catching crawling, indexing, and architecture issues before they hurt rankings, and keeping Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site health in good shape. You'll turn findings into clear, actionable tasks for developers and content teams, then verify the fixes actually landed correctly on the live site — not just take someone's word for it. You'll also track performance through GA4 and Search Console, investigate unusual traffic or ranking shifts, and report on what's working, what isn't, and what should happen next. Because our clients operate in healthcare, you'll need to apply extra care and sound judgement around medical content accuracy, not just chase quick wins.



Do Not Apply If...



You rely solely on automated tool scores instead of professional judgement

You don't follow through to confirm that requested fixes were actually implemented correctly

You're uncomfortable explaining technical SEO issues to non-technical team members

You cut corners on accuracy, especially with medical/healthcare content

You need close supervision to manage multiple client websites and priorities

You're not comfortable learning new SEO tools and platforms.

You don't havr a background or practical experience in web development.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, covering crawling, indexing, rendering, and site architecture.

Review and optimise XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and URL structures.

Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.

Review and troubleshoot structured data and schema markup.

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and performance issues, and investigate unusual changes.

Support website migrations, redesigns, and staging-to-live launches.

Optimise on-page elements — titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.

Identify duplicate, thin, or competing pages and recommend consolidation or redirection.

Review and QA completed SEO and development work across desktop, tablet, and mobile before sign-off.

Retest and verify that requested fixes have been implemented correctly on the live site.

Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions via GA4, and prepare clear performance reports.

Coordinate with developers, designers, and content teams — writing clear, actionable SEO tasks.

Apply extra care, accuracy, and professional judgement when working with healthcare and medical content.



Skills and Tools Required



At least two years of practical SEO experience.

Strong knowledge of technical SEO and on-page optimisation.

Experience conducting detailed website audits and prioritising fixes by impact.

Understanding of crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, and URL structures.

Experience with structured data/schema markup and Core Web Vitals.

Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Experience working with developers and verifying completed fixes.

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues simply.

Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

Experience with SEO platforms such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush.

Familiarity with PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse, Looker Studio, and schema validation tools.



Compensation



We offer a competitive, performance-based package tailored to your experience and track record, with room to grow as you take on more client responsibility. This is a long-term opportunity with a stable, growing agency — not a short-term contract — and we reward accuracy, reliability, and great work with real career progression.



Why Join Us?



Work across a real portfolio of client websites, including meaningful healthcare projects where your work genuinely matters.

Join a fast-growing team where your audits and recommendations directly shape client results.

Flexible, remote-friendly setup with a supportive, collaborative team culture.

Room to grow into more senior SEO or strategy roles as the company scales.

Exposure to a variety of tools, platforms, and industries — never the same day twice.

A team that values professional judgement, accuracy, and follow-through over vanity metrics.





Ready to Join a Fast-Growing Team?

Senior Meta Ads Specialist / Media Buyer



About the Role



We are looking for a Senior Meta Ads Specialist / Media Buyer who can take full ownership of our
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.



This is not a junior execution role. We are looking for someone who understands the strategy behind paid advertising, knows how to analyse campaign data, can identify what is working and what is not, and can confidently make decisions around budgets, audiences, creative testing, optimisation, and scaling.



You will be responsible for managing campaigns from strategy and setup through optimisation, reporting, and scaling, with a strong focus on generating quality leads or sales and achieving measurable business results.



We want someone who can work independently, take accountability for performance, and bring recommendations to the table rather than simply waiting for instructions.



What You'll Own

Meta Advertising Strategy

Develop and execute
 and Instagram advertising strategies based on our business and revenue goals.

Determine appropriate campaign objectives, audience strategies, budgets, offers, and testing approaches.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and scale successful campaigns.



Campaign Management

Build, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.

Manage campaigns, ad sets, audiences, placements, bidding, budgets, and creative variations.

Manage prospecting, retargeting, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and other relevant targeting strategies.

Monitor campaign performance and make data-driven optimisation decisions.



Testing & Optimisation

Test different audiences, ad creatives, ad copy, offers, landing pages, and campaign structures.

Identify winning combinations and allocate budget accordingly.

Optimise campaigns based on CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, and other relevant KPIs.



Tracking & Analytics

Set up, monitor, troubleshoot, and validate:

Meta Pixel

Conversions API (CAPI)

Conversion events

UTM/campaign tracking

Other relevant conversion tracking systems

Ensure campaign data is accurate and reliable.

Work with sales teams to understand whether generated leads are actually converting into qualified opportunities and customers.



Reporting

Provide clear weekly and monthly performance reports.

Explain what happened, why performance changed, what is working, what is not working, and what should be tested next.

Present actionable recommendations based on campaign data.



Collaboration

Work closely with designers, copywriters, sales teams, and other stakeholders to improve campaign performance.

Provide clear creative briefs and feedback based on advertising data.

Communicate campaign priorities, challenges, and opportunities proactively.



What We're Looking For



You should have:



At least 5 years of hands-on Meta Ads experience.

Proven experience managing
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

Strong practical knowledge of media buying, audience targeting, campaign structure, bidding, and optimisation.

Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets.

A proven track record of generating leads, sales, or measurable business results.

Experience scaling campaigns while maintaining acceptable CPL, CPA, ROAS, or other agreed KPIs.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Experience with conversion tracking and attribution.

The ability to work independently and take ownership of campaign performance.

Strong communication and reporting skills.



We Particularly Value Candidates Who Have:

Managed advertising for Australian businesses.

Experience with B2B, service-based businesses, lead generation, or high-ticket offers.

Experience working with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or other CRM platforms.

Experience connecting advertising performance with actual sales outcomes.

Meta advertising certifications.

Experience managing multiple campaigns or accounts simultaneously.



What Success Looks Like



Your success in this role will be measured by your ability to generate quality business results, not simply by launching campaigns.



Key performance indicators may include:



Quality and volume of leads or sales generated

Cost per qualified lead

Cost per acquisition

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), where applicable

Conversion rates

Lead-to-customer performance

Ability to identify and scale winning campaigns

Ability to control and optimise advertising spend

Accuracy of tracking and attribution

Quality and usefulness of reporting

Speed and effectiveness of optimisation decisions



What We Expect From Our Senior Media Buyer



We are looking for someone who will think like an owner.



If a campaign is underperforming, we expect you to investigate why and recommend a solution.



If a campaign is performing well, we expect you to identify opportunities to scale it.



You should be comfortable saying:



“Here is what the data is telling us, here is the problem, and here is what I recommend we do next.”



You should not need to be micromanaged to monitor campaigns, identify issues, or make optimisation recommendations.



How to Apply
