**Content Manager — Dreaver (Remote)**



We're Dreaver. We sell treadmills for the home, direct to people who want to move more without a gym membership. We run creative and ads across the Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden. Right now our content lives across a Google Drive. Notion Page and
, all has grown faster than our structure has. We need someone to fix that, and then keep it fixed and even make it better where you can!



**What you'd be doing**

- Owning our Content Drive: naming, folders, versioning, all of it. Not a one-time cleanup, an ongoing system that stays usable as more content comes in every week.

- Matching content to the task that needs it. When an editor needs footage for a specific ad, you know where it is, or you know who to ask.

- Chasing people for content. Founders, UGC creators, external partners, they don't always deliver on time or in the right format. You follow up, you don't wait to be asked twice.

- Connecting UGC, content and editors so nothing sits waiting. If an editor is blocked because a clip hasn't landed yet, that's on you to catch and fix before it becomes a delay.

- Owning deadlines across the content pipeline. Not doing the editing or the shooting yourself, but making sure everyone else's can work on their parts.



**What you bring**

Google Drive fluency: real folder architecture, not "I use Drive sometimes." You've organized shared drives for a team before, not just your own files.

A tracker mind. Whether that's Asana, Notion, Sheets or something else, you default to writing things down and following up, not remembering it in your head.

Comfortable chasing busy people for deliverables without being annoying about it. You know how to write a follow-up that gets a reply.

Written English that's clear and direct. You'll be coordinating with team members and creators across NL, DK and SE markets, so you don't need to speak those languages, but you do need to communicate clearly in English with everyone in between.



**What we love to see in you**

- You're responsible for the result, not just your tasks. See something that could be better? You pick it up.

- You don't wait around. You spot opportunities, flag problems, and act.

- No unnecessary complexity. If it can be simpler, we make it simpler.



**What we offer**

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- $800-1000 monthly, depending on your skill level

- Long-term role, not a project. Perform well and you grow with us

- A few hours of overlap with Amsterdam CET, otherwise totally flexible



**How to apply**

Send your application with the subject line in exactly this format:

[Your name] | [years managing content/drive systems] | [tool you'd default to for tracking deadlines]

Example: Maria Santos | 2 | Notion



Then in the body, answer these questions and nothing else. No CV, no cover letter, links only where asked:



1. Describe a messy shared drive or content system you inherited or built. What did you change?

2. A content deliverable was late from someone outside your control. What did you actually do?

3. Link to a folder structure, tracker, or system you built (screenshot or shared view is fine).

4. In one sentence: how do you make sure an editor never sits waiting on content that should've already arrived?



You will be skipped for: a generic CV with no answers to the questions above, no folder/tracker example, or anything that reads like it could've been sent to any company.

title: Real Estate Content & Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
Freedom Management is seeking a creative, organized, and proactive Virtual Assistant to support Andrew Freed's personal brand and the company's real estate marketing initiatives. This role combines content creation, video editing, social media management, podcast support, event coordination, and property marketing.



About the Role

Andrew Freed is a multifamily real estate investor, real estate agent, podcast host, and community builder. The person in this role will take raw ideas, videos, voice notes, property updates, and podcast content and turn them into polished, on-brand marketing assets. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing several projects at once, working independently, and following through without constant supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation & Editing

• Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts.

• Create podcast clips, captions, hooks, thumbnails, carousels, quote graphics, educational posts, and other branded assets.

• Repurpose long-form podcasts and videos into multiple platform-specific pieces of short-form content.

• Write social media captions, LinkedIn posts, short video scripts, email copy, and content outlines in Andrew's voice.

• Review all content for spelling, branding, formatting, audio quality, factual accuracy, and overall professionalism.

• Maintain consistent fonts, colors, logos, messaging, and brand standards across all materials.

• Organize raw footage, completed edits, graphics, captions, and approved final assets in clearly labeled folders.

Social Media Management

• Maintain weekly and monthly content calendars and schedule approved content through Buffer.

• Manage posting across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.

• Help launch, optimize, and manage Andrew's TikTok account.

• Adapt content for each platform rather than publishing the exact same version everywhere.

• Add captions, hashtags, tags, links, thumbnails, and clear calls to action.

• Monitor comments and direct messages and route important inquiries to the appropriate team member.

• Track basic analytics, identify high-performing topics, and recommend new content ideas.

• Confirm scheduled posts publish correctly and promptly resolve formatting, tagging, or link issues.

Podcast Support

• Research potential podcast guests and coordinate outreach, scheduling, reminders, and follow-up.

• Collect guest biographies, headshots, social links, and promotional materials.

• Prepare basic guest briefing documents and suggested interview questions.

• Coordinate with podcast editors and monitor production and publishing deadlines.

• Create episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps, social captions, and promotional clips.

• Send guests completed marketing assets when their episodes are published.

• Maintain an organized podcast guest and production tracker.

Monthly Real Estate Meetup

• Support the planning and promotion of Andrew's monthly real estate meetup.

• Contact and coordinate speakers, panelists, sponsors, vendors, and special guests.

• Collect speaker headshots, biographies, topics, and presentation materials.

• Create event graphics, social posts, email announcements, registration materials, and reminder communications.

• Build and update presentation decks, speaker introductions, agendas, sponsor slides, and run-of-show documents.

• Track registrations, maintain attendee lists, and organize event records.

• Create post-event recaps, photos, short videos, and follow-up content.

• Follow up with speakers, sponsors, and attendees after each event.

Off-Market Property Marketing

• Create professional marketing materials for off-market and listed real estate opportunities.

• Develop property flyers, one-page summaries, social graphics, email campaigns, and presentation decks.

• Organize property photos, rent rolls, financial details, maps, and investment highlights.

• Verify addresses, pricing, rents, contact information, and property details before publication.

• Coordinate with Andrew and the real estate team to obtain missing information.

• Prepare materials for social media, email lists, investor groups, and direct buyer outreach.

• Maintain a tracker of available, upcoming, under-contract, and sold properties.

Project & Team Coordination

• Track assignments, approvals, deadlines, and outstanding items across content, podcast, event, and property-marketing projects.

• Follow up when materials, decisions, or deliverables are late.

• Turn meetings and voice notes into organized tasks and action items.

• Maintain shared folders and ensure files are clearly labeled, current, and easy to locate.

• Proactively identify bottlenecks, quality concerns, and missed opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.

Weekly Reporting

Provide a concise weekly update covering:

• Content published and content currently in production.

• Upcoming podcast episodes and guest-coordination status.

• Monthly meetup progress and outstanding needs.

• Active property-marketing projects.

• Missed deadlines, bottlenecks, and items requiring Andrew's approval.

• Recommended next steps and opportunities for improvement.

Required Qualifications

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Demonstrated experience creating and editing social media content.

• Video editing experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Descript, or similar software.

• Strong Canva and presentation-design skills.

• Experience managing Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, or YouTube.

• Familiarity with Buffer or another social media scheduling platform.

• Strong organizational, project-management, and follow-up skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a backup plan for power or connectivity issues.

• Availability for partial overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting a personal brand, entrepreneur, podcast, real estate investor, brokerage, or property-management company.

• Knowledge of multifamily investing, house hacking, cash flow, NOI, cap rates, rent rolls, value-add investing, and syndications.

• Experience creating real estate flyers, offering summaries, or property-marketing packages.

• Experience coordinating podcasts, events, meetups, webinars, or speakers.

• Familiarity with Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, and project-management tools.

• Ability to turn rough ideas and raw materials into polished deliverables with minimal direction.

Ideal Candidate

You are creative but highly organized. You can edit a video, design a graphic, write a caption, coordinate a podcast guest, and keep multiple projects moving at the same time. You take ownership, communicate clearly, follow up consistently, catch mistakes before publication, and suggest improvements instead of waiting for every instruction.

Performance Expectations

• Deliver accurate, polished work by the agreed deadline.

• Respond promptly during scheduled working hours and communicate early when a deadline may be at risk.

• Maintain organized project trackers and shared folders.

• Protect confidential company, investor, tenant, and property information.

• Use sound judgment and obtain approval before publishing sensitive, financial, or property-specific information.

Application Requirements

Please submit the following:

• Resume.

• Links to social media accounts or brands you have supported.

• Two examples of short-form videos you edited.

• Two examples of graphics, carousels, property flyers, or presentations you created.

• A brief explanation of your real estate knowledge and relevant experience.

• Your weekly availability and expected overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

• Your internet speed and backup plan.

• Your desired start date.

Final candidates may be asked to complete a short paid skills assessment.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager



As our Accounting Manager, you’ll lead client engagements, manage junior staff, and ensure timely and accurate delivery of services. This is a hands-on role — from overseeing regular accounting functions to jumping into cleanup, catch-up, and system migrations when needed. You’ll balance strategic thinking with detailed execution.

Responsibilities:

Own and manage full-cycle accounting for multiple clients

Lead and execute cleanup and catch-up projects to bring client books up to date

Manage system migrations (e.g., from Xero to QuickBooks Online), including setup, mapping, and reconciliation

Review financial statements, reconciliations, and journal entries prepared by junior staff

Serve as primary client contact for accounting needs and deliverables

Maintain strong internal controls, checklists, and deadlines across accounts

Train, support, and review work from junior accountants

Collaborate with leadership on process improvements and client success

Perform ad hoc work as needed

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field; CPA is a plus

2+ years of accounting experience, including client-facing or multi-entity management

Strong experience with cleanup work, catch-up accounting, and system transitions

Advanced QuickBooks Online skills; experience with tools like Gusto, RAMP, Xero, or similar platforms

Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing shifting priorities

Excellent communicator — written, verbal, and across time zones

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote team environment

Work Terms:

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Schedule: EST Business Hours

Compensation: $1500.00/month

title: Search Specialist
description:
We're Hiring: Search Specialist (Full-Time Virtual Assistant)

Company: Entrust Housing

Location: Based in San Francisco: Looking for Remote position.

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

Schedule: Full-time | Must overlap partially with U.S. hours



Hi there!

Entrust Housing helps families who’ve experienced home disasters — like fires, floods, or storms — find temporary homes while their properties are being repaired. We work with insurance companies to quickly match families with available rental housing that fits their needs.



We’re looking for a Search Specialist VA who can take ownership of one of the most important parts of our process: finding suitable homes for displaced families.



Your Main Responsibilities:

Research and find available short-term rental properties that meet each client's needs (location, dates, budget, etc.).



Reach out to landlords and property managers to confirm availability and details.



Communicate clearly and professionally — both spoken and written — with our internal team and sometimes with property contacts.



Organize search results in spreadsheets and track follow-ups.



Help support urgent and high-stress situations with a calm, solution-focused mindset.



What We’re Looking For:

Excellent English-speaking skills — confident, clear, and professional. This is a must. ** Please do not apply unless you are fluent and comfortable speaking in English **



Strong written English for messages, summaries, and documentation.



Fast and reliable online research skills — you know how to dig, verify, and filter.



A sense of urgency and ownership — you want to get it right and get it done.



Highly organized and reliable — you never leave loose ends.



A good listener who asks smart questions when something’s unclear.



Experience in US real estate, housing platforms, or property coordination.



Why This Role Matters:

This is not just a background task — it’s the heart of what we do. You’ll be the one who helps get families housed during a crisis. The properties you find literally determine the outcome of each case. We need someone who treats this with care, urgency, and pride.



If you are interested in this role, please send a Loom video introduction of yourself.

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist: Shopify Dropshipping (UK Women's Fashion), Part-Time, 3+ Years Required
description:
Senior Customer Support Specialist: Shopify Dropshipping (UK Women's Fashion), Part-Time, 3+ Years Required



We are a growing UK women's fashion dropshipping brand on Shopify, looking for an experienced Senior Customer Support Specialist to run our customer inbox long-term. This role is for someone who already knows Shopify dropshipping support inside out, not for beginners.



Who we're looking for

Someone dependable who works independently and thinks for themselves, not someone who sends generic, AI-style replies. Every case is different. You read the situation, understand what the customer really needs, and find the solution that keeps her happy while protecting the business: a replacement or a partial refund instead of a return or a full refund, wherever that's the right call.



What you will do



Respond to customer
s: returns, refunds, partial refunds, replacements, product and delivery questions

Handle pre-purchase questions and help turn interested browsers into buyers

Look up and edit orders in Shopify, create draft orders and invoices, check tracking

Communicate with our supplier about faulty or wrong items

Reply to
 comments and messages

Follow our written handbook and use your judgment within it

Write warm, professional
s in British English (our customers are UK women aged 45+)



Schedule: split shift

You check the inbox twice a day, at 9:00 and 18:00 UK time, Monday to Saturday, and once on Sunday. Working time depends on volume: some days 2 hours, some days 8 or more. You clock in when you start and clock out when you finish (Clockify), and you are paid for actual working time.



Requirements



Minimum 3 years of
 customer support for Shopify dropshipping stores. Fashion or clothing experience strongly preferred. Please do not apply without it.

Experience with returns, refunds, partial refunds and replacements

Excellent written English

Strong attention to detail: you read the whole
 thread, open every attachment and check the order in Shopify before every reply

When unsure, you ask. You never guess.

You take direct feedback professionally

Reliable and punctual: you check in at both shifts every day, even when it's quiet

Stable internet with a backup, and backup power

Long-term commitment, with two weeks' notice on both sides



Compensation



€3.50 per hour, fixed. Please apply only if you accept this rate.

Performance bonus for consistently excellent, error-free work

Paid monthly via Wise, Revolut, PayPal or your preferred method

Room to grow with the brand as we scale



Training

For the first three days you draft replies and I review every one before it is sent. Every mistake is explained once, in writing. If the same mistake happens a second time, the trial ends.

 Once your drafts are consistently right, you handle cases independently.



How to apply

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be reviewed.



Start your application with the words "Lyra Support".

Your Shopify dropshipping customer support experience: stores or clients, niche, dates and the tools you used.

Your current workload: other clients and hours per week.

Confirm that you accept €3.50 per hour and both daily shifts.

Write your first reply, word for word, to this customer:



"Very poor quality, the product doesn't look like it does in the
 ads. Give me a refund immediately, or I'll contact Trading Standards."

title: Project Engineer
description:
Job Summary



The Project Engineer is responsible for planning, coordinating, monitoring, and ensuring the successful completion of assigned projects. The position works closely with clients, contractors, suppliers, site personnel, and management to ensure that projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and according to approved plans and quality standards.



Key Responsibilities

Plan, coordinate, and monitor project activities from start to completion.

Review project plans, drawings, specifications, and other technical documents.

Coordinate with clients, contractors, suppliers, and project personnel regarding project requirements.

Conduct regular site inspections and monitor project progress.

Ensure that construction and project activities follow approved plans, specifications, and company standards.

Monitor project schedules, materials, manpower, and equipment requirements.

Prepare and maintain project reports, progress updates, documentation, and records.

Identify project issues, delays, and potential risks and recommend appropriate solutions.

Coordinate with the engineering, purchasing, safety, and operations teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

Monitor the quality of materials and workmanship used in the project.

Ensure compliance with company safety policies and applicable regulations.

Assist in the preparation of estimates, project budgets, and material requirements when needed.

Attend project meetings and provide updates regarding project status and concerns.

Perform other duties and responsibilities assigned by management.



Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering field.

Preferably a Licensed Engineer, depending on project requirements.

With experience in project engineering, construction, or related field is an advantage.

Knowledgeable in reading and interpreting engineering plans, drawings, and specifications.

Proficient in Microsoft Office and preferably familiar with AutoCAD and other engineering software.

Good project management, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Strong communication and coordination skills.

Willing to conduct site visits and work in project locations as required.

Able to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.

Skills

Project Planning and Coordination

Site Supervision and Monitoring

Technical Documentation

Problem Solving

Quality Control

Time and Resource Management

Communication and Teamwork

Safety and Compliance

Engineering Plan and Drawing Interpretation

title: Guest Communications VA
description:
KEEP EVERY GUEST ANSWERED IN UNDER 10 MINUTES



ABOUT US

We run 5 short-term rental homes in the United States. Our guests are families and groups who expect fast, warm answers, and we want someone who takes pride in giving them that.



THE ROLE

You own guest communication for all 5 homes during your shift:

- Every guest message gets a fast, warm, correct answer

- Every guest gets their check-in details before they arrive

- Every stay ends with a review request

- Every problem reaches the right person (cleaner, repair person, or owner) and is logged the same day



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

- Average response time under 10 minutes

- Check-in messages sent on time for 100% of stays

- Review requests sent for 100% of checkouts

- 100% of guest issues logged, 90% closed within 24 hours

- The owner spends less than 1 hour a week in the guest inbox



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong written English. Clear, short, friendly messages.

- Able to work 6 PM to 2 AM US Central (7 AM to 3 PM PHT; 8 AM to 4 PM PHT after US clocks change on November 1), 5 days a week, including some weekends

- Stable internet and a quiet place to work

- Experience with Airbnb, VRBO, or a guest messaging tool (Hospitable, Guesty, OwnerRez, Hostaway) is a plus

- Learns new tools fast from a short video, without hand-holding

- Stays calm when a guest is upset and knows when to ask for help



THE PROCESS

1. Apply by
 (see below)

2. Fill out our application form (link sent to you after you apply correctly)

3. Paid practical test: up to 2 hours of real guest messages, paid at $15 per hour

4. Short video interview

5. Offer, with a start date and a 30-day review



PAY

- $3.50 USD per hour to start

- Rate reviews at 30, 60, and 90 days, based on the results above

- Paid every 2 weeks via Wise



HOW TO APPLY

 

Subject line, exactly: GUEST VA 10 - [Your Full Name]



Only
s with this exact subject line get the application form. On the form, enter your age as 40. Please read every instruction carefully. Following instructions is part of the job.

title: Walmart Marketplace Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role



Kingsbay Group is seeking a highly analytical, self-driven Walmart Marketplace Operations Specialist to join us. In this role, you will own the day-to-day execution, health, and compliance of our Walmart Marketplace storefront. As an Individual Contributor, you will be the "go-to" subject matter expert for all things Walmart and managing everything from vendor onboarding and account health to inventory coordination and listing optimization.



If you are a marketplace expert who thrives on absolute ownership and loves turning complex catalogue data into smooth, high-performing operations, we want to work with you.



Scope of Work & Deliverables



• Account Health & Compliance Management: Perform daily monitoring of Walmart account health, independently identifying platform risks and executing corrective actions to maintain account integrity.



• Vendor Onboarding & catalogue Management: Manage the end-to-end Walmart onboarding process for new vendors, delivering complete documentation coordination, listing setups, and catalogue activations.



• Listing Content Quality Control: Review and optimize Walmart product listings, variations, images, and content to ensure they consistently align with brand guidelines and platform requirements.



• Analytics & Performance Reporting: Provide regular data-driven analysis on key performance metrics, including sales trends, buy box performance, conversion rates, and fulfilment KPIs.



• Process Optimization & SOP Creation: Identify operational inefficiencies and independently develop, document, and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs) for Walmart marketplace workflows.



• Inventory Insights: Deliver Walmart-specific demand insights and forecasts to assist the Purchasing and Logistics teams in resolving inbound or replenishment friction.



• Cross-Functional Data Sharing: Coordinate autonomously with internal teams (Account Management, Logistics, Marketing, Finance) on an as-needed basis to provide data inputs and clarify platform issues.



• Customer Experience Tracking: Analyse return drivers and product review trends, executing targeted, platform-specific solutions to improve customer satisfaction metrics.







Requirements



• Proven Expertise: Minimum 2–4 years of hands-on experience independently managing Walmart Marketplace / Walmart Seller Centre.



• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Walmart’s ecosystem, including account health metrics, Buy Box dynamics, repricing strategies, and listing optimization.



• Analytical Capabilities: High proficiency in spreadsheet data analysis and turning raw marketplace KPIs into operational improvements.



• Communication: Fluent in professional written and spoken English for seamless cross-border coordination.



• Infrastructure: Must provide your own high-speed internet, computer hardware, and remote workspace software required to complete the services.

title: Canadian Immigration Processing Associate
description:
Canadian Immigration Processing Associate

Independent Contractor  |  Remote/Hybrid  |  Canada Hours



Aces Connections Consultancy Inc. is a Canadian immigration practice led by a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC), with offices in Regina, Saskatchewan and Makati. We’re engaging an independent contractor to support our clients through their immigration journey: guiding them through each step, keeping them informed, and preparing and reviewing their visa and immigration application files for clients moving to Canada.



No immigration background? We provide onboarding on our processes and the immigration programs you will handle. Strong English communication, independent research skills, attention to detail, and genuine care for clients matter most.



Engagement Details



• Independent contractor engagement, 6-month automatically renewable contract

• Monthly retainer of ₱25,000 – ₱35,000, depending on experience and the file volume you can handle

• Performance bonus per completed file

• Must be available for at least 4 hours daily within Canada (Saskatchewan) business hours, approx. 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM PHT, for client calls and team coordination. You manage the rest of your schedule. Saskatchewan doesn’t observe daylight saving, so this window stays the same all year.

• Work remotely. Our Makati office is available if you prefer to work on-site.



Scope of Work



Client care and support

• Serve as a friendly, reliable point of contact for clients by phone,
, Zoom, and messaging

• Explain document requirements and next steps clearly, so clients always know where their application stands

• Follow up with clients to collect documents and keep files moving

• Respond to client concerns with patience and professionalism, escalating to our licensed consultant when needed



Application processing

• Review client forms and documents for completeness against IRCC requirements

• Prepare application packages for final review by our licensed consultant

• Draft explanation letters, employment reference letters, and client correspondence

We work AI-first. You should already use AI features in your editing tools (for example, DaVinci Resolve Magic Mask or CapCut auto cutout) to work faster without lowering quality.

Schedule: [fill in, e.g. US Pacific Time business hours]

WHAT YOU WILL DO



Organic Social Video (about 20 hours per week)



Edit 9:16 vertical videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels using raw footage from our in-house social team and content creators.

Apply creative visual effects, including dynamic rotoscoping and masking (sticker peel effects, freeze-frame cutouts, object pop-ins), seamless jump cuts, disappearing and appearing object tricks, match cuts, native collage, paper tear, 2D sticker animations, and seamless loops built for replay value.

Time cuts, transitions, text animations, and effects precisely to the beat of the music.

Design on-screen text with a refined eye: choose and pair fonts, set clear hierarchy and spacing, keep text within platform safe zones, and animate it so it looks polished and premium, not template-based.

AI Workflow



Use AI tools throughout your workflow to speed up turnaround, such as AI masking and rotoscoping, auto captions, beat detection, and rough cut assembly, while keeping full creative control of the final edit.

Generate and edit video and visual assets with AI tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, and Claude, and blend them with live footage.



Across All Work

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

A precise sense of rhythm. Your edits land on the beat, not near it.

title: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA
description:
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis

title: Full Cycle Bookkeeper - Experienced 5 yr +
description:
Read this entire posting before applying. If you skip to the apply button, you will be rejected automatically.

I am done wasting time and money on VAs who overpromise and underdeliver. This posting is intentionally blunt so only qualified, serious candidates apply. If you do not meet ALL of the requirements below, do not apply — you will not be considered, and applications that ignore this will be deleted without a response.

Non-Negotiable Requirements — ALL of these are deal-breakers if not met:



1 -Speak and write English clearly. If you have a thick accent or are not fluent in written and spoken English, do not apply. This is an immediate disqualifier.

2 - Be an actual, hands-on expert in bookkeeping, payroll, and HR administration. I use QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core for inventory/COGS, QBO for AP, and QBO for payroll. If you claim experience with these tools and then have to Google how to do basic tasks once hired, this is an immediate disqualifier. You will be tested before hire — see below.

3 - Explain things simply. I am not an accountant. If I ask you a question and you can't break it down in plain language I understand right away, do not apply. I need someone who translates the technical into the simple, not someone who talks over my head.

4 - Follow instructions exactly. I have had VAs guess at what I wanted, get "creative," do work I never asked for, and then expect to be paid for it. This happens ONCE and we're done. I am open to your suggestions on better ways to do things — but only with my approval before you act. Suggest, don't assume.

5 - Do not pad your hours. I know roughly how long tasks take, and I am generous about it. If I see 15-minute tasks billed as multi-hour tasks, my generosity disappears immediately and so does the job.

6 - Show up on time, every time. I understand life happens — tell me in advance and I will be understanding. Chronic lateness or last-minute excuses (storms, internet outages, etc., without advance notice) will end this immediately. One strike.

7 - We pay via Payoneer ONLY. No exceptions. If you don't have a Payoneer account or can't set one up, do not apply. This is nonnegotiable — no PayPal, no Wise, no bank transfer, no other method.

8 - We track time using Timeproof. Mandatory, no exceptions. If you are not willing to use Timeproof for every hour billed, do not apply. This is not up for discussion.

9 - Meetings are professional — no children visible or audible on camera. These are leadership meetings. My team does not bring kids into the office, and I expect the same from you. Have children asleep, at school, or with another caregiver during our scheduled meeting times. If a child is on camera or heard in the background, the meeting will end.

10 - If I call you during paid hours, you answer. Period. No exceptions, no "I saw it but was busy." If you're on the clock, you're reachable.



What You'll Be Doing:



Full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction coding, reconciliations, AP/AR

Inventory and COGS tracking and reconciliation in Cin7 Core

Vendor bill capture, approval routing, and payment processing through or QBO

Payroll support and coordination through Paylocity

HR administrative support — onboarding documentation, recordkeeping, basic compliance tasks

Monthly financial reporting to ownership



Application Instructions — Read Carefully:



To prove you read this far, start your application with the word LEDGER in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.

Confirm in your application that you have a Payoneer account, are willing to use Timeproof for every hour worked, can keep meetings child-free, and will answer calls during paid hours. If you don't confirm all four, your application will be skipped.

Include your specific hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and/or Cin7 Core — not "familiar with," actual experience.

Include your available start date and your hourly rate expectation.

Be prepared to complete a short paid skills test before any offer is made.



This is a long-term, part-time position for the right person, with room to grow. If you meet every requirement above and can prove it, I want to hear from you. If you don't, please save us both the time.

title: Contractor Network Development VA – Performance-Based
description:
Booked Services Pro (BSP) is a growing U.S. home-services platform connecting homeowners, general contractors, and specialty contractors.



We are looking for a motivated VA to help us develop relationships with home-service contractors in the U.S.



This is a **performance-based opportunity**, not a traditional hourly VA position. It is best suited for someone with experience in sales, appointment setting, prospecting, cold outreach, recruiting, or business development who is comfortable being rewarded based on results.



### What You’ll Do



* Research and identify home-service contractors in assigned markets

* Contact contractors through approved outreach channels

* Introduce contractors to Booked Services Pro

* Explain how BSP works and answer basic questions

* Help interested contractors complete the signup process

* Follow up with prospects

* Maintain accurate prospect and contractor information

* Build relationships with contractors you personally develop

* Work independently and consistently toward measurable results



You will receive the BSP process, messaging, training, and tools needed to do the work.



### Compensation



This is a **performance-based role**.



BSP currently provides milestone-based compensation for qualifying contractor development, including payments for:



* Qualified contractor signup

* Contractor activation

* Contractor remaining active

* First qualifying paid project



There is also an opportunity to earn **ongoing recurring compensation from contractors you personally develop**, based on BSP's collected completed-project fees and applicable performance requirements.



The more successful your contractor network becomes, the greater your potential earnings.



This is not an hourly position, and income is not guaranteed. We are looking for people who are motivated by performance and long-term earning potential.



### Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you have experience with:



* Sales

* Appointment setting

* B2B outreach

* Cold calling

* Lead generation/prospecting

* Recruiting

* Customer acquisition

* Social media outreach

* Business development



Experience working with U.S. businesses is a plus.



**Home-services, construction, real-estate, or B2B sales experience is especially valuable.**



We are more interested in your ability to communicate, follow up, build relationships, and produce results than in having a specific degree.



### Ideal Candidate



* Strong English communication

* Confident communicating with U.S. business owners

* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

* Persistent without being pushy

* Organized with follow-up

* Comfortable with performance-based compensation

* Interested in building something long-term rather than simply completing VA tasks



If you're looking for a traditional hourly administrative VA position, this probably isn't the right opportunity.



If you enjoy sales, outreach, and building relationships—and want the opportunity to earn based on the business you help develop—we'd like to hear from you.

title: Content Publishing Specialist (WordPress/Sanity)
description:
Position: Content Publishing Specialist

Employment Type: 2 month Gig (to start)

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Minimum 50% overlap with Eastern Time (ET) business hours

Experience Level: Junior to Intermediate (1–3+ years preferred)



- About the Role



We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Content Publishing Specialist to join our digital marketing team.



This is a high-volume, production-focused role responsible for publishing website content accurately, efficiently, and consistently across multiple client websites using WordPress (Elementor) and Sanity CMS.



The ideal candidate has an exceptional eye for detail, understands what makes a webpage look professional, and can follow established publishing processes while applying foundational SEO best practices.



This is not primarily a content writing or SEO strategy position. Your responsibility will be to take prepared content and turn it into polished, properly formatted, SEO-friendly webpages that are ready for visitors and search engines.



Training, publishing guidelines, templates, and checklists will be provided. However, previous experience working with WordPress, Elementor, and/or Sanity CMS is strongly preferred.



- Key Responsibilities



Content Publishing & Page Formatting



Publish a high volume of blog posts, landing pages, and other website content.



Work within WordPress (including Elementor) and Sanity CMS.



Format content to match established website templates and design standards.



Ensure pages are visually appealing, consistent, and professional across desktop and mobile devices.



Properly format headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, buttons, and other page elements.



Add and optimise images, including sizing, alignment, compression, and descriptive alt text.



Identify and correct layout issues, formatting inconsistencies, broken elements, and visual errors.



Ensure published pages accurately reflect the approved content provided.



- Foundational SEO Implementation



Apply basic on-page SEO best practices to every published page, including:



Entering accurate, optimised SEO title tags and meta descriptions.



Correctly formatting H1, H2, H3, and other heading levels.



Adding relevant internal links using appropriate anchor text.



Ensuring external links are correctly placed and functional.



Checking URL slugs and page structure.



Adding image alt text where appropriate.



Applying appropriate categories, tags, and other CMS fields.



Following provided SEO instructions, content briefs, and publishing checklists.



Identifying obvious SEO issues and escalating them to the appropriate team member.



Advanced SEO knowledge is not required. We will provide training on our publishing standards and SEO processes.



Quality Assurance & Workflow Management



Thoroughly review each page before publishing.



Check desktop and mobile layouts for visual consistency.



Verify links, headings, images, spacing, and formatting.



Catch spelling errors, missing content, formatting mistakes, and inconsistencies.



Manage repetitive publishing tasks while maintaining a consistently high standard of quality.



Follow documented workflows and meet daily or weekly publishing targets.



Track progress and communicate any publishing blockers or issues.



Incorporate feedback quickly and avoid repeating previously identified mistakes.



- What We're Looking For / Required Qualifications



Experience publishing and formatting content in a CMS, preferably WordPress with Elementor or Sanity.



Exceptional attention to detail and strong visual judgment.



Ability to recognise when a page looks polished versus when something is misaligned, inconsistent, or poorly formatted.



Familiarity with basic on-page SEO principles, including title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, and internal linking.



Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage high volumes of repetitive work.



Ability to follow detailed instructions and established procedures consistently.



Comfortable working independently and maintaining productivity without constant supervision.



Strong written English comprehension and communication skills.



Availability to work at least 50% of working hours overlapping with Eastern Time (ET) business hours.



- Preferred Qualifications



Hands-on experience with both WordPress (Elementor) and Sanity CMS.



Experience publishing SEO-focused blog posts and commercial landing pages.



Familiarity with common WordPress SEO plugins such as Yoast SEO or Rank Math.



Basic understanding of HTML and CSS.



Experience using project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or similar.



Experience working with an SEO or digital marketing agency.



- Who Will Succeed in This Role?



This position is particularly well suited to someone who:



Notices the small things. You catch inconsistent spacing, incorrect headings, missing links, and poorly cropped images that others overlook.



Enjoys structured, repetitive work. You are comfortable publishing many pages each week while maintaining accuracy and quality.



Takes pride in presentation. You care about the final appearance of every webpage, even when the task seems routine.



Works efficiently. You can move through a publishing queue quickly without sacrificing quality.



Follows processes. You understand the importance of consistency across multiple websites and client projects.



Learns quickly. You are comfortable learning new CMS platforms, templates, and publishing requirements.



- Training & Support



We provide onboarding and training covering:



Our publishing standards and quality assurance checklists.



WordPress, Elementor, and Sanity workflows specific to our client websites.



Baseline on-page SEO requirements.



Internal linking guidelines and content formatting standards.



Page design consistency and mobile responsiveness.



Production targets, task tracking, and escalation procedures.



While training is provided, candidates should already be comfortable navigating content management systems and publishing website content.



- Performance Expectations



Success will be measured primarily through:



Publishing accuracy: Pages are published correctly with minimal errors or revisions.



Visual quality: Pages are clean, consistent, and professional on desktop and mobile.



SEO compliance: Required metadata, headings, links, and SEO fields are completed accurately.



Productivity: Consistent achievement of publishing volume targets.



Reliability: Tasks are completed on schedule with clear communication and minimal supervision.



The expectation is to deliver both high output and high quality, rather than prioritising speed at the expense of accuracy.



- How to Apply / Please submit:



Your resume, including relevant CMS experience.



A brief description of your experience with WordPress, Elementor, and/or Sanity.



Examples of webpages or blog posts you have personally published or formatted.



Your location, time zone, and availability to overlap with Eastern Time business hours.



What matters most: We are looking for someone who can publish content repeatedly, accurately, and efficiently — and who takes pride in making every page look right, down to the smallest detail.

title: SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required
description:
We're Recruiting a SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required



Company: Allied Health Media

Job Type: Full-time

Work Setup: Remote

Working Hours: Mon-Sat / 9AM-6PM UK time


 



About Allied Health Media



Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



About the Role



As our SEO Specialist, you'll own the organic search performance of a portfolio of client websites, most of them in healthcare. That means running full technical and on-page audits, catching crawling, indexing, and architecture issues before they hurt rankings, and keeping Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site health in good shape. You'll turn findings into clear, actionable tasks for developers and content teams, then verify the fixes actually landed correctly on the live site — not just take someone's word for it. You'll also track performance through GA4 and Search Console, investigate unusual traffic or ranking shifts, and report on what's working, what isn't, and what should happen next. Because our clients operate in healthcare, you'll need to apply extra care and sound judgement around medical content accuracy, not just chase quick wins.



Do Not Apply If...



You rely solely on automated tool scores instead of professional judgement

You don't follow through to confirm that requested fixes were actually implemented correctly

You're uncomfortable explaining technical SEO issues to non-technical team members

You cut corners on accuracy, especially with medical/healthcare content

You need close supervision to manage multiple client websites and priorities

You're not comfortable learning new SEO tools and platforms.

You don't have a background or practical experience in web development.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, covering crawling, indexing, rendering, and site architecture.

Review and optimise XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and URL structures.

Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.

Review and troubleshoot structured data and schema markup.

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and performance issues, and investigate unusual changes.

Support website migrations, redesigns, and staging-to-live launches.

Optimise on-page elements — titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.

Identify duplicate, thin, or competing pages and recommend consolidation or redirection.

Review and QA completed SEO and development work across desktop, tablet, and mobile before sign-off.

Retest and verify that requested fixes have been implemented correctly on the live site.

Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions via GA4, and prepare clear performance reports.

Coordinate with developers, designers, and content teams — writing clear, actionable SEO tasks.

Apply extra care, accuracy, and professional judgement when working with healthcare and medical content.



Skills and Tools Required



At least two years of practical SEO experience.

Strong knowledge of technical SEO and on-page optimisation.

Experience conducting detailed website audits and prioritising fixes by impact.

Understanding of crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, and URL structures.

Experience with structured data/schema markup and Core Web Vitals.

Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Experience working with developers and verifying completed fixes.

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues simply.

Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

Experience with SEO platforms such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush.

Familiarity with PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse, Looker Studio, and schema validation tools.



Compensation



We offer a competitive, performance-based package tailored to your experience and track record, with room to grow as you take on more client responsibility. This is a long-term opportunity with a stable, growing agency — not a short-term contract — and we reward accuracy, reliability, and great work with real career progression.



Why Join Us?



Work across a real portfolio of client websites, including meaningful healthcare projects where your work genuinely matters.

Join a fast-growing team where your audits and recommendations directly shape client results.

Flexible, remote-friendly setup with a supportive, collaborative team culture.

Room to grow into more senior SEO or strategy roles as the company scales.

Exposure to a variety of tools, platforms, and industries — never the same day twice.

A team that values professional judgement, accuracy, and follow-through over vanity metrics.





Ready to Join a Fast-Growing Team?

If you take pride in thorough audits, clear recommendations, and following through until it's actually fixed, we'd love to hear from you. Apply below and show us what you can do.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

title: Virtual Assistant - Scheduling Coordinator & Staffing Fulfillment
description:
Sunflower Childcare Substitutes is seeking a dependable and detail-oriented part-time Scheduling Coordinator to manage the scheduling work behind our childcare staffing services.



Your primary responsibility is to fill open shifts and quickly refill shifts when substitutes cancel. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with schedules, spreadsheets, and detailed information, and can keep everything accurate as priorities change.



We’re looking for an organized problem-solver who follows through, works independently, and stays focused in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.

Responsibilities



Review staffing requests and enter complete, accurate shift information in Avionté.

Match available substitutes to center needs using internal procedures and best-fit guidelines.

Post open shifts, send availability requests, and follow up with substitutes to secure coverage.

Prioritize same-day requests, urgent openings, and call off replacements.

Cancel and repost shifts when needed, then actively work to refill them.

Confirm substitute availability and assignment details before marking shifts as filled.

Check required compliance documentation before placing a substitute, including background checks, fingerprints, and CPR/First Aid.

Maintain accurate schedules, substitute records, assignment notes, and status updates.

Build and maintain spreadsheets that track requests, filled and unfilled shifts, cancellations, and staffing hours.

Use formulas, filters, sorting, lookups, and conditional formatting to organize information and identify gaps or errors.

Review upcoming schedules to catch open shifts, conflicts, and missing information.

Give the Customer Service Coordinator timely, accurate updates so centers receive clear communication.

Maintain clear handoff notes so both team members know what is filled, pending, or needs follow-up.



Qualifications



Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, conditional formatting, and working with multiple sheets.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy with names, dates, times, and scheduling information.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple open requests.

Persistent follow-through and a proactive approach to filling shifts.

Ability to reprioritize quickly when cancellations or urgent needs arise.

Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly with substitutes and teammates.

Comfortable learning scheduling systems and digital tools.

Experience in staffing or scheduling is strongly preferred; Avionté experience is a plus.



Requirements

Your own computer with Microsoft Windows 11 or newer.

Reliable electricity & high-speed internet and the ability to use Google Meet.

A quiet, dedicated workspace.

Willingness to review training videos, learn our systems, and follow established procedures.

Dependable availability during your assigned hours.

title: Data Entry

## Monthly Grand Strand Event Calendar Assistant



VRMB Owner Direct is looking for a reliable person to help keep our **Myrtle Beach and Grand Strand Events Calendar** current each month.



This is a small, ongoing monthly gig that can be completed remotely and on your own schedule.



### What You’ll Do



Each month, you will research upcoming events throughout the **Grand Strand of South Carolina**, specifically:



- Cherry Grove

- North Myrtle Beach

- Little River

- Myrtle Beach

- Carolina Forest

- Surfside Beach

- Garden City

- Murrells Inlet

- Pawleys Island



### Where to Find Events



You will actively research events using:



-
 Events and local social media pages

- Official city and town websites

- Local Chamber of Commerce event calendars

- Local tourism and community event calendars

- Convention, festival, entertainment, and venue calendars

- Other reputable local sources



Do not rely on just one website. The goal is to find a good variety of events happening throughout the Grand Strand.



### Events to Include



Look for events that would be useful or interesting to both visitors and locals, including festivals, concerts, live entertainment, farmers markets, family activities, sporting events, holiday celebrations, food and drink events, car and motorcycle events, community events, and other major local happenings.



For each event, you will add the **event name, date, time, location, town, brief description, and event/source link** when available.



Information should be verified for accuracy before being entered, and duplicate events should not be added.



### Monthly Expectation



The calendar should include events from **across the Grand Strand rather than concentrating only on Myrtle Beach**.



The expectation is a **minimum of 20 quality events each month**, with additional major events added when appropriate. We value accurate and relevant events over simply adding events to reach a number.



### Pay



**$10 per month**



This is a small monthly assignment, not a traditional part-time position. Once the monthly research and calendar update are completed, the assignment is finished until the next month.



What We’re Looking For



You should be dependable, comfortable researching information online and through social media, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.



We will provide guidance on the geographic area and the types of events we want included.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
# Construction Production Virtual Assistant — Full-Time



**Allstate Exteriors & Restoration** is hiring a virtual assistant to support our Production Manager and production team. We manage a high volume of roofing and exterior projects and need someone who can keep job information current, follow up on missing items, and help us catch problems early.



**Schedule:** Full-time, Monday–Friday, with working hours that overlap ** 6:30a.m.–6:30 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time**.



## What you will do



- Review active jobs in **CompanyCam** each day for required photos, completed checklists, progress updates, and documented issues.

- Follow up with project managers and subcontractors when photos or updates are missing.

- Maintain a list of approved jobs waiting to be scheduled, including each job’s blocker, owner, next action, and follow-up date.

- Check upcoming jobs for missing crew, material, customer, permit, or scheduling information and alert the appropriate coordinator.

- Track completed jobs that still need photos, paperwork, walkthrough information, or other items before invoicing.

- Prepare a concise morning report of jobs needing a decision and an afternoon report of unresolved issues.

- Enter accurate, verified notes and task updates in our systems. We use **CompanyCam, Zoho, and AccuLynx**.



You will help the team stay organized and accountable. Project coordinators make scheduling commitments; project managers own field execution and job quality; the Production Manager makes operational decisions. You will make sure missing information reaches the right person promptly.



## You may be a good fit if you



- Have experience supporting construction, roofing, home services, or project management teams.

- Are highly organized and comfortable following up with people repeatedly and professionally.

- Can review dozens of jobs without losing track of details.

- Write clear English and can turn a complicated situation into a short, useful update.

- Are comfortable learning software and following detailed processes.

- Can work independently during U.S. Eastern business hours.



Experience with CompanyCam, Zoho, AccuLynx, or similar construction software is a plus.



## What success looks like



Every active job has a current status and the required photo checklist. Missing updates are followed up the same day. Jobs waiting to be scheduled have a documented next action. Completed jobs move promptly toward invoicing. Our Production Manager receives a short list of exceptions and decisions instead of having to search through every job.



## To apply



Please send your résumé and a short explanation of your construction or project coordination experience. Also answer this question:



**A project manager says a job is complete, but CompanyCam has no final photos and the customer walkthrough is not documented. What would you do next, and what would you include in your update to the Production Manager?**

title: Senior AI Ecommerce Designer, Amazon Listings and Ads
description:
ABOUT US



We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners like Petco and Costco. We are looking for a Senior AI Ecommerce Designer to own the images that sell those products.



Your work d
 whether a shopper clicks and whether they buy. You will design Amazon and Chewy listing images, A+ Content, Brand Stories, storefronts, marketplace assets, Amazon ad creative, and landing pages. We measure your work by click-through rate and conversion rate, not by how it looks in a portfolio.



This role is for a designer who already uses AI every day. You will combine Photoshop and Illustrator with generative AI tools to concept, stage, and composite photorealistic product images in hours, not weeks. We need speed and volume, but neither is an excuse for generic work.



Pay: USD 1,500-2,000 per month

Schedule: US PST

Reports to: Creative Director, who sets weekly priorities. You will work closely with our Video Editor, Social Media Manager, and brand managers.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF



AI is not already part of your daily design workflow. This is a requirement.

Your work depends on templates, Canva layouts, or stock mockups.

You submit raw AI generations without retouching and compositing.

You need a week to deliver what a strong AI workflow can deliver in a day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Marketplace Assets



Design Amazon main images that follow Amazon’s white background and product fill rules while standing out in search results.

Build full secondary image sets: benefit infographics, feature callouts, size charts, comparison charts, materials and ingredient visuals, lifestyle scenes, and in-use images.

Design Premium A+ and standard A+ modules, Brand Story carousels, and Brand Storefront pages.

Create Chewy listing images and rich content to Chewy’s specs.

Adapt assets for Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and retail partner requirements.

Design mobile-first. Every image must read clearly at thumbnail size on a phone.

Deliver multiple variations of main images and A+ Content for split testing, and use the results to shape the next round.

Audit and refresh underperforming listings using click-through and conversion data from the brand managers.



Amazon Ads and Landing Pages



Design Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, Amazon Posts, and seasonal, deal, and promo graphics.

Deliver ad variations for testing and refresh creative as performance data comes in.

Design landing pages and Shopify product pages as full desktop and mobile mockups, with exported assets ready for our Shopify team to build.

Keep messaging and visuals consistent from ad to listing to landing page.



AI Workflow and Compositing



Use generative AI to explore several creative directions quickly before committing to one.

Generate photorealistic lifestyle scenes (homes, yards, apartments, balconies, pets in real settings) and composite our real products into them with correct lighting, shadows, perspective, scale, and color.

Replace, extend, and clean up backgrounds using Photoshop Generative Fill, Firefly, Flux, or similar tools.

Upscale and enhance images with Magnific or similar tools without adding artifacts.

Fix AI errors before anything ships: pet anatomy, paws, eyes, fur edges, warped geometry, garbled text, and incorrect product details.

Work from any source assets we have (studio photos, supplier images, 3D files, basic product shots) and flag when a reshoot is needed.

Build and maintain prompt libraries, style references, and scene templates to keep output consistent across brands.

Test new AI tools as they launch and recommend the ones that make the team faster or better.



Brand Consistency and Compliance



Keep each brand visually distinct while following its typography, color, and tone guidelines.

Keep products accurate in every image. AI must never change the size, color, texture, components, or packaging of what the customer receives.

Follow Amazon, Chewy, Walmart, and TikTok Shop image and content policies, including rules on claims, badges, and comparisons.

Use only product claims approved by the brand managers.

Use only AI tools and assets licensed for commercial use.

Keep organized, layered source files with clear naming and version control in our shared drive.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Design Fundamentals



4+ years of professional graphic design experience, with at least 2 years designing Amazon listing images and A+ Content.

Expert-level Photoshop and Illustrator, including advanced masking, color matching, compositing, and high-end retouching.

Strong typography. You pair fonts with intention, build clear hierarchy, and avoid generic or dated type.

Strong command of layout, grids, color, and visual hierarchy, including desktop and mobile landing pages.

Ability to turn a product benefit into a visual a shopper understands in 3 seconds, without a wall of text.

Working knowledge of what drives marketplace conversion: scannable benefits, objection handling, comparison framing, and image sequence.

Clear written English for on-image copy and daily work with a US-based team.



AI Prompting and Retouching



At least 1 year of daily, hands-on use of generative AI in professional design work.

Fluency with Midjourney, Photoshop Generative Fill and Firefly, Flux, Magnific, or similar tools.

Ability to control AI output: style and image references, inpainting and outpainting, seeds, and pose or composition control.

Ability to composite real products into AI scenes so the final image reads as a real photo.

A trained eye for AI artifacts and the retouching skill to fix them.

Ability to explain your workflow step by step and how much time AI saves you at each stage.



Nice to Have



Pet product or consumer packaged goods experience.

Experience with Amazon split testing (Manage Your Experiments), Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, or reading click-through and conversion data.

3D rendering experience (Blender, KeyShot, or similar).

Basic motion or video skills to support our Video Editor.

Figma experience for templates and design systems.



PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS



Applications without a portfolio that includes ALL of the following will not be reviewed:



At least 2 complete Amazon listing image sets (main image plus full secondary carousel) that you designed.

At least 1 full A+ or Premium A+ Content project showing the complete module stack.

At least 1 landing page or ecommerce product page design, shown for desktop and mobile.

At least 3 before-and-after AI compositing examples. For each, show the original source photo, the raw AI generation, and your final image, with a short note on tools used and time spent.

Results where available, such as click-through or conversion lift or a split test outcome. If you are under NDA, explain what you changed and why.

Your role on each project: sole designer, lead, or part of a team.



Live Amazon or Chewy product links are welcome. Portfolios built mainly on templates, stock mockups, or unedited AI output will not move forward.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



A link to your portfolio (Google Drive, Behance, or personal site). Make sure the link is set to public.

A short note on which piece in your portfolio you are most proud of and why.

Start your message with the words “SCROLL STOPPER” so we know you read the full post.



Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed.
