title: Website Development
description:
# Full-Stack Website Developer – Modern, Fast, SEO-Focused, AI-Ready Roofing Websites (Long-Term)



We are an established roofing and solar company based in Vancouver, Canada. I'm looking for an experienced website developer to build a new website and hopefully continue working with us as we expand.



We've been in business since 2008 and have a substantial collection of completed roofing projects, photographs and industry experience.



I'm not looking for a basic template website. I want to invest in building something properly that will remain modern, fast, easy to manage and adaptable as AI technology continues to develop.



**We're moving away from WordPress.** I'm particularly interested in modern technologies such as Next.js, Astro and Sanity CMS, although I'm open to other non-WordPress recommendations if you can explain why they're better for our needs.



I'm not a developer myself, so I'm looking for someone who can recommend the right approach, explain it in straightforward language and help us make good long-term decisions.



## The Bigger Picture



Our first project will be a new website for West Vancouver Roofing & Solar.



However, this is not intended to be a one-website project.



My longer-term goal is to develop additional roofing businesses and websites in different locations.



Each business will have its own branding, domain, local presence, projects and unique content.



I want the first website built on a reusable foundation so that future websites can share the underlying technology and components without having to rebuild everything from scratch.



The websites must still operate as separate brands with their own content, SEO, tracking and appropriate access controls.



## Website Performance



The website needs to be exceptionally fast, especially on mobile devices.



I want clean development, optimized images and videos, minimal unnecessary JavaScript, appropriate caching and excellent Core Web Vitals.



Speed should be considered throughout development, not something we try to fix after the website is finished.



## SEO From the Beginning



SEO is extremely important to us, particularly local SEO.



We want the website structured properly from the start, including:



- Roofing service and material pages

- City and neighbourhood pages

- Completed roofing projects

- Detailed case studies

- Logical internal linking

- Clean URLs and metadata

- Appropriate schema and structured data

- Image optimization

- XML sitemaps, canonical URLs and redirects

- Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools



I don't want hundreds of nearly identical location pages created just to target keywords.



Our location pages should be supported by actual projects, photographs, case studies and useful information relevant to those areas.



I also want the website prepared for how people increasingly find businesses through ChatGPT, Google AI and other AI-powered search tools.



I'm not expecting anyone to guarantee rankings or AI recommendations. I want a technically sound website with useful, original content based on our actual experience.



## Roofing Projects and Case Studies



We have approximately 200 project photos and 20 videos available initially, with more being added regularly.



Our work includes:



- Standing-seam and other metal roofing

- Asphalt shingles

- Cedar roofing and cedar replacement

- Composite and synthetic roofing

- Flat roofing, including TPO and torch-on

- Skylights

- Solar installations

- Complex and unusual roofing projects



I want a structured project library that makes it easy to add and organize completed jobs.



A project could include its location, roof type, manufacturer, materials, colour, existing conditions, challenges, solutions, photographs, videos and customer reviews.



**The important part is that we should only have to enter the project once.**



The website should then automatically connect that project to the appropriate service, material, neighbourhood, gallery and case-study pages.



Our case studies should go beyond displaying photographs. They should explain the original problem, the options considered, why we recommended a particular roofing system, what was installed and the results.



Over time, I want our websites to become valuable resources built around real roofing experience.



## AI-Assisted Website Management



This is one of my most important requirements.



I want AI integrated into the way we manage and improve our websites, not simply used by the developer to write code.



**Our office staff should be able to manage routine website content without knowing how to program.**



For example, an employee should be able to upload photos and basic details from a completed roofing job, then have AI help:



- Draft the project description and case study

- Suggest appropriate photo descriptions

- Prepare SEO titles and descriptions

- Recommend relevant services and neighbourhoods

- Suggest internal links

- Identify missing information

- Prepare the project for review and publishing



We would review and approve AI-generated content before it goes live.



I also want staff to be able to make ordinary changes, such as editing text, replacing photographs and updating information, through a simple dashboard.



There must be a manual editing option as well, so we're not dependent on AI for every change.



I don't expect every advanced AI feature to be completed immediately. However, I want the underlying system designed for these capabilities, and I'd like applicants to explain what can realistically be included in the initial build.



Ideally, the system will support different employee permissions, an approval process and simple training for new staff.



## CallRail, Analytics and Lead Tracking



We want to properly track where our customers come from.



This includes CallRail, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and appropriate tracking for calls, contact forms and quote requests.



We want to understand which leads originate from Google organic search, Google Business Profile, paid advertising, Bing, social media, referrals and other sources.



CallRail Dynamic Number Insertion must be implemented correctly without compromising our business phone numbers or local SEO.



Eventually, I'd like to connect our marketing data to estimates and completed jobs.



The goal is to understand:



**Where the customer found us → which page they visited → whether they called or submitted a form → estimate → sold job**



I'm more interested in measuring actual business results than simply reporting website traffic.



## Lead Generation



The website should be designed to turn visitors into customers.



We need professional, mobile-friendly contact forms, quote request forms, click-to-call buttons and clear calls to action.



Forms must be reliable, properly tracked and protected against spam without making them frustrating for legitimate customers.



## Long-Term Management and Expansion



I'm looking for someone interested in an ongoing working relationship.



After launch, there will be opportunities to improve SEO, develop new features, monitor performance, improve conversions, refine AI workflows and help launch additional roofing websites.



However, I don't want the business to depend on a developer for routine content updates.



The goal is to have a system that is sophisticated behind the scenes but easy for our employees to operate.



## Security, Ownership and Documentation



The website must have appropriate security, backups and a staging environment for testing changes.



Our company must own and control the domains, hosting, source code, content, photographs, CMS, analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager, CallRail and other important accounts.



The project must also be properly documented so another qualified developer can maintain it if necessary.



I don't want to be locked into one developer or an unnecessarily complicated proprietary system.



## Working Hours and Communication



We are located in Vancouver, Canada.



You can work your normal hours in the Philippines, but you must consistently be available between **8:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. Vancouver time on working days**.



Outside that window, your schedule can generally be flexible.



Good communication is important. I want someone who can explain recommendations clearly, raise concerns and help solve problems rather than simply waiting for instructions.



## When You Apply



Please put **ROOFING 2027** at the top of your application.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Would you recommend Next.js, Astro or another non-WordPress platform for this project? Why?



2. Which content-management system would you recommend, and how easy would it be for nontechnical office employees to use?



3. How would you build AI-assisted content management so an employee could upload project photos and details and have AI prepare a draft for review?



4. Have you personally built an AI workflow that creates or updates content in a website or CMS? Please explain what you built.



5. How would you make the website extremely fast, especially on mobile?



6. How would you build technical and local SEO into the website from the beginning?



7. How would you organize roofing services, materials, projects, case studies and neighbourhoods so they automatically connect to one another?



8. How would you build the first website so we can efficiently launch additional independently branded roofing websites using the same underlying system?



9. Have you worked with CallRail, GA4 and Google Tag Manager? Please explain your actual hands-on experience.



10. How would you track calls and form submissions back to their marketing sources and eventually connect them to estimates and sold jobs?



11. What would you do differently today to prepare a website for AI-powered search?



12. Please provide three websites or systems you've personally developed, explain exactly what you did and identify which technologies you used. I'd particularly like to see examples involving structured content, modern frameworks or AI integrations.



13. What tools do you use to test website speed, technical SEO and overall quality?



14. What would you include in the initial launch, and what would you recommend developing afterward?



15. What is your hourly rate in USD, and approximately how long would you expect the initial website to take?



16. Are you interested in maintaining and improving the system after launch, including helping us develop additional websites?



17. Please confirm you can consistently overlap with our working hours between 8:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. Vancouver time.



I'm not necessarily looking for the cheapest developer. I'm willing to pay more for someone who is genuinely skilled, reliable, communicates well and can demonstrate strong work.



I'm looking for someone who can help guide this project and hopefully work with us for years.



If you think there's a better way to accomplish what I'm describing, I'm interested in hearing your recommendations.



Thanks,



Doug

, and text, and run the first-contact call to understand the family's care needs

title: Full-Time Performance Video Editor — DTC / E-Commerce Ads
description:
We are looking for a full-time Performance Video Editor to join our team and help us create direct-response ads for our DTC brands.



This is not a role for someone who only knows how to make videos look nice.



We are looking for someone who understands that the purpose of an ad is to grab attention, keep people watching, communicate the message clearly, and drive action.



If you enjoy studying ads, improving hooks, testing different angles, working with UGC, finding the right B-roll, and continuously making your edits better, this could be a good fit.



This is a long-term remote position with opportunities to grow as the company grows.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be editing performance creatives for platforms such as Meta.



You will:



Edit short-form direct-response video ads



Edit UGC-style creatives



Edit longer-form ads and VSL-style creatives



Create strong hooks for the first few seconds



Improve pacing and retention throughout the video



Add captions, graphics, sound effects and pattern interrupts when needed



Find relevant B-roll and supporting footage



Work with raw UGC footage



Work with AI-generated images and video



Create different variations of winning ads



Recreate proven concepts in an original way for our brands



Follow scripts, briefs and reference ads closely



Make revisions based on feedback



Continuously improve creatives based on what is working



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone with experience in:



DTC / e-commerce video ads



Direct-response advertising



UGC-style creatives



Meta ads



Short-form advertising



Video sales letters or longer-form ads



You should have a good understanding of:



Hooks



Pacing



Retention



Visual storytelling



B-roll selection



Pattern interrupts



Captions



Direct-response marketing



We especially want someone who tries to understand why an ad works, instead of simply following instructions without thinking.



Tools



You should be comfortable using video editing software such as:



CapCut



Adobe Premiere Pro



Or similar editing software



Experience with AI tools is also a big advantage, including tools such as:



ElevenLabs



HeyGen



Gemini



Nano Banana



AI image-generation tools



AI video-generation tools



You do not need to know every tool already.



However, you must be comfortable learning new tools quickly.



Who This Role Is NOT For



This position is probably not for you if most of your experience is editing:



Wedding videos



Gaming videos



Cinematic montages



Music videos



Generic social-media content



We are specifically looking for someone interested in becoming very good at performance creative and direct-response advertising.



What We Value



We value people who are:



Reliable



Detail-oriented



Fast learners



Good communicators



Able to follow instructions closely



Comfortable receiving feedback



Able to meet deadlines



Interested in marketing



Constantly trying to improve their work



Able to work independently without needing constant supervision



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position, not someone looking for a temporary freelance project.



Compensation



Starting compensation:



$4–$6/hour depending on experience and skill level.



On top of your base pay, we also offer performance bonuses for winning creatives.



If a creative you edit becomes a winner and scales while maintaining our performance targets, you can earn:



$5,000 ad spend → $10 bonus



$10,000 ad spend → $20 bonus



$20,000 ad spend → $40 bonus



$30,000 ad spend → $50 bonus



$50,000 ad spend → $100 bonus



The bonus is based on the highest spend milestone reached by each creative.



For example:



If your creative reaches $20,000 in spend, the total bonus for that creative is $40.



The milestones are not added together.



We want our editors to benefit when their work performs well.



The better your creatives become and the more winning ads you help us produce, the more opportunities you will have to increase your compensation and responsibility within the company.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position.



We are looking for someone who can work consistently each week and communicate reliably with the team.



We care more about reliability, output and quality than where you work from.



How To Apply



Please send us the following:



A link to your portfolio



Your 3 best DTC / e-commerce / direct-response ads



Please do not send us 30 random videos. We want to see the 3 ads that best represent your skills.



Tell us exactly what you did on those ads.



For example:



Editing



B-roll sourcing



UGC sourcing



AI generation



Voice-over



Captions



Motion graphics



Tell us which video editing and AI tools you currently use.



Tell us your current hourly rate.



Tell us how many hours per week you are available.



Tell us briefly about your previous experience working with DTC or e-commerce brands.



Start your application with the words:



PERFORMANCE EDITOR



If you do not include these words at the beginning of your application, your application will not be reviewed.



Hiring Process



If your portfolio looks like a good fit, we will invite you to complete a short editing trial.



The trial will be based on the type of creatives you would actually be producing for us.



We will evaluate:



Hook quality



Pacing



Clip selection



B-roll selection



Captions



Attention to detail



Ability to follow references



Overall direct-response instinct



We are not looking for perfection.



We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, good judgment, and the ability to improve quickly.



Long-Term Opportunity



We want to build a strong creative team, and we are looking for someone who can grow with us.



If you consistently produce strong work, learn quickly, and help us create winning ads, there will be opportunities for:



Higher compensation



More responsibility



Larger performance bonuses



A long-term position within the company



If this sounds like you, send us your application and your best work.



Remember to start your application with: PERFORMANCE EDITOR

title: Hospice Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist – Remote
description:
We are seeking an experienced Hospice Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist to support a California-based hospice agency. The ideal candidate must have prior experience performing QA for a hospice organization and be familiar with California hospice documentation, Medicare/CMS requirements, and Data Soft Logic (DSL) EMR.



Key Responsibilities



Review hospice clinical records for completeness, accuracy, compliance, and consistency with the Plan of Care.



Audit admissions, comprehensive assessments, IDG documentation, physician orders, nursing/discipline visits, recertifications, discharges, and other clinical documentation.



Verify that visit frequency, disciplines, services, medications, DME, and supplies are consistent with physician orders and the Plan of Care.



Identify documentation deficiencies and communicate corrections/follow-up items to clinical staff.



Assist with QA audits, compliance monitoring, corrective action plans, and preparation for accreditation/CMS surveys.

title: Social media Content Creator
description:
# Social Media Content Creator — Memes & Short-Form Video



**Remote | Part-Time/Freelance | Potential Permanent Position**



## About Confide



Confide is an early-stage startup building a new kind of platform centred around **real human connection, shared experiences and meaningful conversations**.



Sometimes people simply need an outlet — someone to talk to, someone who understands, or someone who has been through something similar and can offer advice or perspective.



Confide connects people looking for support and conversation with people who can draw on their own experiences to help. On the other side, creators can **share their experiences, build their personal brand, earn money and make a difference in someone's life.**



**Confide — where your story meets theirs.**



Our **pre-launch waitlist is now live**, and we're focused on building an engaged audience across the **US and UK**, with a particular focus on growing our American audience.



---



# The Role



We're looking for a creative **Social Media Content Creator** who understands memes, TikTok, Instagram, internet culture and short-form video.



You'll create finished content for Confide each week and send it via *
 to our Social Media Manager**, who will handle uploading, scheduling and managing our accounts.



This is not a traditional corporate content role. We want someone who understands **what people actually watch, share, send to friends and talk about online.**



The role will initially be freelance/part-time, but we're ultimately looking for the right person to potentially become a **permanent member of the Confide marketing team** as we grow.



---



# Weekly Content Required



You will create **9 finished pieces of content per week:**



### 3 Photo Memes

Funny, relatable, emotional or culturally relevant image-based content designed to generate shares, comments and engagement.



### 3 Video Memes

Short, entertaining videos using relevant memes, viral formats, trending sounds, POVs, pop culture and internet humour.



### 3 TikToks / Instagram Reels

Fully edited short-form videos including trends, storytelling, conversation starters, emotional content, questions/debates and occasional Confide promotional content.



That's approximately **36 finished pieces of content per month**, all delivered ready to post.



---



# What Our Content Should Feel Like



We **do not want corporate social-media content** or endless generic wellbeing graphics.



We want people to see Confide content and think:



**"This is literally me."**  

**"Why is this so accurate?"**  

**"I'm sending this to my friend."**  

**"I need to comment on this."**  

**"Wait... what is Confide?"**



Content can cover:



- Dating & relationships

- Breakups

- Friendship

- Family

- Work & careers

- Adulthood

- Loneliness

- Personal struggles

- Self-development

- Everyday situations

- Pop culture

- Current online conversations



Some posts should be **funny**, some **emotional**, some **thought-provoking**, and some designed to create debates in the comments.



Most importantly, the content should feel **native to TikTok and Instagram rather than like an advertisement.**



---



# Confide & Waitlist Content



Our waitlist is currently live, so while most content should be relatable and entertaining, some posts should naturally **allude to the Confide concept and create curiosity about what we're building.**



For example:



**"Sometimes you don't need everyone to understand. You just need someone who does."**



**"Your story could be exactly what somebody else needs to hear."**



**"What if the person who understood exactly what you're going through was one conversation away?"**



The objective is to turn:



**Great content → engagement → curiosity → profile visits → waitlist sign-ups.**



We don't want every post to advertise Confide. We want to **build a community first while naturally introducing the brand within it.**



---



# US Trends & Internet Culture



Understanding **American social-media culture is particularly important** for this position.



You should actively follow:



- US TikTok and Instagram trends

- Viral memes and sounds

- American pop culture

- Dating/relationship conversations

- Gen Z & Millennial humour

- Viral online conversations

- Emerging TikTok/Reels formats



You should also understand UK audiences.



We want someone proactive who sees a trend gaining traction and thinks:



**"I know how Confide could use this."**



—not someone who waits for us to provide every content idea.



---



# Your Responsibilities



You will:



- Create **9 finished pieces of content every week**

- Research current US and UK trends

- Generate original meme/content ideas

- Design photo memes

- Edit video memes

- Create TikToks and Reels

- Write strong hooks and on-screen text

- Adapt viral trends to the Confide brand

- Create content designed for shares, comments and engagement

- Occasionally create content promoting Confide and the waitlist

- Deliver all finished content to our Social Media Manager on time

- Respond to creative feedback and continuously improve the content



---



# Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



- Lives and breathes TikTok/Instagram culture

- Understands memes and internet humour

- Has strong knowledge of American social-media culture

- Understands emotional and relatable content

- Can create both image and video content

- Uses Canva, CapCut or similar tools confidently

- Has strong written English

- Can work independently

- Consistently brings fresh ideas

- Understands what makes content **shareable**

- Is reliable with deadlines

- Is interested in potentially growing with an early-stage startup



A good sense of humour and strong creative instincts are extremely important.



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



This will initially be a **freelance/part-time position**, but we're looking to build a long-term relationship rather than continuously hire different freelancers.



As Confide grows and launches, there will be an opportunity for the right person to potentially become a **permanent member of our marketing team**, take on greater responsibility and grow alongside the company.



---



# When Applying



Please send:



- Your portfolio

- Examples of photo memes you've created

- Examples of video memes/TikToks/Reels you've edited

- Social accounts you've created content for, if applicable

- Any experience creating content for US audiences

- The tools/software you use

- Your expected monthly rate for **36 finished pieces of content**



Please only apply if you're comfortable creating **all three formats: photo memes, video memes and TikTok/Reel content.**



We're looking for someone who understands **people, internet culture and social media** — and knows how to turn everyday experiences into content people want to watch, share and talk about.



**Confide.**  

*where your story meets theirs*

title: Account / Project Manager
description:
The Role

You'll be the day-to-day point of contact for a portfolio of Encipher clients. You own the relationship: onboarding, communication, project follow-through and expectations.



Our media buyers run the ad accounts. Your job is to make sure every client feels informed, looked after and confident in the work, and that nothing falls through the cracks between them and our team.



This is a full-time, remote position for a candidate based in the Philippines.



We're a startup, and we're hiring an A player. Your role will grow and shift beyond what's written here as we scale. If you want a job that stays exactly the same, this isn't the role for you.



What You'll Do



• Manage multiple clients at once. Know each client's goals, budget, services and current status without needing to look it up.

• Own the inbox. Reply to client
s within one business day. Write updates, recaps and follow-ups that are clear enough to send without edits.

• Lead onboarding. Take new clients from payment to launch: kickoff call, intake form, and access to ad accounts, Google Business Profile, website and CRM. Keep our onboarding checklist in Notion up to date.

• Set and manage expectations. Explain timelines, the learning phase in the first few months, and what good results look like at each stage. Make sure clients never get surprised.

• Keep projects moving. Track tasks across clients, like landing pages, website updates, tracking fixes, creative requests and reports. Chase client approvals and assets so our team is never blocked.

• Run client calls. Schedule and lead check-ins, present monthly results alongside the media buyer, and send a recap with next steps after every call.

• Protect retention. Spot unhappy or at-risk clients early and escalate before it becomes a cancellation. Flag upsell opportunities (LSAs, SEO, web design) to sales.



Who You'll Work With



You sit between our clients and our internal team, and you'll be talking with both every day.

• Head Media Buyer. Runs Google Ads and Meta Ads strategy and tracking. You pass along client goals, feedback and budget changes, turn their technical updates into plain language for clients, and prep monthly reports and calls together.

• Sales. Closes new clients. You get a handoff of what was promised and take it from there. You send upsell and referral opportunities back their way.

• Clients. Mostly moving company owners and operators, plus other home service businesses. They're busy, often on the road or the phone, and want short, straight answers.



What You Need



• Clear, confident English, spoken and written. This is non-negotiable. You'll be on live calls with North American business owners and writing
s that go out as-is. We screen for this on a recorded video and a live call.

• 2+ years in account management, client success or project coordination, ideally at a marketing agency.

• Experience with paid ads clients. You understand leads, cost per lead, booked jobs and ROAS, and can explain them to a business owner in plain language.

• Experience working with US or Canadian clients, including their expectations and communication style.

• Proven ability to juggle multiple clients and deadlines without dropping anything.

• A go-getter. You take ownership, move fast and find the answer before anyone has to ask.

• Strong organization. You keep clean notes, live in a task system and follow up without being reminded.

• Calm under pressure. You can handle a frustrated client professionally and know when to escalate.

• Daily user of Notion, Slack and Google Workspace. You'll be working in these tools from day one.



Nice to Have



• Agency experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads or Local Services Ads clients

• Experience in the moving or home services industry

• Familiarity with WhatConverts, SmartMoving, GoHighLevel and Stripe



Schedule, Setup and Compensation



• Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week, during Eastern Time business hours 9-5EST. This is a night shift in the Philippines.

• Location: Fully remote, from the Philippines.

• Your setup: A reliable computer, stable internet with a backup connection, a noise-cancelling headset, a webcam and a quiet place to take calls.



How to Apply



Applications that skip any of these steps won't be reviewed.

1. Start your application with the words "Booked Moves" so we know you read the full post.

2. Record a 2 to 3 minute video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself and telling us about a time you turned around an unhappy client.

3. Answer these three questions in writing:

    1. You manage 12 clients. Three of them
 you urgent requests on the same morning. How do you decide what to handle first?

    2. A client
s saying their leads dropped this week and they're thinking about cancelling. Write the exact reply you would send.

    3. Walk us through how you would onboard a new client in five steps.

4. Attach your resume and your expected monthly rate in USD.

You will help move builders through a simple process:

Find builder → Contact builder → Get building plans → Submit plans for bid → Send bid → Follow up → Book a call with our team

You will NOT need to create construction bids or do engineering.

We have a team that handles the pricing and technical work.

Your job is to keep the process moving and make sure no builder gets forgotten.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. CONTACT BUILDERS

Call builders and contractors

Send
s

Follow up with builders

Ask simple questions

Find out what projects they have coming up

Ask if they would like a free steel framing estimate

Keep notes about every conversation

You will use scripts and training.

You do not need to be a construction expert.



2. GET BUILDING PLANS

When a builder wants a bid:

Ask for the PDF plans

Make sure we received the plans

Save the plans correctly

Upload the plans to our CRM

Submit the plans to our estimating team

Track the job until the bid is ready

You do not price the job.

Our RFP team prepares the proposal.



3. SEND THE BID TO THE BUILDER

When the bid is ready:

 the proposal to the builder

Call the builder

Make sure they received it

Ask if they have questions

Ask them to review the proposal

Book a call with our team

The Titan process calls for sending the proposal and then immediately calling the builder to confirm receipt and book the walkthrough.



4. FOLLOW UP

This is one of the most important parts of the job.

You will:

Follow up the same day

Follow up every other day when needed

Keep track of responses

Ask for the next step

Schedule calls

Update the CRM

We do not want leads sitting in a CRM with no next action.

The rule is:

Every builder needs a next step.

Construction companies

Contractors

Builders

Real estate

B2B sales

CRM systems

 follow-up

Sales pipelines

U.S. businesses

Follow up with builders

During the day

Call builders

 builders

Communication

English

Phone skills

Overall results

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Real Estate and Architecture Reels (Per-Video, Long-Term)
description:
Job Type: Freelance / per-project, long-term ongoing work



Rate: $25–35 USD per finished reel (30–60 seconds), depending on length, experience, and edit complexity. Longer edits (1–3 minutes, documentary-style) are priced separately per project. Paid test edit for shortlisted applicants.



About us



MC Visuals is a San Diego-based marketing agency. We create content primarily architects, custom home builders, design-build firms, and real estate professionals. Our style is clean, cinematic, and story-driven, but it has to perform on social. We want edits that hold attention in the first three seconds and keep people watching, without losing the polished, high-end feel our clients expect.



The role: 



We’re looking for a video editor to turn our raw footage into short social media reels, mostly 30–60 seconds, for Instagram and other platforms. You’ll receive organized footage and a brief, and deliver a finished vertical edit ready to post. You’ll select the music for each edit unless we specify a track, so a strong ear for what fits the mood and performs on social is important.



We manage all projects in 
. Each edit will have its own task with the brief, footage links, deadline, and feedback, so you’ll always know what’s assigned, what’s due, and where things stand.



Typical work:



- Cutting 30–60 second vertical reels from cinematic footage (homes, construction, interiors, on-camera interviews)

- Color grading Sony S-Log3 footage to match our clean, cinematic look (reference examples provided)

- Music selection, pacing, and rhythm edits with strong hooks and retention-focused structure

- Motion graphics, animated text, and creative transitions when the edit calls for them (speed ramps, match cuts, masked transitions, kinetic captions)

- Clean, tasteful text overlays and captions

- Occasional 1–3 minute documentary-style brand films with interview audio and b-roll



Some edits will be minimal and cinematic. Others will be punchy and graphic-heavy. We need someone who can do both and knows when each is right.



We’re building toward a steady weekly workflow of several reels per week across multiple clients. We’ll start with a handful of edits to get aligned on style, then scale up quickly as we build trust.



You’re a fit if you have: 



- Experience editing real estate, architecture, or interior design video (strongly preferred)

- A portfolio of short-form vertical content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

- Confident color grading skills, including experience with S-Log3 or similar log profiles

- Motion graphics and transition skills (After Effects a plus, but not required if you can do it in Premiere or Resolve)

- Access to a licensed music library (Epidemic Sound, Artlist, Musicbed, or similar) and good instincts for pairing music to footage

- A feel for what performs on Instagram and TikTok: hooks, retention, pacing, and trends, applied with taste

- An understanding of short documentary storytelling: how to build a hook, a story, and a payoff in under a minute

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- Comfort working in 
 (or willingness to learn; it’s simple)

- Reliable turnaround (within 1–3 days of receiving footage) and clear communication

- Comfort with English briefs and feedback



How to apply



Reply with:



Links to 2–3 short vertical edits you’re proud of. Ideally one cinematic/minimal and one with graphics and transitions, so we can see your range.

Which editing software you use

Which music library you have access to

Your typical turnaround time for a 45-second reel

Start your message with the word “CINEMATIC” so I know you read the full post



Shortlisted applicants (2–3 people) will receive a paid test edit using our real footage. Not everyone who applies will be tested. If it’s a good fit, this becomes ongoing work.

title: AI Talking Avatar Video Creator (Google Flow OMNI + CapCut) - 6 videos/day, long-term
description:
Watch this video first. This is the job:





Everything in it is AI. The man talking, his voice and every shot were made with OMNI in Google Flow, then cut together in CapCut. It got 12,000 likes and 2,300 comments because nobody scrolling past can tell it is AI.



I need someone who can make 6 videos like that every day.



WHAT MAKES THAT VIDEO WORK (and what you will be judged on)



- It looks like a normal person filmed it on their phone. Not cinematic, not polished, not "AI looking".

- It is the same man in every shot: same face, same hair, same clothes, same voice.

- His lips match every word. Nothing is cut off, nothing is doubled.

- What you see matches what he says. When he talks about ginger, there is ginger in his hand.

- He holds the real product on camera, label to the lens.

- The captions are clean and on time, and the music is quiet under his voice.



If you look at that video and think "I already make videos like this", keep reading. If you think "I could learn this", this job is not for you yet. I am not training anyone from zero.



YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE



1. Hands-on experience making talking clips with OMNI in Google Flow. Veo only, Kling, HeyGen or Higgsfield does not count.

2. At least 3 months of paid AI avatar video work for a client or brand.

3. At least 50 finished AI videos delivered (finished videos, not clips).

4. Solid CapCut: captions, keyframes, audio ducking, cutting to the beat of the voice.

5. Proof you have kept one character consistent across several videos.



A NORMAL DAY



The day before, I send you everything for each video: the script, a reference video, the character image and the start frames. You then:



1. Generate each line as its own Omni clip, from the start frame, one clip at a time.

2. Check every clip: face, voice, lip sync, every word said exactly as written. Redo any that fail.

3. Put the clips together in CapCut with captions and quiet background music, matching the reference video's pacing and shot order.

4. Export 9:16, 1080x1920 MP4 and upload each video as soon as it is done.



Videos are 1 to 2 minutes long. Week 1 is 4 to 5 videos a day while I check your workflow. After that it is 6.



OMNI SKILLS I EXPECT ON DAY ONE



- Frames mode (not Ingredients) so the clip starts on the exact image

- Short dialogue prompts: the action, the speaker, the delivery and the exact line, nothing else

- Choosing 4s, 6s or 8s to fit the line, so no words are cut off and there is no dead air

- Rewording a blocked prompt (filter / "reputational risk") without changing the spoken line

- x1 generations only, checked one at a time



CREDITS



Accounts and credits are provided. Images are free, so the start frame gets perfected first. Clips cost credits, so: shortest length that fits the line, never 10s, never x2/x3/x4, never 16:9. Screenshot the credit balance at the start and end of each day. Wasting credits is the fastest way off the team.



HOW I CHECK YOU ARE REAL



- You show me your Omni history in Flow on a screen share or a short screen recording.

- You make ONE paid test video from my script and assets before you are hired. Same quality as the example.

- I get the same recycled portfolios from different people every week. If you cannot prove the work is yours, you are out.



CONSISTENCY



Same hours and same days every week, Saturdays included. 3 strikes: missing a day without telling me first is a strike, and repeating a mistake after feedback is a strike. You need a computer that can export 6 videos a day and reliable internet.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "OMNI" or I will not read it. Then answer:



1. Link 2 to 3 talking avatar videos you made yourself with Omni. For each: which client or brand, and what you did.

2. How long have you used Omni, and about how many finished videos have you delivered with it?

3. Watch my example video. In 2 to 3 sentences, how would you rebuild it in Omni?

4. Tell me about one Omni clip that got blocked, cut off a word or drifted from the start frame, and how you fixed it.

5. Link one character you kept consistent across 2 or more videos.

6. Honestly, how many 1 to 2 minute videos can you finish per day at the example's quality?

7. Your working hours and the days you commit to.



No Omni videos, no reply. AI-written copy-paste applications that do not answer the questions get no reply either.



WHAT YOU GET



- Everything prepared for you the day before: scripts, references, character images, start frames

- My exact process and prompt library, plus Loom feedback

- Accounts and credits paid for

- Long-term stable work, a raise as you get faster, and a monthly performance bonus

title: 🐾 WE’RE HIRING: SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT MARKETING MANAGER The Pet Care Club of Seattle | Seattle, WA
description:
We’re not looking for someone to simply “keep our social media active.”



We’re looking for someone who can make people stop scrolling, understand what makes us different, and want their dog to be part of it.



The Pet Care Club of Seattle is an established, locally owned pet care company that has been serving Seattle-area pets and their people for nearly 20 years—and we’re entering one of the most exciting chapters in our history.



We’re changing the way people think about dog walking.



Our new Behavior + Enrichment Membership combines professional dog walking with R+ positive reinforcement, force-free, low-stress, Fear Free–focused methods designed to make a walk more meaningful than simply getting a dog around the block.



We want Seattle pet parents to understand why that matters.



And that’s where you come in.



WHAT WE NEED



We’re looking for a creative, strategic storyteller who gets genuinely excited about taking a great idea and getting others excited about it, too.



Someone who can help us:

• Educate pet parents about R+ positive reinforcement, enrichment, behavior, decompression, confidence building, leash skills, reactivity, and what dogs actually need from their walks

• Turn those sometimes-complex concepts into engaging, easy-to-understand content people actually want to consume

• Show the real-life difference between an ordinary dog walk and an intentional Behavior + Enrichment walk

• Tell stories about the dogs we work with and the progress we see

• Create compelling Reels, short-form video, carousels, graphics, stories, and posts

• Develop hooks and concepts that make people stop scrolling

• Showcase our team, our personality, and the humans behind the business

• Create content for our dog walking, training, puppy, and cat services while keeping our Behavior + Enrichment membership at the heart of our current growth strategy

• Build excitement around The Pet Care Club—not simply awareness

• Help turn followers into inquiries, and inquiries into clients

• Engage authentically with our local community and help grow a recognizable Seattle pet-care brand

• Pay attention to what performs, test new ideas, and continually improve our content strategy



THIS IS IMPORTANT: WE WANT HUMAN-CREATED CONTENT

We believe people are becoming increasingly tired of social media that sounds, looks, and feels AI-generated.



So are we.



We're looking for someone with their own voice, creativity, judgment, humor, curiosity, and ideas.



We don't want someone using generative AI to write our captions, create our posts, manufacture our imagery, or replace original creative work.



We want our content to sound like people talking to people.

Our dogs are real.

Our team is real.

Our clients are real.

Our stories should feel that way too.

YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF…

You understand that good social media isn't just “posting consistently.”

You know how to find the story.



You can look at a video of a dog learning to disengage from another dog and immediately start thinking:



"People need to understand why THIS is a big deal."

You know the difference between educating and lecturing.

You understand how to make content useful and entertaining.

You have strong instincts around hooks, storytelling, pacing, copywriting, video, and calls to action.

You’re comfortable bringing us ideas rather than waiting for us to tell you exactly what to post.

You’re curious enough to learn our approach to dog behavior and enrichment so that you can communicate it accurately.

You care about the details.

And ideally, you’re a little obsessed with dogs. 😉



WE'D ESPECIALLY LOVE SOMEONE WHO HAS:

• Proven experience growing or managing social media for a consumer-facing brand

• Strong short-form video/Reels experience

• Excellent writing and storytelling skills

• Experience with Instagram and
; additional platform expertise is a plus

• A strong visual eye and the ability to create polished content that still feels natural and human

• An understanding of what makes people share, save, comment, click, and inquire

• Experience translating educational topics into compelling consumer content

• An understanding of local/community-based marketing

• The ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and communicate proactively

• Enough confidence to say, “I have an idea…” and run with it



Pet industry experience is wonderful, but marketing talent, curiosity, and the ability to understand our mission matter more.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success isn't simply posting numerous times a week.

We want to see people begin saying:

“I had no idea dog walking could do that.”

“This is exactly what my dog needs.”

“How do I sign up?”



We’ll look at meaningful indicators like engagement, saves, shares, reach within our local market, website traffic, inquiries, membership interest, and ultimately new clients—not vanity metrics alone.



ABOUT US

The Pet Care Club of Seattle is a locally owned, woman-owned company serving Seattle-area pets and their people since 2007.



We believe pet care can—and should—be better.



Our approach centers on relationship, enrichment, positive reinforcement, thoughtful handling, and meeting each animal where they are.



Our growing services include Behavior + Enrichment dog walking memberships, classic and on-demand dog walks, dog training, puppy services, and cat care.



We're building something different, and we're looking for someone who wants to help us tell that story.



INTERESTED?



Please send us:

• A little about yourself and why this particular brand and role interests you

• Examples of social media accounts or content you've created

• Two or three pieces of content you're especially proud of and why

• Any measurable results you're able to share

• Your availability and compensation expectations



And because we care much more about how you think than receiving a perfectly polished cover letter:



Tell us one idea you'd be excited to explore for The Pet Care Club after reading this post.

We can't wait to see what you come up with. 🐾

title: Warehouse & Inventory Reconciliation Coordinator
description:
Reports to: Operations Manager

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Warehouse & Inventory Reconciliation Coordinator to support our growing Amazon wholesale operation.

This role will be responsible for tracking inventory throughout the supply chain, identifying discrepancies, communicating with our warehouse and suppliers, and ensuring inventory and financial records remain accurate.

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating issues, reconciling data between systems, and following processes to completion.

This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week during training and onboarding, with the expectation of transitioning to full-time after successful completion of training.



Working Hours

Training Period

6:00 PM – 10:00 PM Mountain Time

Approximately 4 hours per day, 20 hours per week

Full-Time Schedule

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Time

8 hours per day, 40 hours per week

Provides overlap with our warehouse operations team



Primary Responsibilities

Inventory Tracking & Reconciliation

Track inbound shipments from suppliers to warehouse

Use carrier delivery confirmations (UPS, FedEx, regional and LTL carriers) as the official delivery date, and confirm each delivery is checked in by the warehouse within the agreed timeframe

Investigate delayed, missing, or incomplete shipments

Escalate deliveries not checked in within the agreed window, with the carrier proof of delivery attached

Compare supplier shipment confirmations against warehouse receipts

Identify inventory discrepancies and escalate issues as needed

Warehouse Coordination

Communicate daily with warehouse staff via Slack

Follow up on missing inventory, damaged products, and receiving issues

Assist with inventory investigations and exception handling

Evaluate damage reports and photos against Amazon’s New condition standard – a product in damaged retail packaging is damaged even if the item works

Maintain organized records of open issues and resolutions in the shared escalation and holding logs

Supplier Claims & Credits

File supplier claims for shortages, damages, and missing inventory within each supplier’s claim window (often 48–72 hours after delivery)

Maintain a reference of claim windows and documentation requirements by supplier

Request RMAs and supplier credits when appropriate

Track outstanding claims through resolution

Include reconcile in the subject of your
 application

Verify supplier credits are properly issued and received

Inventory & Software Reconciliation

Compare warehouse shipments against software records

Verify inventory movements are accurately reflected in company systems

Identify discrepancies between physical inventory and software data

Assist with ongoing inventory accuracy initiatives

Financial Reconciliation Support

Review discrepancy reports generated by our automated tracking tools (delayed-shipment alerts in ClickUp and Google Sheets trackers)

Compare identified discrepancies against supplier invoices, shipment records, and credit memos

Verify supplier credits and RMAs are ultimately received

Escalate unresolved discrepancies for further review

Audit prep center invoices against the agreed rate card and against receiving and shipment records; request itemized breakdowns when charges change

Monitor carrier adjustment and freight reclass charges on outbound shipments and identify the cause

Amazon Seller Central Support

Maintain Amazon listings, including marking out-of-stock items as non-replenishable, removing listings that will not be replenished, and creating listings to generate MSKUs.

Monitor Account Health and flag issues that need action; assist with negative feedback cases.

Open and follow up on cases for inventory lost or misplaced at Amazon warehouses.

Assist with customer inquiries, brand validation, COGS updates, and document requests as assigned.



Ideal Candidate

Extremely detail-oriented

Strong organizational skills

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and data (Google Sheets); experience with Slack and ClickUp preferred

Investigative mindset; enjoys solving problems

Able to follow processes consistently

Strong written English communication

Comfortable communicating with suppliers and warehouse personnel

Holds a position with evidence when a partner disputes a record – professional and calm, not escalatory

Able to manage multiple open issues simultaneously



Preferred Experience

Inventory management

Supply chain operations

Warehouse coordination

Amazon FBA operations

Data reconciliation

Administrative support

Accounts payable or inventory auditing experience



Success Metrics

Inventory discrepancies identified and resolved

Claims filed within each supplier’s claim window

Supplier credits successfully recovered (credits recovered vs. amount claimed)

Open warehouse issues resolved promptly (age of open escalations)

Accurate reconciliation between inventory systems

Timely communication with suppliers and warehouse personnel

Reduction in unresolved inventory and credit discrepancies



Employee Expectation

Uphold company values and maintain a positive work environment. 

Ensure confidentiality of company information, including leads and supplier details. 

Use the time-tracking software Hubstaff accurately and with integrity. 

Must work 40 hours per week, 160 hours per month. 

Must attend KPI meetings every week.



Compensation

$960 –$1120 USD per month full-time; training hours paid at the equivalent hourly rate

Paid time off accrues at 1-day per month, up to 12 days per year. Unused PTO may accumulate and is paid out at the end of the year.

Paid holidays include Good Friday, All Saints’ Day, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, New Year’s Day, and your birthday.

We promote from within and offer growth opportunities and pay increases based on performance.

To support long-term stability, we maintain reserves equivalent to six months of operating costs.



How to Apply

Send an
 to 
 your resume and why you would be a good fit for this specific role. Please include your onlingjobsph profile so that we can perform a background check. 

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid practical exercise: reconciling a set of carrier deliveries against a check-in log and an invoice, and writing up the exceptions.

title: New Zealand focused Traffic Management Planner | Morning Shift

title: Leasing & Collections Specialist (Sales Background Preferred)
description:
Leasing & Collections Specialist (Sales Background Preferred)



About the Role



We are an Atlanta-based property management company looking for a phone-first closer. This role is focused on two things: filling our vacant units and collecting the rent. If you've worked in sales and you like having clear numbers to hit, this role is built for you.



You'll spend most of your day on the phone with prospects and residents. Some of those calls are friendly ("let's get you into this home") and some are firm ("your balance needs to be paid by Friday"). We want someone who's good at both and who gets satisfaction from moving a number in the right direction.



What You'll Own

1. Leasing (filling vacancies)

- Respond to every new rental inquiry within minutes during business hours, by phone, text, and
.

- Qualify prospects on income, move-in date, and household size, then book showings.

- Run live virtual walkthroughs by phone or video while prospects tour the property.

- Follow up persistently after showings, handle objections, and ask for the application.

- Work applications through to approval: collect missing documents and complete landlord and employer verifications.

- Keep listings live, accurate, and compelling on Zillow,
 Marketplace, and other sites.

- Contact current residents ahead of lease expiration to secure renewals.



2. Collections (protecting revenue)

- Work the past-due list every day: call, text, and message each resident with a balance.

- Secure specific payment commitments (amount and date) and follow up the day they're due.

- Keep conversations professional, respectful, and firm, and follow company policy and fair housing and collections guidelines.

- Flag accounts that need escalation (payment plans, notices, or legal filing) to the Operations Manager with a clear summary.

- Get residents set up on online payments and autopay through the resident portal.



3. Reporting & Admin Support

- Submit an end-of-day report: leads, showings, applications, leases signed, calls made, payment promises secured, and dollars collected.

- Log every conversation in CRM with outcomes and next steps.

- Run weekly and monthly reports on rent collected, delinquency, and late fees.

- Provide administrative support and assist with other property management tasks as needed.



How Success Is Measured

- Speed to lead (time from inquiry to first contact)

- Lead-to-showing and showing-to-application conversion

- Days vacant per unit

- Delinquency rate and dollars collected each month

- Payment promises kept

- Renewal rate



Who We're Looking For

- Sales background preferred: 2+ years in inside sales, leasing, appointment setting, call center sales, or collections. Tell us your numbers.

- Near-native English, spoken and written. Every call is with an American resident or prospect.

- Phone-first: you'd rather make the call than send another text.

- Comfortable with "no": rejection from prospects and pushback from past-due residents don't rattle you.

- Organized follow-up: you track every lead and every promise, and nothing slips.

- Honest with your numbers. We value accurate reporting over good-looking reporting.

- Nice to have: experience with Rentvine, AppFolio, Buildium, or another property management system; a CRM such as Brivity or Follow Up Boss; Google Workspace.



Schedule & Requirements

- Tuesday through Saturday, 9am to 6pm Eastern. Saturday availability is required.

- Quiet home office, noise-canceling headset, and reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection.

- References (required): You must provide 2 professional references we can speak with directly, ideally US-based. We appreciate your help facilitating those conversations.

- Compensation: $6/hour, paid biweekly.



How to Apply

Start your message with the words "I close and I collect." Please include the following: 

1, A short summary of your sales or collections experience, with numbers if you have them (quota, conversion rate, dollars collected).

2. A video of no more than 2 minutes that tells us:

- Your name and who you are

- Something unique about yourself

- Your experience and how it relates to this role

- Why you're interested in this position

3. A statement confirming that you have 2 professional references available and that you can help arrange a conversation with them.



Applications missing all of these items won't be reviewed.

title: Acquisitions Lead Qualifier
description:
# Cold Caller / Lead Generation Specialist — Remote



We are looking for an energetic, reliable, and confident **Cold Caller / Lead Generation Specialist** to join our U.S. real estate investment company.



**Real estate experience is NOT required.**



We are willing to train the right person if you already have strong English communication skills, confidence on the phone, a positive attitude, and the ability to learn.



Your job will be to speak with property owners throughout the United States, have genuine conversations, gather information, and identify people who may be interested in selling their property.



## Compensation



- Starting pay: **$3.00–$4.00 USD per hour**

- Paid training

- Full-time opportunity

- Performance bonuses available

- Pay increases available based on performance

- Opportunity to advance into Lead Management or Acquisitions



We reward people who consistently perform.



Someone who starts at $3–$4/hour can earn increases as they demonstrate reliability, communication skills, lead quality, and production. Can go up to $5 + performance bonuses



## What You Will Do



You will receive training, scripts, rebuttals, and coaching.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Making outbound calls to property owners

- Introducing yourself and the company

- Asking whether they would consider selling their property

- Having natural conversations instead of simply reading a script

- Asking questions about the property

- Learning the property's condition

- Understanding why the owner may want to sell

- Determining their desired selling timeline

- Asking what price they would consider

- Handling basic objections

- Identifying potential motivated sellers

- Scheduling callbacks

- Passing qualified opportunities to our acquisitions team

- Entering accurate notes into our CRM

- Following up when assigned

- Meeting daily activity goals



## You May Be a Good Fit If You Have Experience In



Real estate experience is helpful but NOT required.



We are interested in applicants with experience in:



- Cold calling

- Appointment setting

- Call centers

- Outbound sales

- Customer service

- Mortgage

- Telecommunications

- Collections

- Lead generation



Even if you have never worked in real estate, we can teach you the real-estate side.



## What Matters Most



We are looking for someone who:



- Speaks clear conversational English

- Is easy to understand

- Has a friendly personality

- Is comfortable talking to strangers

- LISTENS after asking questions

- Doesn't constantly interrupt people

- Doesn't sound like they are reading a script

- Can think during a conversation

- Can ask follow-up questions

- Is comfortable hearing "no"

- Remains professional when someone is rude

- Has strong attendance

- Is coachable

- Wants to improve

- Can follow instructions

- Wants stable long-term employment



We prefer someone who is **warm, confident and conversational** rather than overly aggressive.



## Training



We provide training on:



- U.S. real estate terminology

- Motivated sellers

- Property-condition questions

- Seller motivation

- Asking about price

- Seller timelines

- Building rapport

- Objection handling

- Appointment setting

- CRM usage

- Call structure

- Lead qualification



Your calls will be reviewed periodically so we can help you improve.



## Schedule



This is a remote position working U.S. business hours.



You must be available to work during **Eastern Time hours**.



Consistent attendance is extremely important.



## Technical Requirements



You must have:



- Reliable high-speed internet

- Computer/laptop

- Good-quality headset

- Quiet working environment

- Stable electricity

- Ability to use web-based software

- Backup internet preferred



## Growth Opportunity



We prefer promoting from within.



High-performing callers may eventually move into:



**Cold Caller  → Senior Cold Caller → Lead Manager → Junior Acquisitions → Acquisitions**



Employees who produce strong results may also qualify for additional bonuses and pay increases.



## How to Apply



Send the following:



1. Full name

2. Location

3. Current hourly rate expectation

4. Previous work experience

5. Cold-calling or call-center experience, if any

6. Your available working hours

7. Internet speed

8. A **60–90 second voice recording**



For your recording, answer:



**"Imagine you called a homeowner and they said, 'I'm not interested.' What would you say next?"**



Do NOT submit a heavily edited or AI-generated recording. We want to hear how you naturally communicate.



Selected applicants will complete a short interview and mock cold call before being hired.



We are looking for reliable people interested in a **long-term position**, not short-term freelance work.



All calling must follow company procedures and applicable telemarketing, consent, and do-not-call requirements.

title: 2D Motion Graphics Animator for Fast-Paced YouTube Videos
description:
I’m looking for a talented 2D Motion Graphics Animator / YouTube Animator to help create fast-paced, entertaining videos for a brand new YouTube channel.



Our videos are based around concepts such as:



What If you were a ( job profession, celebrity, fictional character ) for 24 hours

24 Hours As

Hypothetical scenarios

Celebrity / sports / pop culture scenarios

Fictional and imaginative situations



For example:



For the first video: 24 Hours As LeBron James



The viewer is placed directly into the scenario and experiences the story as if they are the character.



-What You’ll Receive



For each video, I will provide:



* The complete script.

* The finished voiceover.

* Clear direction for the video.

* Character/reference information when needed.

* Additional references or examples when necessary.



Your job is to turn the voiceover into a complete, engaging visual experience.



You will NOT be responsible for writing the script.







-What You’ll Be Doing



You will create the visual side of the video, including:



* 2D character animation.

* Character movements and expressions.

* Creating and animating environments/backgrounds.

* Motion graphics.

* Dynamic camera movements.

* Zooms, pans, and transitions.

* Text and typography animation when appropriate.

* Visual effects.

* Scene changes synchronized with the voiceover.

* Creating visual gags and interesting moments.

* Using different shots and compositions to prevent the video from feeling static.

* Timing visuals closely to the narration, music, and sound effects.

* Turning the narration into something that feels like a real animated story.



The animation does not need to be extremely complex in every scene.



*The priority is visual storytelling, pacing, creativity, and keeping the viewer engaged.





-VERY IMPORTANT: This Is NOT a Slideshow



I am NOT looking for someone who simply puts images on screen while the voiceover plays.



The video should feel alive.



For example, if the narration says:



You walk into the arena and 40,000 people start screaming your name.”



I don't want:



A static image of an arena.



I want something more like:



The character walks into the arena → camera follows them → crowd reacts → camera pushes toward the character → text/effects emphasize the moment → transition into the next scene.



The visuals should interpret and enhance the narration, rather than simply illustrate it with static images.





-Visual Pacing



Our videos will be 12–15 minutes long ( preferable 15-17 minutes), so maintaining visual variety is extremely important.



The first video will be approximately 20 minutes but the other videos will be shorter than that.



We want the screen to constantly feel like something is happening.



Depending on the scene, this can include:



* Character animation.

* Camera movement.

* New backgrounds.

* Different camera angles.

* Zooms and pans.

* Text animation.

* Transitions.

* Visual effects.

* Animated objects.

* Environmental movement.

* Reactions and expressions.

* Creative visual jokes.



The goal is not necessarily to create a completely new animation from scratch every few seconds.



Smart reuse of characters, environments, assets, and animation is completely fine.



Constant character assets/location assets are very important



What matters is that the final video feels dynamic and entertaining rather than repetitive.



-The Style



The general visual direction is:



2D animated characters + stylized environments + dynamic camera movement + motion graphics + fast-paced editing.



We are open to different animation styles as long as the final result fits the channel.



-You can use tools such as:



* Adobe After Effects

* Adobe Animate

* Toon Boom

* Blender

* Character animation software

* AI-assisted tools

* Other professional animation software



The software you use is less important than the final result.





-AI Tools



AI-assisted workflows are completely fine for the animation/asset creation process.



-You may use AI tools to help create:



* Backgrounds.

* Character assets.

* Props.

* Reference images.

* Other visual elements.



However, the final video needs to feel cohesive and professionally produced.



I don't want a random collection of AI-generated images placed together.



NO AI SLOP.



The assets should be consistent in style and properly integrated into the animation.



-Working With the Voiceover



The voiceover will be the backbone of the video.



You should be comfortable:



* Cutting scenes precisely to narration.

* Changing visuals when the subject changes.

* Emphasizing important words or moments visually.

* Creating visual payoffs for jokes or twists.

* Using pauses in the narration effectively.

* Building momentum as the story progresses.



You should constantly be thinking:



What should the viewer be seeing at this exact moment?





-What We’re Looking For



The ideal animator has:



* Strong 2D animation skills.

* Strong understanding of motion graphics.

* Good visual storytelling instincts.

* Excellent sense of timing and pacing.

* Ability to make simple animation look entertaining.

* Strong understanding of composition and camera movement.

* Attention to detail.

* Ability to follow direction and references.

* Ability to work independently.

* Reliable communication.

* Ability to meet deadlines.



Bonus Points



* Previous experience working on YouTube channels.

* Experience with faceless YouTube content.

* Experience with animated storytelling channels.

* Experience creating character animation.

* Experience with fast-paced YouTube editing.

* Experience with AI-assisted animation workflows.

* Understanding of YouTube audience retention.

* Experience creating videos in a similar style.



Important: We Care About Retention



The purpose of the animation is not simply to make the video look good.



It needs to keep the viewer watching.



We want an animator who understands that visual changes, movement, reactions, camera work, and creative moments can all help maintain attention.



You should be able to look at a voiceover and think:



This section is getting visually repetitive — I need to change the shot, movement, environment, or presentation.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. 3–5 examples of your best animation/motion graphics work.**

2. At least one YouTube video you have worked on**, if available.

3. Examples of 2D character animation, if you have them.

4. Your preferred software.

5. Your rate per finished minute or per video.

6. Your typical turnaround time.

7. A brief explanation of how you would approach animating a 12-15 ( 20 minutes MAX) minute voiceover-driven YouTube video.



Please do not send only logo animations, corporate presentations, or basic motion graphics examples.



I am specifically looking for someone who can create engaging animated storytelling for YouTube.





Long-Term Opportunity



I’m looking for someone who can become a long-term part of the production process, rather than someone interested in completing only one video.



If we find the right person and the quality is consistent, there will be opportunities for regular videos and ongoing work.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Job description:



Ashoori Law | Full-Time | Remote | Independent Contractor



Independent Contractor Notice



This is a full-time independent contractor position, not an employee position. The selected candidate will be responsible for their own taxes, registrations, and compliance obligations in their jurisdiction.



About Ashoori Law



Ashoori Law is a U.S.-based immigration law firm serving individuals, families, entrepreneurs, investors, and businesses with their U.S. immigration needs.



We are seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead our marketing strategy, strengthen lead generation, improve conversion performance, and drive measurable business growth.



Position Overview



The Marketing Director will own the firm’s overall marketing strategy and performance. This role will oversee paid advertising, lead-generation funnels, HubSpot CRM and automation, website optimization, content strategy, analytics, and marketing attribution.



You will work directly with firm leadership and manage marketing agencies, contractors, media buyers, developers, designers, and content creators.

Identify opportunities to increase qualified leads, consultations, client acquisition, and revenue

Customer acquisition cost

Marketing-sourced revenue

Revenue attribution

ROAS and overall marketing ROI

Required Qualifications



10+ years of progressive marketing experience, including senior-level marketing leadership

Strong experience with paid advertising, lead generation, and conversion optimization

Advanced experience with HubSpot CRM and marketing automation

Strong understanding of marketing analytics, attribution, budgeting, and ROI

Ability to analyze performance data and translate it into actionable business decisions

Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills

Comfortable working directly with senior leadership in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience as a Marketing Director, Head of Marketing, VP of Marketing, or similar senior marketing leader

Experience marketing legal or professional services
