title: Senior Human Resources Manager / Chief of Staff to the CEO
description:
Senior Human Resources Manager / Chief of Staff to the CEO

Location: Philippines — Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote

Compensation: $1,200–$1,550 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

About the Position

We are looking for a highly organized, experienced, and proactive Senior Human Resources Manager / Chief of Staff to the CEO to join our growing team.

This is a unique hybrid position combining senior-level Human Resources leadership with executive support and Chief of Staff responsibilities.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the company's HR function, including recruiting, onboarding, employee relations, HR policies, performance management, and employee support. At the same time, this individual will work closely with the CEO as a trusted partner, helping manage priorities, coordinate projects, follow up with team members, organize information, and ensure important initiatives are executed.

This position is ideal for someone who is highly dependable, extremely organized, proactive, discreet, and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.

You will work directly with the CEO and will be trusted with confidential employee, business, and executive information.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Human Resources

• Manage the company's day-to-day HR operations.

• Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employees and management.

• Manage the full employee lifecycle, including recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, performance management, and offboarding.

• Develop and maintain HR policies, procedures, and employee documentation.

• Maintain accurate and confidential employee records.

• Support employee relations and address employee questions and concerns.

• Assist managers with performance issues, employee communication, and workplace matters.

• Develop and maintain employee handbooks and internal HR procedures.

• Coordinate benefits and other employee-related programs as applicable.

• Assist with payroll-related HR matters.

• Monitor HR compliance requirements and coordinate with appropriate professionals or providers when necessary.

• Help build a professional, accountable, and positive company culture.

• Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and employee experience.

________________________________________

Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

Recruiting will be a significant part of this position.

The successful candidate will:

• Create and maintain job descriptions.

• Post positions across appropriate recruiting platforms.

• Source and identify qualified candidates.

• Review resumes and applications.

• Conduct initial phone and video interviews.

• Develop structured interview processes.

• Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and the CEO.

• Communicate with candidates throughout the hiring process.

• Maintain candidate pipelines and recruiting records.

• Assist with offer letters and hiring documentation.

• Coordinate onboarding for new employees.

• Help develop an efficient and scalable recruiting process.

• Continuously identify ways to improve the quality and speed of hiring.

________________________________________

Chief of Staff / Executive Support

In addition to HR responsibilities, you will work directly with the CEO as an Executive Partner / Chief of Staff.

Responsibilities will include:

• Help the CEO organize and prioritize daily, weekly, and long-term priorities.

• Track important projects, deadlines, and action items.

• Follow up with team members and managers on assignments and deadlines.

• Coordinate communication between the CEO and different departments.

• Prepare meeting agendas, notes, summaries, and follow-up items.

• Attend virtual meetings with the CEO when appropriate.

• Document decisions and ensure action items are followed through.

• Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and other materials for the CEO.

• Conduct research and provide summaries and recommendations.

• Help coordinate company-wide initiatives and special projects.

• Assist the CEO with administrative and operational priorities.

• Identify issues that require attention and bring them to the CEO proactively.

• Ensure important information reaches the appropriate people.

• Help turn the CEO's priorities into organized, actionable tasks.

• Take ownership of projects from beginning to completion.

________________________________________

The Right Person for This Role

We are looking for someone who is more than an HR administrator.

You should be someone the CEO can trust to say:

“Give it to me. I'll take care of it.”

The ideal candidate:

• Takes initiative without waiting to be told what to do.

• Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Has excellent follow-through.

• Can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Communicates clearly and professionally.

• Is comfortable working directly with senior leadership.

• Can handle confidential information with complete discretion.

• Is comfortable making decisions and solving problems.

• Can identify problems before they become larger issues.

• Is comfortable holding people accountable for deadlines and responsibilities.

• Can work independently in a remote environment.

• Is dependable and consistently responsive during working hours.

• Has strong written English and professional communication skills.

• Is comfortable working with U.S.-based executives and teams.

• Understands that priorities can change quickly in a growing company.

________________________________________

Remote Work Expectations

This is a 100% remote position.

The successful candidate must have:

• A reliable internet connection.

• A professional and quiet home working environment.

• A computer capable of handling video conferencing and standard business applications.

• The ability to participate in video meetings.

• Strong availability and responsiveness during agreed working hours.

• The ability to work independently without constant supervision.

• Strong time-management and organizational skills.

Because this position works directly with the CEO, responsiveness, reliability, and communication are extremely important.

________________________________________

Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years of professional HR experience.

• Strong experience with recruiting and talent acquisition.

• Experience managing employee onboarding and offboarding.

• Experience handling employee relations and HR administration.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills.

• Experience working with managers or senior leadership.

• Strong Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Preferred

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.

• HR certification such as SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent.

• Previous experience as an HR Manager, Senior HR Manager, HR Business Partner, Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner, or Chief of Staff.

• Experience working directly with a CEO, founder, or executive.

• Experience working for a U.S.-based company.

• Experience managing remote employees.

• Experience building HR processes for a growing company.

• Experience with HRIS, recruiting platforms, project management systems, and collaboration tools.

________________________________________

Compensation

Monthly Compensation: $1,200–$1,550 USD

Final compensation will be based on:

• Relevant HR experience

• Recruiting experience

• Executive/Chief of Staff experience

• English communication skills

• Level of independence

• Overall qualifications and experience

Exceptional candidates with directly relevant experience may be considered at the higher end of the range.

________________________________________

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to become a key member of a growing organization and work directly with the CEO.

You will have meaningful responsibility across both Human Resources and company operations, rather than being limited to a traditional administrative HR role.

The right person will have significant visibility into the business and the opportunity to grow with the company as the organization expands.

If you are an experienced HR professional who is highly organized, proactive, trustworthy, and enjoys being the person who keeps things moving, we want to hear from you.

How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your resume

2. A brief summary of your HR and recruiting experience

3. Your experience working directly with executives or CEOs, if applicable

4. Your current availability

5. Your expected monthly compensation within the $1,200–$1,550 USD range

We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term relationship with the company and grow with the organization.



Please send your resume to Glemil Lopez at

title: US Outbound Cold Caller (B2B, Home Service Contractors) – Clear American-Neutral English
description:
We're a web design studio looking for a US outbound cold caller for a 2-week paid trial, with a long-term position for the right person.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll call US roofing contractors (owners, not receptionists) and do one thing: find out if the owner wants to see a free preview of a new website. You are NOT selling. You open the conversation and get a "yes, send it". I handle the rest.



- 50-60 dials per hour of work, ~5-6 hours per day

- Talk to the owner/decision maker, qualify in under 60 seconds

- Log every call in a shared Google Sheet within 5 minutes

- Send a short end-of-day report (dials, conversations, leads, what didn't work)



SCHEDULE

Part time, 5-6 hours/day, Monday-Friday, during US Central business hours (roughly 9 AM-3 PM Central). This is a night shift in the Philippines, so apply only if this works for you.



PAY

- Trial: $5-7/hour (based on experience)

- $50 bonus for every client that closes from your leads

- Weekly payment via Wise or PayPal



WHAT WE PROVIDE

Lead list with phone numbers, call script, OpenPhone account with a US number. All calls are recorded.



REQUIREMENTS

- Native-level, clear, neutral English. Accent matters because the owner decides in the first 5 seconds

- At least 6 months of B2B cold calling or appointment setting

- Comfortable with rejection: expect 8 out of 10 calls to end in "not interested"

- Stable internet and a quiet room with a quality headset

- Honest reporting. I check recordings daily, so numbers must match



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT - applications that skip this are deleted)

1. Start your message with the word ROOFLINE

2. Attach a 60-second voice recording (MP3 or a Google Drive/Loom link) in which you:

   a) Read this opening line naturally, as if you're calling:

      "Hi, is this the owner? Hey, my name is [your name], I'm calling about [business name]'s website. I put together a free preview of a new one for you, no strings attached. Do you have 30 seconds?"

   b) Then answer out loud, in your own words: "An owner says: I already have a website." What do you say?

3. Tell us in 2-3 sentences: how many cold calls did you make per day in your last role, and what was your results rate?

4. Tell us your available hours and your internet speed.



Shortlisted candidates do a paid 3-4 hour test on a real lead list. Best performer gets the job.

title: Full-Time Video Editor for Facebook & TikTok Ads | $800–$1,000/Month
description:
We are a growing performance marketing company looking for a fast, reliable video editor to join our team long-term.

We create a high volume of video ads for
, TikTok, Snapchat, and other paid social platforms.

This is not a cinematic editing position.

We're looking for someone who can make effective social media ads quickly, create variations of winning ads, use AI to work faster, and eventually operate with minimal supervision.

You do NOT need years of direct-response advertising experience. We're willing to teach the right person.

What we care about most is:

- Speed

- Reliability

- Communication

- Creative instincts

- Resourcefulness

- Willingness to learn

- Ability to work independently

What you'll be doing

You'll create short-form video ads, usually around 15–60 seconds.

We'll provide things like winning ads, scripts, hooks, UGC footage, landing pages, competitor examples, and creative direction.

However, we do not expect everything to be handed to you.

If you need B-roll, find it.

If you need a voiceover, generate one.

If you need an AI image/video, create it.

If you need ideas, research them.

We want editors who solve problems instead of immediately asking what to do.

Volume

Our long-term target is approximately 50–60 finished ads per week.

That does NOT mean creating 60 completely new videos every week.

Typically:

- Around 10–20 will be new concepts

- The remaining 30–40+ will be variations of existing ads

For example, you might take one winning
 ad and create 5 different versions with:

- New hook copy

- Different opening footage

- New voiceover

- Different visual hook

- Different person/UGC footage

- Different AI-generated opening

Much of the original winning ad may stay the same.

Speed is extremely important for this position.

If it normally takes you an entire day to edit one 30–60 second social media ad, this probably isn't the right position for you.

AI is encouraged

We want our editors using AI to make themselves faster and more creative.

You may use tools such as:

- ChatGPT

- Claude

- ElevenLabs

- Kling

- Veo

- Midjourney

- CapCut AI

- Other AI image/video tools

You don't need to be an amazing copywriter.

However, you should be able to use AI to help generate hooks, rewrite scripts, brainstorm concepts, create assets, and solve problems.

Communication

This is extremely important.

Our team communicates through Slack.

During your normal working hours, you are expected to check Slack regularly and respond within a reasonable amount of time.

You do NOT need to be available 24/7.

But if you regularly disappear during working hours, don't check messages, or need to be chased for updates, please do not apply.

We want someone we can trust to communicate and get their work done without constant follow-up.

You're probably a good fit if:

- You're experienced editing TikTok/Reels/UGC-style content

- You're a fast editor

- You have strong English comprehension

- You're reliable and responsive

- You can follow instructions carefully

- You have good creative instincts

- You're comfortable using AI

- You can find B-roll/assets yourself

- You can work independently

- You take feedback well

- You're interested in learning performance marketing

Experience editing
 ads, TikTok ads, UGC ads, e-commerce ads, affiliate marketing, or direct-response creative is a big plus, but it's not required.

Compensation

$800–$1,000 USD/month

This is an ongoing position with consistent work.

We're looking for someone who wants to stay with us long-term, learn performance marketing, and become an important part of our creative team.

There will also be opportunities to take on more creative responsibility over time if you perform well.

Paid test

Before hiring someone full-time, selected applicants will complete a paid creative test.

We'll give you several existing ads and ask you to create variations.

We'll be evaluating:

- Editing quality

- Speed

- Communication

- Creativity

- Resourcefulness

- Ability to follow instructions

- Ability to create strong variations

You will be paid for completing the test.

How to apply

Please answer ALL of the following:

1. Send 3–5 examples of your best short-form video work. Do not send us 20+ examples.

2. Have you edited
, TikTok, UGC, e-commerce, or direct-response ads before? Briefly explain.

3. What editing software do you primarily use?

4. What AI tools do you currently use for your work?

5. If we gave you an existing 30–60 second ad, approximately how long would it take you to create 5 new hook variations?

6. Are you comfortable using Slack every workday and checking/responding to messages regularly during your working hours?

7. Are you looking for a long-term position?

IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word VELOCITY.

If your application does not start with VELOCITY, we will assume you did not read the job post.

We're hiring immediately and will invite the strongest applicants to the paid test.

title: Vertical Video Editor
description:
About the role



Keenya Kelly LLC is hiring a contract editor to turn raw footage into ready-to-post short vertical videos for Instagram, TikTok, and
. This is an editing-only role. Keenya plans and films the content, and our operations manager schedules it. You edit, on time, to a clear standard.



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing educator who has trained over 10,000 entrepreneurs and built 700K+ organic followers across platforms. You'll be editing the content that feeds her audience and her programs every week.



You're a fit if you like working from a clear brief, delivering in batches, and knowing exactly what's expected each week.



What you'll deliver:



Two kinds of videos, delivered in batches on a fixed weekly rhythm.

Deliverable

Volume

Delivery

Main videos: talking-head, tutorials, and trend videos edited from Keenya's footage



About 7 per week (1 per day), about 14 per week during launch periods (Talking Head)



Edit next week's videos this week. About 3 finished videos per working day once footage and the calendar are shared.



Trial Reels: B-roll clips with text on screen (VERY EASY AND REPETITIVE)

70 per week

35 every Monday and 35 every Wednesday



What a finished main video includes

• Tight cuts with no dead air, and a strong visual hook in the first second

• On-screen text and captions as written in the content calendar

• Clean audio, and trending audio where the calendar calls for it

• Vertical 9:16, exported to the right folder and named to our file convention



What a finished Trial Reel includes

• A B-roll clip chosen from our best-performing footage folder, with the strongest visual moment first

• The on-screen text from the text list provided, readable and on-brand

• Around 7 seconds long, unless the brief says otherwise

Revisions: turn around requested changes within 24 hours.



What we provide

You won't be guessing what to make. Every week you get:



• The content calendar for main videos, planned about two weeks ahead, with the hook, on-screen text, caption, format notes, and reference examples for each piece

• Raw footage from Keenya in a shared Drive folder

• The B-roll library, plus a separate folder of the footage that performs best in Trial Reels

• A running list of Trial Reel on-screen text and captions

• Examples of top-performing videos and our approved templates

• One point of contact: our operations manager, who handles handoffs, feedback, and scheduling



You don't write scripts, plan content, schedule posts, or manage accounts. You never need login access to Keenya's social media accounts.



Requirements

Must have

• A portfolio of short vertical videos you edited for Instagram Reels or TikTok, with links

• Strong skills in CapCut (desktop) or a comparable editor

• An eye for hooks: you know what makes someone stop scrolling in the first second

• Reliability: you hit batch deadlines every week without reminders

• Clear written English, and you follow written briefs precisely

• Comfort working in Google Drive and shared spreadsheets



Nice to have

• Experience editing for coaches, educators, or personal brands

• Familiarity with current Instagram and TikTok trends and audio

• Experience with Canva



Availability: enough capacity to deliver the volumes above every week, with at least a few hours of overlap with US Central Time on weekdays for questions and feedback.



Pay, terms, and paid test week

• Pay: $550per month, based on experience. You're paid for output, not hours, so you can batch the work on your own schedule as long as deliveries land on time.



• Type: independent contractor, ongoing.

• Paid test week: before we agree on a monthly contract, the top candidate completes one paid test week of real work: one week of main videos and 70 Trial Reels, delivered on the normal Monday and Wednesday schedule. The test week pays $140.



We'll look at speed, quality, how closely you followed the brief, and how you handle revisions.



• After the test: if it's a fit, we set a monthly agreement with the deliverables above and review it after 30 days.

How to apply

Send the following to 
 with the subject line "Short Vertical Video Editor":

1. Links to 3–5 short vertical videos you edited, with one line on what you did for each

2. Your editing software, and how many videos you can realistically edit per week

3. Your time zone and weekday availability

4. Confirmation that the pay range and weekly delivery schedule work for you

5. Must include the word CAPCUT to show that you have read the entire job post for consideration

Title: WordPress Developer: Build Our Business Website from Approved Designs (Fixed-Price Project, Ongoing Work Possible)

We install gutter systems, heat cable for ice dam prevention, concrete coatings and custom garage cabinets across the Four Corners. We are replacing our current website and want to own and run the new one ourselves.



The project

Build our new site in WordPress on our existing SiteGround hosting. The designs and copy are finished before you start building. You are not designing or writing, you are building accurately and cleanly. About 75 pages built from 10 page layouts.



What you will do



Build the theme and global styles (colors, fonts, buttons, header, footer) from our design files

Build each layout as reusable block patterns so our team can edit pages without breaking the design

Load our final copy and images into about 75 pages (homepage, service pages, location pages, blog posts, project profiles)

Import about 30 existing blog posts and set up about 30 redirects from our old URLs

Connect our lead form to our CRM (JobNimbus) using Zapier or a webhook

Embed our Alivo.AI booking widget on the contact page

Install Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager and Search Console

Set up an SEO plugin (Rank Math or Yoast) with titles, meta descriptions, XML sitemap and schema (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ, Article)

Build on a staging site that is hidden from Google, then handle the cutover to the live domain

Record short training videos so our team can edit pages and publish posts



What we provide



Approved page designs for each layout

Final copy and images for every page

A page-by-page site map and a redirect map

SiteGround access (a separate user account, not our main login)

A single point of contact who answers within one business day



Must have



At least 3 live WordPress sites you built, with links you can show us

Experience with block editor themes (Kadence, GeneratePress or similar), not just heavy page builders

Experience migrating a site with redirects without losing search traffic

Fast, clean builds (good Core Web Vitals scores) that work well on phones

Clear written English and weekly progress updates



Nice to have



Experience with local service business sites

Zapier or API experience

Experience with SiteGround



Timeline

Start: early November 2026. Staging complete: mid-December. Go-live target: December 21, 2026. Hard deadline: January 1, 2027. Please apply only if you can commit to these dates.



Pay and terms

Fixed price for the full build, paid in 4 milestones after we review each one. Include 30 days of free fixes after launch. Tell us your price and what is included. Ongoing monthly website support is available for the right person.

We will pay you to build one page from one of our approved designs, with a deadline of 3 days.



To apply, answer these:



Send 3 WordPress sites you built and tell us which parts you did.

You'll also design the thumbnails, social graphics, carousels and blog images for our website and social channels. You'll work in Premiere Pro (or similar), Photoshop and Canva, and you'll build and maintain the templates the marketing team uses for everyday content.



Because we’re an immigration law firm, every video and graphic goes through an accuracy and compliance review before it's published. The right person takes detailed feedback well, applies edits precisely, and makes educational immigration content clear and engaging without overstating anything. You'll report to the Marketing Manager and work closely with the content, social, SEO and web development team.



Core Responsibilities

Video Editing

Edit long-form YouTube video per week, turning scripts, raw footage, graphics and other source material into a polished final production.

Cut each long-form video into 3-5 short clips for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, with captions, a strong opening hook and a closing call-to-action card.

Edit scripted short-form videos, client testimonial videos and firm introduction videos.

Add captions, lower thirds, on-screen text, b-roll, motion graphics, intros, outros and end cards, and handle audio cleanup and color correction for a consistent, professional look.

Apply reviewer notes precisely and completely, and provide an updated transcript after each revision round.

Keep project files, raw footage and final exports organized in the shared drive.

Deliver high-quality work on a consistent weekly schedule, with quick turnaround on revisions.

Graphic Design

Design YouTube thumbnails, Reel and TikTok covers, and testimonial video thumbnails.

Create social graphics and carousels for Instagram,
 and 
 from blog posts, FAQs and approved client reviews.

Produce blog featured images and text-based infographics and tables for the website, optimized for web performance.

Build and maintain a Canva template library so the marketing team can produce recurring content quickly and consistently.

Support the firm's brand refresh and website redesign with visual assets, including photo retouching and consistent backgrounds on attorney headshots.

Editorial & Brand Standards

Use sound editorial judgment to create content that is clear, accurate and engaging for people navigating immigration questions.

Make sure all videos and graphics follow Ashoori Law's brand guidelines and the legal advertising rules for law firms.

Submit all work through the firm's accuracy and compliance review before publishing, and implement required changes promptly.

Follow YouTube and social platform community guidelines and content policies.

Work with the marketing, content, social, SEO and web development teams so content meets creative and strategic goals.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Stay current on YouTube and short-form editing best practices, thumbnail trends, audience behavior and new content formats.

Review high-performing immigration and legal education content for format and style ideas, without copying anyone's wording or creative.

Use performance data (click-through rate, watch time, engagement) to improve thumbnails, hooks and pacing over time.

Suggest improvements to editing workflows, templates and production efficiency.



Qualifications

3+ years of experience of professional video editing and graphic design experience

A portfolio showing edited YouTube videos, short-form vertical videos, thumbnails and social graphics or carousels.

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro), Adobe Photoshop and Canva.

Experience editing educational, talking-head or explainer content for YouTube.

Working knowledge of platform formats and specs, including 16:9, 9:16 and 4:5, safe zones and caption styles.

Strong attention to detail, especially with on-screen text, spelling and accuracy.

Ability to take detailed feedback and implement revisions precisely and on deadline.

Strong organization and project management skills; able to juggle a weekly video alongside ongoing design requests.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Reliable internet connection and availability during PST business hours.



Preferred

Experience creating content for law firms, legal media, or other regulated industries such as finance or healthcare.

Familiarity with YouTube Studio analytics and thumbnail testing.

Adobe After Effects or similar motion graphics experience.

Adobe Illustrator 



What Success Looks Like

One polished YouTube video and its short-form clips delivered on schedule every week.

A trial task IS REQUIRED for this role. This is non-negotiable.



We have seen complaints suggesting this is a scam — it is not. We have hired almost 10 people for this exact role through this exact process. The trial task exists for one reason: to see your actual skill level. The majority of applicants submit very poor quality links and are removed from the process at this stage, which is exactly the point.



We do not use, build, or benefit from any links submitted during the trial. They are reviewed for quality only. If we do build them, you will be compensated.

How It Works

What You Bring



Existing relationships with publishers in industrial, healthcare/compliance, home services, or ecommerce niches preferred

Knowledge of how to vet a domain (DR, traffic, ranking keywords vs. brand-only ranking)

Strong written outreach skills

Self-directed — we don't hand-feed targets

 with subject line "Backlink Outreach Specialist — [Your Name]"

Include:

title: Part-Time Sales & Client Outreach Assistant
description:
# Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor



**Remote | Initial Week-to-Week Trial**



Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. is seeking a confident, reliable, organized, and results-driven **Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor** to support our outbound calling, lead generation, customer follow-up, appointment setting, and business development activities.



This is an **independent contractor engagement and not an employment position**.



The engagement will begin with a **four-week trial period conducted on a week-to-week basis**. Following successful completion of the trial period, Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. may continue the contractor engagement for approximately **3–6 months**, depending on performance, reliability, results, and ongoing business requirements.



---



## 1. Contract Term & Week-to-Week Trial



The first **four (4) weeks** will be considered a trial period.



During the first month:



* The engagement will operate on a **week-to-week basis**.

* Each week will be evaluated independently.

* Performance, reliability, punctuality, communication, call activity, lead follow-up, professionalism, and results will be reviewed.

* Continuation into the following week will depend on satisfactory performance and the ongoing requirements of Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

* Completion of the four-week trial does not automatically guarantee a longer-term contract.



The purpose of the trial period is to determine whether the working relationship is a suitable fit for both the Contractor and Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



Following successful completion of the four-week trial, Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. may continue the contractor engagement for approximately **3–6 months**.



There is no guarantee that the contract will continue for the full 3–6 month period. Continuation will depend on performance, results, reliability, professionalism, conduct, and business requirements.



---



## 2. Required Service Schedule



The Contractor must be available to provide services during the following agreed hours:





### Strict Schedule Requirement



These service hours are a **material requirement of this contract**.



The Contractor must be logged in, available, and actively performing the agreed services beginning at **8:30 AM Pacific Time** and continuing until **12:30 PM Pacific Time** on each scheduled day.



The Contractor is expected to:



* Be ready to begin work at 8:30 AM Pacific Time.

* Remain available and actively performing contracted services until 12:30 PM Pacific Time.

* Be available for calls, follow-ups, and communication throughout the agreed service period.

* Accurately report hours and activities completed.

* Notify Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. as soon as reasonably possible in the event of an emergency.

* Request approval in advance for planned schedule changes.



The agreed hours cannot routinely be moved to evenings, other days, or different times without prior approval from Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



Repeated lateness, missed service periods, unauthorized schedule changes, extended unexplained absences during agreed hours, or failure to actively perform assigned services may result in the contract not being continued or being terminated.



---



## 3. Primary Responsibilities



The Contractor's primary responsibility is to actively generate and develop sales opportunities for Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



Responsibilities include:



* Making outbound calls to prospective customers.

* Conducting cold and warm outreach.

* Contacting leads provided through Client Reach.

* Following up with new inquiries.

* Following up on outstanding estimates and sales opportunities.

* Reconnecting with previous customers and prospects.

* Contacting prospective B2B partners.

* Identifying business owners and decision-makers.

* Introducing Bloom Bug Screens products and services.

* Identifying customer needs and potential opportunities.

* Generating qualified leads.

* Booking appointments, consultations, estimates, and follow-up calls.

* Developing relationships with contractors, builders, property managers, stratas, restoration companies, designers, window companies, and other potential partners.

* Consistently following up with assigned prospects until an appropriate outcome has been established.



This is an **active outbound sales and client outreach role**.



The expectation is that the Contractor will actively make calls, contact prospects, complete follow-ups, and develop opportunities during the agreed service hours.



---



## 4. Client Reach Requirements



**Client Reach** will be the primary system used for lead management and sales activity.



All assigned customer and prospect interactions must be properly documented in Client Reach.



The Contractor will be responsible for:



* Reviewing assigned leads.

* Recording calls and contact attempts.

* Updating customer and prospect contact information.

* Adding clear and accurate notes following conversations.

* Updating lead status.

* Scheduling callbacks.

* Creating follow-up activities.

* Recording customer requirements and interests.

* Identifying hot, warm, cold, and future opportunities.

* Maintaining an organized and accurate sales pipeline.



**Every assigned customer interaction and outreach attempt must be documented in Client Reach.**



Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. must be able to review Client Reach at any time and clearly determine:



* Who was contacted.

* When they were contacted.

* Whether they answered.

* What was discussed.

* What the customer or prospect is interested in.

* Whether an estimate or appointment is required.

* What follow-up is required.

* When the next contact should take place.

* Which opportunities have the strongest potential to convert.



---



## 5. RingCentral – Business Calls & Call Recording



The Contractor will use the Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. **RingCentral** system for authorized business calls.



The Contractor will be expected to:



* Use the assigned Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. RingCentral account for authorized business calls.

* Make outbound calls during the agreed service hours.

* Maintain professional telephone etiquette.

* Follow approved scripts, talking points, and procedures.

* Leave professional voi
 messages when appropriate.

* Record relevant call outcomes and notes in Client Reach.

* Schedule appropriate follow-up actions.

* Maintain professional conduct whenever representing Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



### Call Recording



RingCentral includes **call-recording functionality**.



Where enabled and permitted under applicable laws and company policies, calls made or received through the Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. RingCentral system **may be recorded**.



Recordings may be reviewed by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. for legitimate business purposes, including:



* Quality assurance.

* Training and coaching.

* Customer service.

* Verification of customer conversations.

* Sales performance.

* Follow-up verification.

* Dispute resolution.

* Compliance with company procedures.



The Contractor acknowledges that authorized business communications conducted through company systems may be recorded and reviewed.



The Contractor must comply with all instructions provided by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. concerning privacy, customer notification, consent, confidentiality, storage, and handling of recorded communications.



Business communications conducted through company-provided systems should not be considered private communications.



---



## 6. Performance Expectations



This is a **results-oriented contractor role**.



Performance will be evaluated throughout the week-to-week trial and during any subsequent contract period.



Performance may be evaluated based on:



* Punctuality and reliability.

* Adherence to agreed service hours.

* Outbound calls completed.

* Meaningful customer conversations.

* Decision-makers contacted.

* Follow-ups completed.

* Qualified leads generated.

* Appointments generated.

* Estimates or quote opportunities generated.

* B2B opportunities developed.

* Sales opportunities moved forward.

* Quality and accuracy of Client Reach documentation.

* Professionalism when communicating with customers and prospects.

* Compliance with agreed processes and procedures.



Simply being logged into Client Reach, RingCentral, or another company system does not constitute completion of the contracted services.



The Contractor is expected to be **actively performing the agreed sales, calling, prospecting, and follow-up activities during the scheduled service hours**.



---



## 7. Weekly Invoicing & Payment Terms



The Contractor will be paid **weekly by invoice** for authorized services completed during the applicable week.



### Invoice Procedure



Invoices must always be submitted **after all scheduled working hours for that week have been completed**.



The Contractor may not submit an invoice in advance for hours or services that have not yet been completed.



The weekly process will be:



1. The Contractor completes all authorized service hours for the applicable week.

2. Once the week's scheduled services have been fully completed, the Contractor prepares the invoice.

3. The invoice must be
ed to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

4. The invoice must include a **PayPal invoice/payment link** that allows Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. to make payment through PayPal.

5. Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. will review the invoice against the authorized hours and services completed.

6. Correct and approved invoices will normally be paid within **24–48 hours after the invoice has been received by
**.



### Invoice Requirements



Each weekly invoice must clearly include:



* Contractor's name or business name.

* Invoice number.

* Invoice date.

* Week/service period being invoiced.

* Authorized hours completed.

* Agreed hourly rate or contractor fee.

* Total amount due.

* Applicable taxes, if legally required.

* **PayPal invoice/payment link.**

* Any other information reasonably required for payment processing.



The invoice must accurately reflect the authorized services actually completed.



### When the Invoice Should Be Submitted



The regular service schedule is:



**Monday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time

**Tuesday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time

**Thursday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time



Therefore, the Contractor's weekly invoice should only be raised and submitted **after the Thursday shift has been fully completed**, unless Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. has approved a different arrangement in writing.



Invoices must not be raised on Monday or Tuesday for the full week because the remaining contracted services have not yet been completed.



### Payment Timeline



Once a correctly prepared invoice has been
ed to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. and the week's authorized services have been completed, payment will normally be processed within **24–48 hours of receipt of the invoice**.



If an invoice contains incorrect hours, missing information, an incorrect amount, or does not include the required PayPal payment link, the Contractor may be asked to correct and resubmit the invoice.



In such cases, the 24–48 hour payment period will begin after the corrected invoice has been received and approved.



### No Advances



**Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. does not provide advances against future contractor fees, future working hours, or future invoices.**



This means:



* No invoices may be submitted for services that have not yet been completed.

* No advance payments will be made for future scheduled hours.

* No advances against future invoices will be provided.

* No personal loans will be provided.

* No early payment will be made for services that have not yet been completed.



The Contractor acknowledges that this is a **post-service weekly invoicing arrangement**.



**Services are completed first. The invoice is submitted afterward. Approved payment is then processed within 24–48 hours of receipt.**



---



## 8. Independent Contractor Relationship



The Contractor is engaged as an **independent contractor and not as an employee of Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.**



Nothing in this arrangement is intended to establish an employer-employee relationship, partnership, joint venture, or other relationship beyond the independent contractor engagement.



The Contractor is responsible for their own applicable taxes, filings, registrations, insurance, and other obligations associated with their independent contractor status, subject to applicable law.



---



## 9. Confidentiality & Company Information



The Contractor may receive access to confidential and commercially sensitive information belonging to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd., including:



* Customer names and contact information.

* Lead databases.

* Customer requirements.

* Pricing.

* Supplier information.

* Business partner information.

* Sales strategies.

* Call scripts.

* Marketing information.

* Internal business processes.

* Login credentials.

* CRM information.

* Recorded communications.

* Company documents and data.



All company and customer information remains confidential and must only be used for authorized Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. business purposes.



The Contractor must not copy, download, distribute, disclose, sell, retain, transfer, or use company or customer information for personal purposes or for another business.



Upon completion or termination of the engagement, the Contractor must immediately cease accessing company systems.



Access to Client Reach, RingCentral,
, and other company systems may be removed immediately upon completion or termination of the contract.



Any confidential company or customer information in the Contractor's possession must be returned or permanently deleted as instructed by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



---



## 10. Position Summary



**Role:** Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor

**Company:** Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

**Relationship:** Independent Contractor

**Initial Trial:** 4 Weeks – Week-to-Week

**Potential Continued Contract:** Approximately 3–6 Months

**Commitment:** 12 Hours Per Week

**Days:** Monday, Tuesday & Thursday

**Service Hours:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time

**Location:** Remote

**Payment:** Weekly Upon Submission of Invoice

**Payment Method:** PayPal Invoice/Payment Link

**Payment Processing:** Normally Within 24–48 Hours of Receiving a Correct Invoice

**Primary Systems:** Client Reach & RingCentral

**Primary Focus:** Outbound Calling, Lead Generation, Customer Follow-Up & Appointment Setting



---



## 11. Important Terms & Conditions



By accepting this engagement, the Contractor acknowledges and agrees that:



* This is an **independent contractor arrangement and not employment**.

* The first four weeks are a **week-to-week trial period**.

* Continuation from one week to the next during the trial depends on satisfactory performance, reliability, results, and business requirements.

* Successful completion of the four-week trial does not guarantee continued engagement.

* Following successful completion of the trial, the engagement may continue for approximately **3–6 months**.

* The agreed Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday service hours are a material requirement of the engagement.

* Consistent punctuality and availability during the agreed service hours are required.

* Schedule changes require prior approval except in genuine emergencies.

* All assigned customer and lead activities must be documented in Client Reach.

* Business calls will be conducted using RingCentral.

* RingCentral includes call-recording functionality, and authorized business calls may be recorded where enabled and permitted.

* Contractor activity and performance may be reviewed through company systems.

* The Contractor must complete the week's authorized services **before raising the weekly invoice**.

* The weekly invoice must be submitted after completion of the Thursday service period unless otherwise agreed.

* The invoice must be
ed to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

* The invoice must contain a **PayPal invoice/payment link**.

* Correct and approved invoices will normally be paid within **24–48 hours after receipt by
**.

* **No advances against future contractor fees, future hours, or future invoices will be provided.**

* Company, customer, lead, pricing, supplier, and business information is confidential.

* Continued engagement depends on performance, reliability, professionalism, results, compliance with agreed procedures, and the ongoing business requirements of Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

description:
Caregiver Recruiter — Home Care (Remote VA)

Full-time or near full-time · Remote (Philippines) · Pacific Time weekdays

Heritage Senior Care (Carlsbad, California)



About us

Heritage Senior Care is a third-generation, California-licensed non-medical home care agency. We help families keep seniors safe and supported at home. We are hiring a remote caregiver recruiter to support our California recruiting lead and keep a steady pipeline of quality caregivers.



Schedule

• Monday–Friday, overlapping Pacific Time office hours (target about 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PT, or a close block we agree on)

• Philippines local time for that window is overnight / early morning — confirm you can work that schedule reliably

• Occasional flexibility for candidate callbacks is a plus



What you will do

• Source caregivers located in the United States (California) on Indeed and other job boards we use (post, boost, and refresh ads as directed)

• Screen applications and resumes against our playbook (geo, experience, reliability signals, red flags)

• Message and phone-screen candidates; schedule interviews with our California recruiting lead

• Keep a clean daily pipeline tracker: new apps, contacted, interviewed, offered, hired, declined

• Follow up with warm candidates who went quiet

• Chase new-hire paperwork until complete (Home Care Aide registry, Live Scan fingerprint appointment, TB test, onboarding forms), then hand ready candidates to our California recruiting lead for interview and orientation

• Prepare short candidate summaries before interviews (no guessing — only what’s in the application and screening notes)

• Help with light recruiting admin: job post updates, interview calendar holds, reminder texts/emails

• Work inside the tools we assign 
, spreadsheet/ATS notes, Indeed, chat with the office)

• Back up our scheduling team during weekday hours when needed: call and text available caregivers to fill open or call-off shifts, and update the schedule in our scheduling software as directed



What you will NOT do

• You do not recruit or screen caregiver applicants located outside the United States

• You do not make final hire decisions, run interviews or orientation, or verify documents in person (our California team does)

• You do not give clinical advice or discuss client medical details

• You do not handle overnight / weekend on-call staffing (that is covered separately); scheduling backup is weekday Pacific Time hours only

• You do not post or change paid ad spend without approval

title: Unreal Engine Game Developer
description:
*** READ BEFORE APPLYING*** 

* Send your Resume.

* Send a work sample that you will be willing to walk us through should you get an interview. Personal projects count too!

* Send your portfolio.

* Read the job description. 

If you have questions before submitting this, feel free to reach out and ask! 



Who We Are:

At Happy Little Games, games are art. We are an independent studio built by gamers, for gamers, making the kinds of games we would want to play ourselves. We care about creating games that are fun, memorable, and worth the time players spend with them. Every project is a chance to build something distinct that we are genuinely proud of.



Why Work Here:

If you love games and enjoy building things, this is a place where you can do both in a flexible, supportive environment. We are fully remote, you can set your own schedule, and we do not believe in crunch. We care about the quality of your work and whether you get things done, not how many hours you sit at a desk.



You also get to work closely with a small team and d
 how you want to grow. You can deepen your expertise in the work you already enjoy, explore other areas of game development, or grow into a different role over time. Being good at one thing does not mean you have to do only that thing forever.



Role Overview

* Build and prototype gameplay features in Unreal Engine using Blueprints.

* Work on gameplay systems, basic AI, physics, interactions, and related gameplay functionality.

* Create focused test environments that clearly show how a feature works.

* Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review.

* Keep implementation focused on the requested scope and avoid unnecessary files, systems, or dependencies.

* Document what you build, how it works, and how it should be tested.

* Manage assigned user stories, communicate progress, and raise questions, blockers, or risks early.

* Learn and follow the studio’s technical standards, workflows, and development practices.





What You Need to Bring:

You do not need to know every Unreal Engine system before joining us, but you should already be able to work productively without constant step-by-step instruction. You should already be able to:



* Work comfortably within Unreal Engine.

* Build functional gameplay features using Blueprints.

* Build simple gameplay systems and basic AI behavior.

* Apply basic software-development principles, including logic, data flow, organization, and debugging.

* Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review.

* Test both the expected behavior and a basic control case where the feature should not activate or behave the same way.

* Research unfamiliar but well-documented problems and make reasonable progress independently.

* Manage your own time and keep assigned work moving toward completion.

* Keep your work focused on the requested scope.

* Ask useful questions when requirements or technical direction are unclear.

* Communicate progress, blockers, and risks early.

* Create and maintain basic documentation for your work.

* Keep project files and implementation reasonably clean and organized.

* Explain how your work functions and why you made important implementation decisions.

* Remain professional, dependable, and honest about what you do and do not know.



What You Can Learn Here:

You are not required to already know every tool, framework, or production practice used by the studio. You can learn or further develop the following after joining:



* Git and the studio’s source-control workflow.

* Notion and the studio’s user-story workflow.

* Agile and Scrum practices.

* The Gameplay Ability System and how it is used within our projects.

* The studio’s architecture, naming conventions, and technical standards.

* Formal system-design and diagramming practices.

* Stronger documentation practices.

* Multiplayer replication.

* Basic C++ as your responsibilities grow.

* More advanced gameplay, AI, animation, physics, and Unreal Engine systems.



You should be willing to research these areas, learn from available documentation and examples, and apply feedback to future work.



Compensation:

Your final hourly rate will be based on your experience, demonstrated skills, technical ability, communication, and level of independence. We will determine the appropriate rate through the interview and trial process.



Work Progression:

New developers begin with a trial project so we can evaluate how they work, communicate, and deliver against a real set of requirements. Developers who complete the trial successfully may continue with project-based work. From there, strong and consistent contributors may move into hourly work as availability and studio needs allow.

As the company grows, hourly developers may also have the opportunity to move into a full-time role if both sides are interested.



How to Apply:

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph whenever possible and include your resume, portfolio, and any relevant Unreal Engine work samples.

title: Customer Support Email / VA
description:
We’re McMahon Dog Training — a dog training brand with 1.1 million followers across all platforms and 50 million views in the last month. Alongside our content, we run an online Puppy Program Course, and we’re currently expanding into a dog training app. That growth is why we need someone on customer support.



What you’ll be doing



You’ll be the person our customers hear back from. Day to day, that means:



- Handling customer
s — answering inquiries and working through problems customers are having

- Processing and responding to refund requests

- Walking customers through how to navigate our course platform — where to find things, how to log in, how to get unstuck

- Managing our platforms on the support side, including Kajabi and our dog training app



Most of this is
-based support for people who’ve bought our course and need help using it.



The hours



This starts at 15 hours per week. As we launch the app and the support volume grows, we expect this to move to 20–30 hours per week within about a month. We would ask you to work from 9AM to 12PM California Time, Monday to Friday.



What we need from you



- Proficient English, written especially — you’ll be representing us in every
 you send

- Takes direction and applies it. We’ll tell you how we want things handled; we need you to actually run with it.

- Takes initiative in helping people. Not just closing tickets — actually solving the person’s problem.

- Able to give clear, patient direction for navigating websites and software. A lot of our customers aren’t especially tech-savvy, and your job is to make it easy for them.

- Reliable. This is the big one. Our customers are waiting on replies, and we need someone who consistently shows up and gets through the inbox.



Experience with Kajabi, Gmail/email support tools, or any helpdesk software is a plus, but what matters most is that you’re sharp, dependable, and good with people.



Time tracking and payroll



We use Hubstaff to track clocked-in hours. This is how our payroll runs, and it works in both directions — it confirms the work is getting done, and it makes sure you are paid fairly and accurately for every hour you actually work. No guessing, no disputes over hours.



If you are not comfortable using Hubstaff, please do not apply.



Why this is a great opportunity



We’re growing, and this role grows with us. You’d be coming in right as we expand from one course into a full app, which means more hours, more responsibility, and real career opportunity for the right person.



HIRING PROCESS — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



Submit your application

Interview — a short 10 to 15 minute interview with us



The interview is required. We need to talk to the person we’re trusting with our customers — and since this role is about communication, we’re not hiring anyone we haven’t actually spoken with. If you are not willing to do a 10–15 minute interview, please do not apply.



TO APPLY



Send your application with:



1. A short note on your customer support or VA experience

2. Any platforms or software you’ve supported customers on (Kajabi, Shopify, helpdesk tools, etc.)

3. One paragraph on how you’d handle a customer who’s frustrated and asking for a refund

title: Part-Time Phone Caller for a US Real Estate Team (Agent Calls Only, No Homeowner Cold Calls)
description:
I’m a real estate agent in Sacramento, California. I need someone to call other real estate agents about their listings and ask two questions: is it still available, and what’s the story. You log what they said in a shared Google Sheet. That’s the job.



You’re not selling anything. You never discuss price or terms. When an agent asks about money, you say “the agent I work for handles that” and move on. The agents you’re calling are professionals and most will be polite. Some won’t. That has to be fine with you.



Details:



  - $10/hour, about 5 hours a week to start (roughly $200/month). More hours and more pay as it works.



  - $20 bonus every time one of your calls turns into a written offer. 



  - Paid one-week trial first.



  - About 5 hours a week. Pick your own days and times, as long as they fall Tuesday to Thursday between 10am and 4pm US Pacific. Those are the hours listing agents actually pick up. Nothing on Monday, Friday, or weekends.



  - All calls and texts from a company phone number I provide. Never your personal phone. No autodialers, no bulk texting tools, no automation of any kind. Every call and text is you, by hand.



  - If you’ve worked on a dialer (Mojo, ReadyMode, Batch), tell me. This job isn’t that. You’ll talk to maybe 10 people in a session, not 150.



  - Fluent, natural, easy-to-understand English on the phone. Non-negotiable. Agents hang up fast on callers they can’t understand.



  - Calm and unhurried. You can ask one question and then stay quiet while someone talks. If you’re a high-energy sales type, this isn’t it.



  - Reliable logging. Every attempt gets a row the same day, including no-answers.



To apply, record 60 to 90 seconds at 
 and paste the link. Read this line first, then tell me in your own words about the last time you fixed something around your house:



“Hi, this is [your name] with a real estate team in Sacramento. We represent a cash buyer for rough rural property, and I’m calling about your listing on Rattlesnake Bar Road. Is it still available?”



Applications without the recording link won’t be considered.

title: Xactimate Estimator - Restoration
description:
Summit Restoration & Construction is looking for an experienced Virtual Restoration & Construction Estimator to join our team full-time.



We are specifically looking for someone with previous U.S. restoration industry experience who understands both mitigation and reconstruction estimating, has strong Xactimate experience, and has worked with TPA programs and insurance claims.



This is a full-time position with set working hours. This is not a flexible-hours, freelance, or project-based position. You will be expected to be available and actively working during your assigned schedule.



The ideal candidate can review project documentation, understand the full scope of a restoration loss, prepare accurate estimates, identify missing information, and communicate effectively with our U.S.-based team.



Responsibilities



* Prepare detailed estimates using Xactimate

* Write estimates for both mitigation and reconstruction

* Estimate water, fire, mold, and other property damage losses

* Review photos, measurements, scopes, Matterport documentation, MICA documentation, notes, and other project information

* Understand the relationship between mitigation and reconstruction scopes

* Prepare accurate estimates based on the documented scope of work

* Apply appropriate Xactimate line items for labor, materials, equipment, demolition, mitigation, and reconstruction

* Work within TPA program requirements and guidelines

* Review carrier and TPA estimate requirements and make necessary revisions

* Prepare estimate revisions and supplements when additional work or documentation is identified

* Assist with responding to carrier or TPA estimate revisions and questions

* Review estimates for accuracy, completeness, and proper documentation before submission

* Communicate with Project Managers, Coordinators, Estimators, and other members of our U.S.-based team

* Maintain organized project files and documentation

* Meet estimating deadlines and communicate proactively when information is missing



Required Experience & Qualifications



Applicants should have:



* Previous restoration estimating experience

* Hands-on Xactimate experience

* Experience estimating both mitigation and reconstruction

* Experience working with TPA programs

* Understanding of insurance restoration claims and carrier requirements

* Knowledge of water, fire, mold, and other property damage losses

* Ability to interpret photos, measurements, floor plans, scopes, and project documentation

* Understanding of restoration and construction terminology

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and deadlines

* Reliable internet connection and a professional remote work environment

* Ability and willingness to work a full-time, set schedule aligned with Arizona business hours



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is highly preferred:



* XactAnalysis

* MICA

* Matterport

* CompanyCam

* TPA platforms and programs

* Insurance carrier estimating guidelines

* Estimate revisions and supplements

* Xactimate Level 1, 2, or 3 certification

* Previous remote experience working directly with a U.S.-based restoration company



What We're Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to enter line items into Xactimate.



We need an estimator who understands restoration and can look at a loss from both the mitigation and reconstruction sides. You should understand how restoration projects move through the insurance process, how TPA requirements affect estimating and documentation, and what is needed to produce a thorough and defensible estimate.



We are a process-driven company, so it is important that you are able to follow established procedures, communicate when something is unclear, meet deadlines, and consistently produce quality work.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term, full-time position and wants to become an important part of our team.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions with your application:



1. How many years of restoration estimating experience do you have?

2. How many years have you used Xactimate?

3. Do you have experience writing both mitigation and reconstruction estimates? Please explain.

4. Which TPA programs have you worked with?

5. What types of losses have you estimated (water, fire, mold, reconstruction, large loss, etc.)?

6. Have you worked directly for or supported a U.S.-based restoration company?

7. What other restoration software have you used?

8. Do you currently hold any Xactimate certifications?

9. Are you available to work full-time during set Arizona/U.S. business hours?

10. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



Please also provide a sample Xactimate estimate you have completed. All customer names, addresses, claim information, and other confidential information must be removed before submitting the sample.



Applicants without restoration, Xactimate, mitigation/reconstruction, or relevant TPA experience may not be considered.

title: YouTube Video Editor + 3D Animator Job Post
description:
YouTube Aviation Video Editor + 3D Animator — Long-Term



We are looking for a talented YouTube Video Editor with 3D animation experience to join our aviation channel long-term.



You will be responsible for editing one 10–12 minute aviation video per week, combining high-quality traditional YouTube editing with selective 3D animation and visualization.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT a full 3D animation role.



Most of each video should use a combination of:



* Relevant aviation footage

* Archive/historical footage when appropriate

* Images

* Maps

* Motion graphics

* Diagrams

* Text/labels

* Other visuals that accurately support the narration



3D should be used strategically when it improves the storytelling, explains something visually, or shows something that would be difficult to demonstrate with normal footage.



For example, 3D could be used to visualize:



* Aircraft movements or maneuvers

* Flight paths

* Aircraft components and systems

* Engineering or technical concepts

* Scale comparisons

* Interior/exterior aircraft structures

* Scenes where suitable real-world footage is unavailable



We want someone who understands when 3D adds value and when regular footage is the better choice.



⸻



JOB DETAILS



Niche: Aviation

Video Length: 10–12 minutes

Frequency: 1 video per week

Turnaround: Maximum 7 days per video

Position: Long-term, ideally 1+ year

Provided by Us: Completed script + voiceover



We are building this channel for the long term and would like to find an editor who can grow with us and help develop a recognizable visual style.



⸻



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



1. Visual Accuracy



The visuals should closely match what is being discussed.



If the script mentions a specific aircraft, aircraft variant, component, airline, airport, event, location, or historical time period, the footage should accurately represent it.



Do not use random aviation footage simply because it looks good.



Attention to detail is extremely important in this niche.



2. Viewer Retention & Storytelling



We want videos that feel polished and engaging without becoming overly edited.



Use pacing, visual changes, camera movement, graphics, music, sound design, and 3D sequences to keep the viewer interested throughout the video.



The editing should support the story rather than distract from it.



3. Strategic 3D Animation



You should be comfortable creating short, clean 3D sequences when needed.



You may use:



* Blender

* Cinema 4D

* Unreal Engine

* After Effects with 3D tools

* Or equivalent professional software



We are not expecting the entire 10–12 minute video to be animated in 3D.



4. Copyright-Safe Sourcing



You MUST understand how to avoid copyright issues when sourcing footage, images, music, and audio.



You should know how to properly use licensed, royalty-free, public-domain, Creative Commons, or otherwise legally usable assets when appropriate.



We do not want videos built around simply downloading copyrighted clips from other YouTube channels.



⸻



EDITING EXPECTATIONS



Each completed video should include:



* Accurate footage that matches the script

* Short 3D sequences where appropriate

* Clean pacing and storytelling

* Background music appropriate to the tone

* Sound effects when they improve the scene

* Maps, diagrams, or graphics when useful

* Consistent fonts, colors, and visual branding

* Clean transitions

* Subtle zooms and camera movements

* Labels/text when needed for explanation

* Professional audio balancing

* A finished video ready to upload to YouTube



We are not looking for excessive transitions, constant flashy effects, or over-editing.



The priority is:



Storytelling → Accuracy → Retention → Visual Quality



⸻



STYLE



We will provide reference channels/videos showing the overall quality and pacing we are looking for.



The goal is not to copy another channel exactly.



We want to build our own recognizable aviation editing style while taking inspiration from high-quality aviation documentary/explainer content.



⸻



REQUIREMENTS



You should have:



* Strong YouTube editing experience

* 3D animation experience

* Experience with Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, or similar software

* Ability to create realistic and clean aviation-related 3D sequences

* Strong understanding of YouTube pacing and viewer retention

* Ability to source relevant, high-quality footage and images

* Strong attention to visual accuracy

* Good music and sound-design instincts

* Experience editing faceless YouTube content is preferred

* Strong English comprehension so visuals accurately match the script

* Reliable communication

* Ability to consistently meet weekly deadlines

* Willingness to make reasonable revisions when necessary



If you are a great traditional editor but cannot create 3D animation, this position is probably not the right fit.



⸻



WEEKLY WORKFLOW



Each week we will provide you with:



1. Script

2. Voiceover

3. Any additional direction or references



You will then:



1. Review the script and voiceover

2. Source accurate footage and visual assets

3. Plan where 3D animation would improve the video

4. Edit the complete 10–12 minute video

5. Add music, graphics, sound effects, and 3D sequences

6. Deliver the completed video within 7 days

7. Complete reasonable revisions if necessary



⸻



COMPENSATION



Please submit your price PER COMPLETED 10–12 MINUTE VIDEO.



Do not submit an hourly price unless you also clearly tell us what you would charge for one finished 10–12 minute video.



There is potential for consistent weekly work and a long-term relationship of 1+ year if the quality

title: Guerrilla Marketing Specialist – U.S. Mushroom Subscription
description:
## Guerrilla Marketing Specialist – U.S. Mushroom Subscription



We are a small U.S.-based mushroom farm looking for a creative and motivated guerrilla/community marketer to help grow our monthly dried mushroom subscription.



Our subscription provides customers approximately **2 oz. of dried mushrooms each month for approximately $20–$30/month**. We ship throughout the United States and U.S. territories.



### What You'll Do



Your primary job will be to find potential customers online and introduce them to our mushroom subscription in relevant communities.



This may include:



-
 groups

- Reddit communities

- Homesteading and gardening communities

- Mushroom and cooking communities

- Healthy-food communities

- Foodie groups

- Subscription-box communities

- Other relevant online communities you discover



We are NOT looking for someone to simply spam links.



We want someone who can find relevant conversations and communities, participate naturally, follow community rules, and creatively introduce people to our mushroom subscription when appropriate.



### Compensation



This is primarily a **performance-based position rather than an hourly position.**



**Qualified Posts/Engagements:**  

$0.50 per approved post/comment/qualified engagement.



Approximately **$10–$15 maximum per day** will initially be available for this portion of the work.



*
 Subscriber Bonus:**  

$2.50 for every verified new
 subscriber generated through your marketing.



**Paid Mushroom Subscription Bonus:**  

$10 BONUS for every new paying monthly mushroom subscriber generated through your marketing.



**BONUSES ARE UNLIMITED.**



For example, if your marketing generates 20 new paying mushroom subscribers, you earn an additional **$200 in bonuses**.



The better your marketing performs, the more you can earn.



### Tracking



You will be provided with a method for tracking the traffic,
 signups, and paid subscriptions generated from your work.



Only legitimate, verified subscribers will qualify for bonuses. Fake accounts, duplicate signups, spam, bots, or incentivized/fraudulent signups will not be accepted.



### Who We're Looking For



We would especially like to work with someone who:



- Has experience with
 groups, Reddit, forums, or community marketing

- Writes natural, conversational English

- Understands the difference between marketing and spam

- Can independently find communities where potential customers spend time

- Is creative about starting conversations and generating interest

- Is comfortable being measured based on actual results

- Can document where approved posts/comments were made



This will begin as a **trial position**. If you demonstrate that you can consistently generate legitimate traffic,
 subscribers, and paying customers, there is an opportunity for ongoing work and increased responsibility.



### When Applying



Please answer these three questions:



1. Have you previously promoted a product through
 groups, Reddit, forums, or other online communities? Please explain.

2. If you were trying to find U.S. customers for a monthly dried mushroom subscription, where would you start?

3. Give us one example of a
 or Reddit comment you might write to naturally introduce someone to our mushroom subscription WITHOUT sounding like spam.



Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for someone who understands creative, grassroots online marketing.
