title: Video Editor / Graphic Designer. Full-Time
description:
# Video Editor / Graphic Designer — Full-Time



We’re looking for a **high-level Video Editor / Graphic Designer** to join our team full-time.



We are a **fast-moving startup media company** that partners with influencers and creators to build and scale digital products — including courses, coaching programs, communities, and education products that genuinely have a positive impact on people’s lives.



You’ll be working across **multiple clients and brands**, so you need to be creative, adaptable, fast, and able to match different editing styles.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Editing short-form and long-form video content

* Creating engaging social media content

* Creating **advanced motion graphics** when required

* Designing graphics, thumbnails, carousels, and other visual assets

* Working across multiple brands with completely different visual identities

* Replicating existing editing styles accurately

* Developing new editing styles when needed

* Working alongside our creative and marketing team

* Turning around most editing projects within **24 hours**

* Taking feedback quickly and making revisions without unnecessary back-and-forth



## Requirements



You must be proficient in at least one of:



* **CapCut**

* **DaVinci Resolve**

* **Adobe Premiere Pro**



You should also:



* Be capable of **advanced motion graphic editing**

* Have strong **graphic design skills**

* Have a strong understanding of pacing, retention, sound design, typography, transitions, and visual storytelling

* Be able to adapt to different editing styles rather than forcing everything into one style

* Be comfortable working across multiple clients simultaneously

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Communicate clearly and respond quickly

* Be reliable with deadlines

* Be able to consistently deliver work within **24-hour turnaround times**

* Be comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment where things change quickly



Experience with After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar tools is a bonus.



## Hours



This is a **40-hour-per-week position**, working Monday–Saturday.



A typical schedule could look like:



**Monday:** 12:00 PM – 7:00 PM UK time

**Tuesday:** 12:00 PM – 7:00 PM UK time

**Wednesday:** 12:00 PM – 7:00 PM UK time

**Thursday:** 12:00 PM – 7:00 PM UK time

**Friday:** 12:00 PM – 7:00 PM UK time

**Saturday:** 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM UK time



**Total: 40 hours per week.**



The exact hours are **flexible**.



We don't care whether you prefer working in the morning, afternoon, or evening — as long as there is good overlap with the UK working day, communication is fast, deadlines are hit, and the work gets done.



We care much more about **output, reliability, and speed** than whether you start work at an exact time every day.



## IMPORTANT — How To Apply



**Do NOT just send us a portfolio. Portfolios will not be accepted as your application.**



We specifically want to see **how you edit**.



Send us a **Loom video showing your actual editing timelines** inside CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or whichever software you use.



Walk us through:



* Some of your strongest edits

* Your editing timeline

* How the edit was constructed

* Motion graphics you've created

* Any graphic design work you've done

* Different editing styles you've worked with



We want to see the **actual project files/timelines**, not just the finished videos.



This helps us separate people who genuinely created the work from people simply submitting portfolio pieces.



## Application



Start your application with the word:



**PINEAPPLE**



If you don't include **PINEAPPLE**, your application will not be considered.



Then include:



1. Your Loom video showing your editing timelines

2. The editing software you primarily use

3. Your experience with motion graphics

4. Your experience with graphic design

5. Your timezone/location

6. Whether you're available for 40 hours per week

7. How soon you can start



We're looking for someone who wants to become a **long-term part of the team**, move fast with us, and produce genuinely great creative work.

title: Operations Manager – Property Management & Leasing (Real Estate) — Long-Term, Full-Time, US Hours
description:
We're a U.S.-based real estate holdings company, and we're hiring an Operations Manager to lease up our rental properties and then run the day-to-day of our property management operation.



This role is phone-forward first. In your first phase you'll be on the phones every day with rental applicants — answering inquiries, pre-screening, scheduling, and getting our units leased. As our properties fill up, the role grows into a full operations seat: overseeing vendors and leasing, managing our support team and systems, and being the owner's right hand on whatever the business needs.



This is long-term residential leasing — not short-term or mid-term rentals. You'll work directly with U.S. leadership inside our systems (GoHighLevel CRM, TurboTenant, Google Drive) using documented SOPs.



Phase 1 — Leasing (fill our units)

- Answer inbound calls, texts, and applications from prospective renters the same business day

- Pre-screen applicants against our rental criteria and schedule showings

- Follow up relentlessly until an applicant is approved and signed — no stale leads

- Keep every prospect and unit status accurate in the CRM

- Coordinate application, screening, and lease paperwork through to move-in



Phase 2 — Operations & Team Oversight (as we lease up)

- Own leasing operations and be the point person for resident and applicant questions

- Oversee vendor management — maintenance, turnovers, service providers, held to schedule

- Oversee our support team and the systems handling our email and inbox flow — you're the quality control that makes sure nothing slips

- Manage the owner's calendar, follow-ups, and open loops

- Provide day-to-day admin and operations support to the owner



Required (you will not be considered without these)

- Minimum 2 years of property management and leasing support (long-term, short-term, or mid-term rentals all qualify)

- That experience must be with a U.S.-based client

- Excellent spoken English and a confident, warm phone presence — this role lives on the phone

- Strong written English for email and CRM notes

- Genuinely strong attention to detail and follow-through (we test this)

- Comfortable coordinating people, vendors, and systems — and holding others accountable

- Reliable daily availability on U.S. Central hours + consistent end-of-day reporting



Nice to have (not required — we train)

- Leasing/screening software (TurboTenant, AppFolio, Buildium) or GoHighLevel

- Team lead, operations coordinator, or executive-assistant background



What success looks like at 90 days

Every applicant answered fast and professionally. Units leasing faster with a clean CRM. Vendors coordinated, the owner's inbox and phone handled, the team running smoothly, nothing slipping.



How to apply

1. Put the word "Blueprint" at the top of your message so we know you read this fully.

2. Attach your resume — it must clearly show your 2+ years of property management/leasing support and the U.S. client(s) you did it for.

3. Record a short (60-90 sec) voice or video recording answering: Tell us about your property management and leasing experience with U.S. clients, and why you're a fit for a phone-forward leasing role.

4. Answer briefly in writing:

 - A renter calls about a unit while you have five other applications waiting and a vendor issue to coordinate — walk us through your day.

 - Your current availability in U.S. Central Time, and your phone setup (quiet space, headset, reliable internet).



Applications missing the keyword, the recording, the written answers, or the 2-year U.S. property-management requirement won't be reviewed.

title: Automotive BDC & Sales Virtual Assistant – Dealership Experience Required
description:
# FULL-TIME AUTOMOTIVE BDC & CUSTOMER SERVICE VA



**Company:** Icon Tradings Co.

**Position:** Full-Time Automotive BDC / Customer Service & Sales VA

**Schedule:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Pay:** Fixed Monthly Salary

**Position:** Long-Term / Full-Time



## ABOUT THE POSITION



Icon Tradings Co. is a U.S.-based independent used car dealership with additional operations in **car rentals, towing, automotive service, and body shop services**.



We are hiring an experienced **Automotive BDC / Sales Virtual Assistant** to handle customer communication, sales leads, appointments, follow-ups, and administrative support.



**Previous experience working for an automobile dealership in Sales, BDC, Internet Sales, or Lead Management is REQUIRED.**



This is **not an entry-level general VA position.**



## PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



### DEALERSHIP SALES & BDC



* Answer incoming dealership calls and online inquiries.

* Respond quickly to new internet leads.

* Make outbound sales and follow-up calls.

* Communicate with customers by phone, text, and
.

* Provide vehicle availability and basic information.

* Schedule test drives and dealership appointments.

* Confirm appointments and follow up with no-shows.

* Follow up with unsold and older leads.

* Maintain accurate customer notes in the CRM.

* Help convert inquiries into **appointments and sales opportunities**.

* Assist with online vehicle listings and inventory updates when needed.



### RENTAL, TOWING, SERVICE & BODY SHOP



You will also assist with:



* Answering rental inquiries and scheduling reservations.

* Rental customer follow-ups, extensions, pickups, and returns.

* Receiving towing requests and coordinating customer information.

* Scheduling automotive service appointments.

* Scheduling body shop estimates and appointments.

* Following up with customers regarding pending services.

* Escalating important issues to management.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



The ideal candidate **MUST HAVE:**



* Previous **automobile dealership experience**.

* Experience in **Automotive BDC, Sales, Internet Sales, or dealership lead management**.

* Experience using a dealership CRM or similar lead-management system.

* Strong customer follow-up and appointment-setting skills.

* Experience making outbound sales calls.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confidence speaking with U.S. customers.

* Strong organization and multitasking skills.

* Reliable internet, computer, headset, and quiet workspace.

* Ability to work **9:00 AM – 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time**.



Experience with **car rentals, towing, service departments, or body shops** is an additional advantage.



## WHAT WE EXPECT



We need someone who understands that BDC is more than answering calls.



Our process is:



**New Lead ? Quick Response ? Qualify Customer ? Follow Up ? Set Appointment ? Confirm Appointment ? Follow Up After Visit ? Continue Until Sold/Closed**



You must be **proactive, dependable, organized, sales-minded, and consistent with follow-ups.**



A short **end-of-day report** will be required showing leads handled, calls made, appointments scheduled, rental/service/towing activity, completed follow-ups, and important pending matters.



## COMPENSATION



**Fixed Monthly Salary**



This is a long-term position with growth opportunities for the right person.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume/CV.

2. A brief description of your **automobile dealership and BDC/Sales experience**.

3. The dealership CRM systems you have previously used.

4. A **1–2 minute voice or video introduction**.

5. Confirmation that you can work **9:00 AM – 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time**.



### REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTION



**A customer inquires about a used vehicle, receives the price, and then stops responding. Explain how you would follow up and turn that lead into a dealership appointment.**



Applicants without previous **automobile dealership Sales/BDC experience** will not be considered.

title: Executive & Marketing Operations Assistant E-commerce
description:
Remote | Full-time |Australian Eastern Time required



About us



FDYS is a media-led outdoor, fishing and lifestyle business operating across multiple ecommerce verticals.



Across our brands, our YouTube channels have more than 3.7 million subscribers. Content is at the centre of what we do: it grows the audience, builds community and drives e-commerce demand.



We are looking for a highly organised, proactive operator to help our founders, marketing lead and wider team keep everything moving across content, social media, e-commerce, customer support, reporting and day-to-day business operations.



This is not a basic task-only virtual assistant role. We want someone who can follow systems, spot what needs attention, communicate early and take responsibility for closing the loop.



This is a broad coordinator role across executive support, content operations, e-commerce, customer support, reporting and team follow-through. Content planning is a high-priority part of the role, but this is not a single-creator personal-content-manager position.



The opportunity



You will work across several connected parts of the business. One important responsibility is helping turn current trends, business activity, fishing/outdoor life and approved campaigns into ready-to-film content plans so the team is not starting from a blank page each day.



You will also keep projects moving, follow up people and deadlines, support the customer-service workflow, prepare reports and make sure the founders and marketing lead have a clean view of what needs attention.



You will begin as a hands-on coordinator and can grow into broader Growth Operations, E-commerce Operations or Executive Operations responsibility as you prove your capability.



What you will do



Executive and team operations



•

Keep the master task tracker, content tracker and follow-up list accurate, with clear owners, deadlines, status and next actions.



•

Follow up editors, agencies, suppliers, collaborators and team members on deadlines and approvals.



•

Coordinate meetings, reminders, call notes and action items.



•

Keep Google Drive folders, files, links and documentation organised.



•

Help with appointments, research, bookings, vehicle servicing, property maintenance coordination and general founder administration.



•

Track outstanding actions and flag clashes, delays and blockers early with a suggested next step.



Customer support and e-commerce coordination



•

Support our approved customer-support workflow as the human quality-control layer behind our AI tools.



•

Review customer context, verified order/tracking information and drafted replies before they are approved and sent.



•

Handle straightforward enquiries about verified order status, tracking, sizing, product links and general FAQs using approved guidance.



•

Keep the support queue organised so cases are assigned, followed up and closed properly.



•

Pull Shopify reports and help track sales, orders, AOV, conversion, top products, stock flags and product performance.



•

Log incoming supplier and business invoices into the approved register, flag duplicates/discrepancies and follow up on items awaiting approval.



Marketing operations and reporting



•

Schedule approved posts and upload approved assets across the agreed social platforms.



•

QA test
 campaigns before sending: check links, product details, discount details, spelling and basic layout.



•

Pull marketing and e-commerce reporting from approved dashboards.



•

Explain basic movements in sales, conversion rate, AOV, traffic, ad spend, ROAS, CPA/CAC,
 revenue and top-product performance in plain English.



•

Prepare a short daily business brief covering sales/store, marketing, content due, customer issues, stock concerns, overdue tasks and decisions required from the founders.



•

Check AI-generated summaries against the source information and clearly separate confirmed facts from items still awaiting verification.



Data, stocktake and systems coordination



•

Help create one clear operating picture across Shopify, marketing dashboards, warehouse/stocktake records, customer support, team trackers and approved AI-agent outputs.



•

Compile daily and weekly reporting from approved sources, clearly labelling the reporting period and source for every important number.



•

Reconcile expected comparisons, such as Shopify inventory against warehouse stocktakes, marketing-platform spend against campaign reports, and AI summaries against the underlying source data.



•

Maintain a simple Data Exceptions Log for any mismatch: what the two sources say, the period, the variance, the owner, the next action and the date it was raised.



•

Request missing inputs, follow up on gaps and escalate material stock, marketing, customer-support or financial-data discrepancies quickly.



•

Maintain consistent definitions for key metrics such as gross sales, net sales, units sold, available stock, on-hand stock, ad spend, ROAS, CAC and profit.



•

Use approved systems only and handle customer/business data carefully. Do not place confidential data into personal tools or unapproved AI platforms.





Content, social media and trend research



•

Build and maintain a rolling two-week content calendar across our brands.



•

Prepare weekly content packs: ready-to-film post ideas with an exact hook, first visual, short script cue, B-roll needed, simple shot list, platform, CTA and any product/content link.



•

Prepare daily natural Story prompts so the relevant team member has a simple plan for what to show, say or ask their audience.



•

Research current short-form video formats and viral hooks across fishing, boating, outdoor, lifestyle and adjacent creator niches.



•

Turn approved trends into original concepts. You will adapt the format or hook—not copy another creator’s exact footage, script or creative work.



•

Maintain a Hook Bank showing the source, why it works, the Field Days version, footage needed, performance result and whether it should be reused.



•

Create clear briefs for editors, captions/CTA options and scheduling details. Follow approved content through to posting.



•

Help with routine comments and DMs using approved brand guidance; escalate sensitive issues immediately.



•

Review content performance weekly and use the learnings to improve the next plan.





What we are looking for



•

2+ years of experience as an executive assistant, operations coordinator, e-commerce coordinator, marketing coordinator.



•

Excellent written English and the ability to write clear, natural customer-facing messages.



•

Strong organisation and follow-through across multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders.



•

A genuine instinct for short-form content: you can identify why a hook works and turn it into a clear, practical filming plan.



•

Comfortable with Shopify, klaviyo, meta ads, google analytics, reporting, social media tools, Google Drive, Slack, spreadsheets, calendars and task trackers.



Comfortable with ai including claude, ai agents, manus etc



•

Practical understanding of e-commerce and performance-marketing metrics: sales, conversion rate, AOV, CTR, CPM, CPA/CAC and ROAS.



•

Comfortable in Google Sheets or Excel, including filters, formulas, pivots and basic reconciliation checks.



•

You understand that revenue and ROAS alone do not equal profit.



•

Confident using AI tools to draft and organise work, while checking outputs rather than trusting them blindly.



•

Strong judgement, confidentiality and attention to detail.



•

Proactive communication: when you find a problem, you flag it early, give context and recommend a next step.



Nice to have



•

Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Klaviyo/email QA, Later, Buffer, Meta Business Suite or similar platform experience.



•

Experience working with founder-led e-commerce, media or creator businesses.



•

Basic Canva or Figma skills.



•

Experience documenting SOPs, building dashboards or improving workflows.



Access and decision-making boundaries



You will have access only to the tools and information needed to do your role well. Access is staged as trust and capability develop.



You can coordinate, draft, check, report, organise, escalate and follow up..



How we work



We operate from one shared task system. Every meaningful request must have a clear owner, deadline, status and next action. You will not be expected to silently juggle conflicting private requests; you should raise priority clashes early and recommend what needs to move.



We value people who close the loop. Do not simply report that something is pending follow it through, update the relevant people and make sure there is a clear next step or a documented closure.



Application process

To apply, please send the following:

1. A short introduction video



Record a short video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a great fit for this role. 



Please upload it to Google Drive, Loom, or another platform where we can easily watch it, then include the link in your application.



Important: The video is a required part of the application. This role requires strong attention to detail, clear communication and the ability to follow instructions. Applications without a video will not be considered.



2. Your CV and relevant examples



Please include your CV, along with any relevant examples of work you have completed such as dashboards, content calendars, reporting, social-media plans, task systems, operational trackers or similar work.



Shortlisted candidates will then complete a paid practical assessment.
